fdroid:com.bartixxx.opflashcontrol.name: OnePlus Flash Control
fdroid:com.bartixxx.opflashcontrol.summary: Advanced LED control for OnePlus (root required)
fdroid:com.bartixxx.opflashcontrol.description:
OnePlus Flash Control is a powerful and intuitive LED control application designed **specifically for OnePlus devices** with dual-tone LED flash. The app works on both rooted and non-rooted devices, offering different feature sets based on your device's capabilities.
For Rooted OnePlus Devices (Full Features):
With root access on OnePlus devices, the app provides complete control over your device's LED functionality, allowing you to customize individual white and yellow LED brightness levels beyond stock settings and access advanced features.
For Non-Rooted Devices (Android 13+):
Even without root, the app offers basic flashlight control using Android's CameraManager API. While designed for OnePlus, this mode may also work on other Android 13+ devices as a bonus feature (not officially supported).
Key Features:
- Master Brightness Control: Adjust the overall LED brightness using a slider (0-500 on rooted devices, 1-5 torch levels on non-rooted).
- Individual LED Control (Root Only): Independently control the brightness of white and yellow LEDs for precise customization.
- Safety Mechanism: The app includes safety features that ensure brightness levels never exceed safe thresholds, automatically adjusting brightness to safe levels if necessary (rooted devices only).
- "Eye Destroyer" Mode (Root Only): A unique feature that flashes the LEDs at maximum brightness, emitting very intense light. This function is protected by a cooldown to prevent excessive use.
- Quick Settings Tile: A quick settings tile to toggle the LED brightness with ease, including cycling through brightness levels and detecting double-tap gestures.
- Adaptive UI: The app automatically hides advanced controls on non-rooted devices, providing a clean and appropriate user experience.
- Secret Action: Unlock hidden experimental features by tapping the app's title 5 times within 5 seconds.
Compatibility:
- OnePlus Devices (Rooted): Full feature access with system-level dual-LED control.
- OnePlus Devices (Non-Rooted, Android 13+): Basic flashlight control with torch strength levels.
- Other Android 13+ Devices (Non-Rooted): May work as a bonus feature, but not officially supported.
- Whether you're looking to fine-tune your OnePlus device's LED functionality with root access or simply need reliable flashlight control without root, OnePlus Flash Control adapts to your device's capabilities.

Square Chess is a chess app built for Android devices that ordinary chess apps often overlook — square and near-square screens, e-ink devices, compact devices and devices with physical keyboards.
The board comes first. Square Chess uses as much of the display as possible, whether you are playing by touch, typing moves on a physical keyboard, or using an e-ink screen.
Play against the computer at ten difficulty levels, from beginner-friendly play to full strength. You can also enable hints when you want a little help without giving up control of the game.
Train your tactics with 10,000 offline puzzles. Choose a theme or play a quick set of five, and the puzzles you miss come back for review.
You can also:
• Play with a friend on the same device, with an optional chess clock.
• Record games played on a real chessboard and review them afterwards.
• Type moves such as e4, Nf3, O-O or e2e4 on a physical keyboard.
• Use a dedicated e-ink mode with a clear black-and-white board, shape-based highlights and no animations.
• Review, undo and export your games as PGN for Lichess, ChessBase and other chess software.
• Use the built-in standalone chess clock for over-the-board games.
Everything runs locally on your device.
No ads. No account. No Internet permission.
Your games and settings stay on your device.
Square Chess works on conventional Android phones and tablets too, but is designed especially for devices where standard chess apps do not make the best use of the screen or hardware.

fdroid:com.vanillify.app.name: Vanillify
fdroid:com.vanillify.app.summary: Remove preinstalled bloat and stop background data sharing. No root.
fdroid:com.vanillify.app.description:
Vanillify makes your Android phone vanilla again: it removes the apps your phone came with that you never asked for, stops background data sharing and always-on listening, and keeps it that way. No root and no computer needed: it works through Shizuku, which gives it the same rights as adb.
Every change can be undone, and nothing happens until you confirm it.
What it does:
* Apps: every preinstalled app with its real name, icon and a safety rating from the Universal Android Debloater community list (about 5,400 packages from all major manufacturers and carriers), plus Vanillify's own findings verified on real phones, such as which apps upload usage data or hold a device-financing lock. Remove, disable or restore one app or many at once.
* Dependencies: before you remove an app, see which apps depend on it, what it depends on, and whether the system uses it as your home screen, keyboard, phone, SMS or browser app. Vanillify warns you before you remove something other apps need.
* Privacy settings: stop Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scanning while they are off, stop uploading your apps and Wi-Fi scans to Google, turn off crash reports, and choose an encrypted Private DNS that blocks ads and trackers in every app.
* Microphone: block the microphone for the apps that run all the time, such as "Hey Google", which Android's "only while using the app" does not cover.
* Per-app firewall (Android 14 and later): cut an app off from the internet using Android's own firewall. No VPN slot taken.
* Kept that way: Android resets microphone and network blocks at every restart. Vanillify puts them back as soon as Shizuku runs again, and reminds you if it isn't running.
* One tap: "Vanillify" lists every recommended change with a checkbox, with the safe ones pre-selected. You review, then apply.
* History: every change is recorded and can be undone, one at a time or several together.
Apps are removed for your user only (pm uninstall --user 0): nothing on the system partition changes, so a removed app can always come back. A factory reset restores everything.
Permissions:
* Shizuku (required to make changes): runs the same commands adb would. Browsing the app lists works without it.
* Query all packages: to list every app with its name and icon.
* Start at boot and notifications: to put your blocks back after a restart, or tell you Shizuku needs starting.
Vanillify has no internet permission: it cannot send anything anywhere. No ads, no analytics, no accounts.
App ratings come from the Universal Android Debloater Next Generation community list (GPL-3.0). Free software under the GNU GPL v3.

fedora-packages:compat-flex/compat-flex.description: This is legacy version of flex, a program that generates scanners. Scanners are programs which can recognize lexical patterns in text. Flex takes pairs of regular expressions and C code as input and generates a C source file as output. The output file is compiled and linked with a library to produce an executable. The executable searches through its input for occurrences of the regular expressions. When a match is found, it executes the corresponding C code. Flex was designed to work with both Yacc and Bison, and is used by many programs as part of their build process. You should install flex if you are going to use your system for application development.

The emphasis is on returning accurate results with errors close to round-off (about 5–15 nanometers). New accurate algorithms for Geodesics on an ellipsoid of revolution and Transverse Mercator projection have been developed for this library. The functionality of the library can be accessed from user code, from the Utility programs provided, or via the Implementations in other languages.

firefox-addons:3000139.name: Vallanx Privacy Shield
firefox-addons:3000139.summary: Vallanx Privacy Shield is a browser extension that blocks trackers, protects your browser fingerprint, and gives you full control over what websites can do.
firefox-addons:3000139.description:
Vallanx Privacy Shield is a browser extension that blocks trackers, protects your browser fingerprint, and gives you full control over what websites can do.
Features Overview of Current Version
 Ad & Tracker Blocking — UBS (Universal Blocklist Syntax) parser with support for domain rules, wildcards, AdBlock-style ||domain^ patterns, allowlists ( @@ ), and $ -modifiers
 Anti-Fingerprinting — Canvas noise, AudioContext noise, randomized navigator properties (hardwareConcurrency, deviceMemory, platform), screen depth, and WebGL vendor masking
 Privacy Headers — Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control, custom User-Agent, custom X-Forwarded-For header
 Geolocation Spoofing — Override getCurrentPosition and watchPosition with configurable coordinates
 Content Controls — Block JavaScript (global or per site), pop-ups, media elements above a size threshold, external fonts, prefetch, and hyperlink auditing
 Cosmetic Rules — Element hiding via ##selector UBS rules, applied in-page with a MutationObserver
 Proxy Support — Configure a fixed HTTP/SOCKS proxy with optional authentication
 Parental Controls — Time-based browsing restrictions using server time ( worldtimeapi.org ) with local time fallback
 Per-Site Overrides — Toggle JS blocking and popup blocking individually per hostname from the popup
 Network Log — Ring buffer (last 200 entries) of blocked/allowed requests, visible in the dashboard
 Statistics — Blocked request count, bandwidth saved (MB), and estimated time saved
 Export / Import — Save and restore all settings as JSON
 Dark / Light / Auto Theme — Follows system preference or manual override
 Localization — Currently supporting 12 differente languages built in; extensible to further locales. Default is English (EN)

firefox-addons:2979107.name: YouTube Dubbing & Translate - AutoDub
firefox-addons:2979107.summary: Translate & dub any YouTube video with AI in one click: press play and understand it instantly. All of YouTube, in your language.
firefox-addons:2979107.description:
AutoDub is a free Chrome extension that translates YouTube videos and dubs them with an AI voice as they play. You hear the video in your own language instead of reading subtitles, and the translated subtitles still show on screen if you want to read along.
★ Free. No daily video limit and no paywall. You do need to sign in with email or Google, which is how we keep bots from burning through the service.
How it works
 Install AutoDub and open a YouTube video.
 Click the AutoDub button in the player controls, then pick your language.
 Press play.
Features
 One-click translate & dub — the AutoDub button sits right in YouTube's player controls; press play and dubbing starts
 Automatic source language detection. You only choose the language you want to hear, never the one the video is in.
 Neural AI voices you can listen to for two hours straight, which is the whole point of a lecture or a podcast.
 Choose your voice: male and female options for every language, 50+ voices in all. English comes in US and UK accents.
 Translation happens while the video plays. A video that has been dubbed before starts right away.
 Dubbing that stays in sync through pausing, seeking and 2x playback.
 Voice speed from 0.5x to 2x, set separately from the video speed.
 Translated subtitles on screen. Leave YouTube's own captions on and you get both languages at once.
 Original audio stays under your control: keep it as it is, or have AutoDub lower it while the voice speaks.
 Chrome, Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers. There is a Firefox build on Firefox Add-ons.
Dub YouTube into 22 languages:
English · Spanish (Español) · Portuguese (Português) · French (Français) · German (Deutsch) · Italian (Italiano) · Dutch (Nederlands) · Polish (Polski) · Swedish (Svenska) · Danish (Dansk) · Norwegian (Norsk) · Finnish (Suomi) · Russian (Русский) · Turkish (Türkçe) · Arabic (العربية) · Hindi (हिन्दी) · Thai (ไทย) · Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt) · Japanese (日本語) · Korean (한국어) · Chinese Simplified (简体中文) · Chinese Traditional (繁體中文)
Good for
 Lectures, online courses and coding tutorials, where you need your eyes on the slides or the code rather than on a subtitle line.
 Long interviews and podcasts.
 Documentaries, news and video essays.
 Creators, travel and gaming videos from countries whose language you don't read.
 Anything you watch while cooking, commuting or fixing something, when you're only half looking at the screen.
 Language practice. Listen in your language and read the original captions, or do it the other way round.
Website: https://autodub.net

bluejetty:00046338:ios.summary:

The Opioid Epidemic is a systemic problem - millions of Americans are physically dependent
bluejetty:00046338:ios.description:
Bicycle Health is a digital health start-up that offers online Medication for Addiction Treatment (MAT) for individuals with Opioid Use Disorder. 
The Opioid Epidemic is a systemic problem - millions of Americans are physically dependent on Opioids but only 10% of Americans have access to treatment. Bicycle Health is addressing this gap by offering personalized, affordable, and confidential treatment with the goal of helping individuals take back control of their lives. 
What we provide
Medication Management: A licensed provider will perform a via video call assessment and prescribe Buprenorphine - Naloxone, if appropriate and help taper it down over time. 
Counseling: Patients often have co-occurring depression, anxiety, trauma, etc. Our mental health providers have 1-1 video calls with patients to support their behavioral health needs.
Support Groups: Our free Support Groups offer a platform for patients to share their journeys with others, support others, and reflect on ways to achieve emotional growth.
Care Coordination: Through constant communication, our health coaches help patients navigate treatment and life changes as a partner, mentor, and support system.
Our Difference:
We don’t take a ‘one size fits all’ approach. Our philosophy is centered around harm reduction - we cater care plans to meet each patient at their point of need.
Same day appointments. Patients can start our program as soon as they are ready. 
We outreach to your patients. Just call, text, or email us if a patient or someone you know is in need of treatment. We will take care of the rest.
Easy access. Patients can reach their doctor anytime, anywhere via text, chat, email, video, or phone and get a response within minutes.
Affordable care. We accept United, Medicare, Cigna, Aetna, and Blue Shield of California (PPO). We also offer a self pay rate of $199/month.
Progress and Outcomes: We have been live since Jan 2019, with positive outcomes:
-2,000+ patients served across the U.S. We are launching in new states weekly - check with us to see if we are available in your region!
-85% abstinence in drug use
-60% improvement in motivation, depression, and patient stress.
Our Technology: 
The Bicycle Health mobile application is the primary treatment portal for our patients. Our patients can use our application to conduct video visits with their provider, view and reschedule upcoming appointments, view prescriptions and request refills, access treatment documents, submit toxicology screens, modify billing preferences, and communicate with our care team via secure messaging. 
For more information and patient resources, please visit our website at: https://www.bicyclehealth.com/
NOTE: Our application on its own is not intended to provide medical advice; rather, it is designed to communicate the guidance of your medical provider. Please always follow the direction of your medical provider before making medical decisions.

bluejetty:00023323:ios.description:
Welcome to the chilling world of Skybound's The Walking Dead, now brought to life in our latest game - The Walking Dead: All-Stars AFK Idle RPG. Get ready for a special mix of team battle RPG and idle gameplay, all set in the Walker-infested universe of The Walking Dead.
Embark on an exhilarating AFK adventure through iconic locations from the series, journeying through the dead city of New York to the abandoned streets of Seoul, and discover secrets hidden in this enticing AFK RPG. Brace yourself for an unrivaled AFK gaming experience where your strategic choices decide the survival of your team of survivors amid the persistent Walker threat in the dead cities.
RPG Game Features:
■ BUILD YOUR SURVIVORS TEAM
Collect and power up a unique group of survivors, including favorite characters like Carl, Rick, Michonne, and Negan. Train and upgrade your survivors, preparing them for the relentless AFK battle against the undead in the dead cities.
■ IDLE & STRATEGY GAMEPLAY
Even when you're not active, your team of survivors keeps battling! Arrange your team's AFK formation and strategies, then watch as they crush the Walker hordes. Return at your convenience to claim your rewards, level up your survivors, and plan your strategy for the next idle combat.
■ DIVE INTO THE TWD STORY
Relive the tension, bravery, and drama of the original comic series. Journey through numerous chapters of the gripping storyline where your choices influence the course of your AFK adventure.
■ COMPETITIVE AFK PVP BATTLES
Pit your survivors against players worldwide in the AFK PVP Arena. Show off your team's might, climb the leaderboard, and earn exclusive idle rewards.
■ IDLE CO-OP & GUILD SYSTEM
Join hands with friends and other players to create powerful communities. Pool resources, strategize together, and tackle the undead world as a team in dead cities. Take part in Community Total Wars and Co-op missions for ultimate survival and dominance.

bluejetty:00006995:android.summary:
METRO is the Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County, serving the Greater Houston, Texas region with safe, clean, reliable, accessible and friendly public transportation services.
The official METRO Q Ticketing app allows you to pu
bluejetty:00006995:android.description:
METRO is the Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County, serving the Greater Houston, Texas region with safe, clean, reliable, accessible and friendly public transportation services.
The official METRO Q Ticketing app allows you to purchase:
• Single ride tickets for local bus and rail
• METRO day pass for local bus and rail
• Park & Ride tickets (full fare only)
You can make purchases with a credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Tickets are then available for immediate activation and use.
COMMON QUESTIONS:
Q: Do I need to be connected to the internet?
A: Ticket purchases require a cellular network or wireless connection. However, you can activate and use tickets offline.
Q: How quickly are ticket purchases processed? 
A: Once the payment is authorized, your purchase is processed immediately and your ticket is then available for immediate activation.
Q: Can I purchase multiple fares at the same time? 
A: You can purchase and activate multiple tickets for multiple passengers. Up to 30 tickets may be purchased at one time. You can purchase up to $50 in tickets per day.
Q: How long are tickets valid?
A: Individual bus or rail tickets can be saved and used for up to 2 years from the original purchase date.
Q: How can I plan a trip?
A: The METRO Q Ticketing app contains a link to our METRO TRIP app which provides routes, schedules and real-time arrival information so you can quickly and easily plan your trip.
Q: What if my battery dies?
A: You must be able to show an activated ticket to either a bus operator (prior to boarding a bus) or a fare inspector (prior to boarding METRORail).
Additional questions and answers are accessible from the app.
Compatibility:
• Android phones running an OS of 5.0 and above. Up to 2 versions behind will be supported.
For assistance, please contact METRO Customer Service at 713-635-4000 or visit the website at RideMETRO.org

bluejetty:00078649:ios.name: Flying Ruler: 3D Tape Measure
bluejetty:00078649:ios.summary:
The Flying Ruler app allows you to measure in the most original way: by just moving your device from one point to another.
Flying Ruler is a ruler, tape measure, rangefinder, protractor and a 3D angle finder. It is five devices in one app,
bluejetty:00078649:ios.description:
The Flying Ruler app allows you to measure in the most original way: by just moving your device from one point to another.
Flying Ruler is a ruler, tape measure, rangefinder, protractor and a 3D angle finder. It is five devices in one app, providing you with the quickest way to measure a distance or an angle.
The secret of the program is that it is based on the principles of the inertial navigational system (INS): the position of the device is determined with the help of the accelerometer and the gyroscope.
Measurements take place extremely quickly and at the same time they are quite accurate. We are constantly improving our computational algorithm for more than 11 years!
To try this technology for free you can install the app "Digital Angle Finder: 3D Meter". This free app measures the angle as you move the device.
AWARDS:
Editor's Choice — 148Apps
www.148apps.com/reviews/flying-ruler-review
PRESS ABOUT US:
"I was impressed with Flying Ruler’s accuracy. It works quickly and effectively", "It’s the perfect addition to anyone’s app collection" — 148apps 4.5 / 5 (MUST HAVE)
"This thing is awesome" — brettterpstra.com
"I literally said “wow!” when I first used this app and I think it’s a truly impressive marvel of mobile technology", "The Flying Ruler Rules" — AppPicker (Cons: there is nothing negative to say about this app)
*** Measure distance with good precision, no matter the lighting or conditions ***
The app has different modes so you can choose which mode is better and easier to use on each occasion. You can measure with the body of the device in one mode or with a virtual tape measure in another. You can not only measure an object but also the distance between two walls (rangefinder mode). You use the same methods to measure angles as the app allows you to measure angles both on a surface area (protractor mode) and between surfaces through space (3D angle finder mode).
You can choose either inches or centimeters. The maximum distance is only limited by the value of the indicator which consists of 999 ft for the imperial system and 99 m for the metric system.
When measuring, you can avoid obstacles and therefore you can measure anything.
Flying Ruler is suitable for measuring not only large, but also very small distances with the accuracy of a standard ruler.
The app also allows you to save a measurement by taking a photograph of the measurement and mark the place that was measured.
Don’t forget to show your friends and colleagues how the app works – believe us, they will be impressed.
ACCURACY OF MEASUREMENT:
We took 100 consecutive measurements and got these results:
On iPhone 13:
• Mean squared error - 0.14%
• Maximum inaccuracy - 0.4%
On iPhone 7:
• Mean squared error - 0.15%
• Maximum inaccuracy - 0.4%
On iPhone 6s:
• Mean squared error - 0.28%
• Maximum inaccuracy - 1.1%
The accuracy of measurements depends on the device, however the error rarely exceeds 1.5%. You can always increase accuracy by making a series of measurements. If you make a series of measurements, the degree of error is usually 0.3% or less.
Angles can be measured with the app to an accuracy of one degree so the app can easily take the place of a protractor or a angle finder.
WEBSITE:
www.flying-ruler.com

■ランキング戦
テクニック、スピード、運が試される2種類のランキング戦、「サバイバル対局」と「テクニカル対局」を導入しました。
全国のプレイヤーたちと競い合って全国1位を目指してください！
■フリー対局
最初はレベル1の雀荘しかオープンしていませんが、特定条件を満たしていくことで、上のレベルの雀荘が
解放されます。このモードでは、お好みの雀荘で、お好みのルール設定で自由に対局を行うことができます。
■最新麻雀AI
機械学習により鍛えられた最新の麻雀AIを搭載。強さだけでなく、打ち筋やクセの異なる30人のAIキャラたちがあなたを雀荘でお待ちしております。
■戦績の記録
アガリ傾向やアガリ役の達成回数などの戦績は保存されます。
さらには対戦相手選択画面では、それぞれの雀荘での対戦戦績を確認することが出来ます。
■フルオープンモード搭載
もちろんイカサマ、牌の操作などはいっさいありません。フリー対局のフルオープンモードでは、

・牌/卓の変更
・BGM、効果音のON/OFF設定
・縦画面/横画面　
・画面の向きの固定

・原点設定（25000～30000点）
・半荘戦、東風戦
・裏ドラ、カンドラ、カン裏ドラ
・赤牌（５萬×１、５筒×１、５索×１）
・喰いタン
・一発
・ドボン
・ウマ（5点、10点）
・連チャン条件（テンパイ、和了）
・和了ヤメ
・二翻縛り
・喰い変え
●その他のルール説明
・リーチをかける場合は手持ち１０００点以上が必要。
・オープンリーチなし
・鳴き、アガリの優先順位はロン＞ポン・カン＞チー
・暗カンのドラは即ノリする。明カンのドラは即ノリしない。
・暗カンにチャンカンは該当しない。ただし、国士無双のみ、暗カン時の槍カンを認める。
・明カンの嶺上開花でアガった時はツモアガリ。
・5本場以降、二飜縛り。
・後付けあり
・平和のメンゼンツモは、２０符で計算。喰い平和型の栄和は、３０符で計算。
・人和は役満扱い。
・地和はチー、ポン、カンのない第一ツモでアガった場合に限る。
・複数の役満の複合を認める（例えば、天和・字一色・大四喜・四暗刻単騎待ちは、５倍役満）
・三連刻、四連刻、十三不塔はなし。
・流し満貫あり。捨て牌に喰いが入ると無効。流局時に成立。アガリ扱いで他家の手スパイオープンもなし。
・途中流局あり。四風子連打、四開カン、四人リーチ、九種九牌が対象。トリプルロンは対象外。
・ダブロン・トリプルロンあり。
・パオあり。大三元、大四喜、四カン子に適用。ツモアガリで完全責任払い、別の放銃者の場合は折半。
・オーラス流局時のリーチ棒、罰符棒はトップに渡される。
・西入りはありません

プレミアムメンバーは月額課金が発生する定期購読コンテンツとなります。

bluejetty:00080860:ios.name: Screw Away: 3D Pin Puzzle
bluejetty:00080860:ios.summary: "Screw Away: 3D Pin Puzzle" is a highly rewarding and challenging game designed for players who enjoy brain teasing and testing their finger dexterity. The game revolves around screwing in pins of various shapes and sizes within a specified
bluejetty:00080860:ios.description:
"Screw Away: 3D Pin Puzzle" is a highly rewarding and challenging game designed for players who enjoy brain teasing and testing their finger dexterity. The game revolves around screwing in pins of various shapes and sizes within a specified time, aiming to minimize errors .
It not only tests your reaction speed and hand-eye coordination but also challenges your spatial awareness and fine motor skills through each level's design . As the game progresses, levels become increasingly complex, demanding quicker decision-making to achieve the goal of screwing in all pins .
The game offers various challenge modes and difficulty options for players to tackle according to their skills. By unlocking achievements and aiming for high scores , you can compare your performance and compete with friends, enhancing the game's social interaction and long-term appeal .
"Screw Away: 3D Pin Puzzle" excels with its simple yet addictive gameplay concept, smooth controls, and immersive 3D environments that make you feel like you're in a real mechanical challenge . Whether you want to unwind casually or push your limits, this game caters to your needs and offers unparalleled gaming enjoyment and a sense of achievement!

bluejetty:00161182:ios.description:
Speakey is an innovative English learning app that helps users quickly improve their English speaking abilities through advanced AI technology.
Whether you are a beginner or have some existing knowledge, Speakey provides personalized speaking practice services for you. No more worries about finding a practice partner or expensive tuition fees; Speakey allows you to speak English confidently and stress-free.
By practicing hundreds of real-life scenarios, you will master spoken English better and be able to use English more fluently in real-life situations.
Every speaking practice session in Speakey will guide you to practice commonly used words, phrases, and expressions in various scenarios, allowing you to apply English more fluently in real-life situations. At the same time, the AI will provide real-time analysis of your sentences, pointing out potential grammar errors and suggesting more natural expressions to help you continuously improve your English speaking abilities.
The AI will provide immediate comprehensive analysis and feedback on every aspect of your spoken sentences, specifically:
- Whether the grammar is correct.
- Whether the choice of words and sentence structure is idiomatic.
- Whether the language is appropriate.
No matter what level your English is currently at, you can gain new insights and improve your proficiency through practice with AI.
Speakey also includes a collection of rich English e-books, which you can listen to or read to improve your reading skills. Encountering unfamiliar words? No worries, the AI will help you quickly obtain the pronunciation and meaning.
Whether you want to practice English anytime and anywhere, or improve your speaking abilities, Speakey is your best choice. 
Download Speakey and unlock the key skills of English speaking!
You need a subscription to fully access all courses and features.

Unless you change the subscription preferences in your iTunes account settings, your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle.

If a free trial period is provided, any unused portion will be forfeited when purchasing a Speakey subscription.

Lingualeo is the ultimate language-learning app — making learning English, Chinese, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese and more languages fun, interactive, and effective.

1. Interactive Lessons and Exercises
Read books, watch videos, and explore articles in their original language. Tap unknown words to translate and save them — expand your vocabulary naturally and in context.
Our AI also helps you find content that matches your current level.
2. Leo Chat — your personal language practice buddy
Discuss any topic. 
Easy translate and save new words. 
The chat actively uses words from your dictionary in conversations, so you can memorize them faster and learn to use fluently in practice.
3. Thematic and Grammar Courses
Learn with engaging clips, dialogues, and scenes from popular content. 
Improve your pronunciation, listening, and speaking skills with dynamically adaptive AI-powered exercises.
4. Games and Challenges
Play interactive mini-games, test your skills, and compete with other learners. 
Gamified exercises make learning fun and highly effective.
5. Personalized Progress Tracking
Track your progress in writing, listening, speaking, and vocabulary. 
Focus on the skills that matter most to you. Leo shows your achievements and suggests the best next steps.
6. Flexible Learning
Learn anytime, anywhere — even 5 minutes a day makes a difference. 
Lingualeo adapts to your level and pace, making it perfect for both kids and adults.
Join millions of learners worldwide and turn language learning into an exciting adventure — develop new skills, explore cultures, and learn with fun thanks to Lingualeo!
Lingualeo Premium

bluejetty:00069320:ios.name: Christmas Match 3 Games
bluejetty:00069320:ios.summary: Christmas Match 3 is a totally amazing puzzle game based on a very popular match-3 game. Swap, drag and sweep the cute Christmas pieces, like the Christmas tree, Santa's hat, Christmas bells and baubles, gingerbread man, and ice crystals. M
bluejetty:00069320:ios.description:
Christmas Match 3 is a totally amazing puzzle game based on a very popular match-3 game. Swap, drag and sweep the cute Christmas pieces, like the Christmas tree, Santa's hat, Christmas bells and baubles, gingerbread man, and ice crystals. Make matches of 4 or 5 to create powerful bombs and power-ups.
Features:
- More than 500 levels of puzzles
- Eye-catching graphics and colorful gameplay.
- Friendly and fascinating characters.
- Unique obstacles and fun puzzles
- No time limit
- Play anywhere and anytime
- Updates come out all the time
- Easy and fun to play, but a challenge to fully master.
How to play:
• Swipe a piece to create a row of three or more of the same pieces.
• Match 4 pieces to get a striped bomb of this color and create a line blast.
• Match 5 beautiful flowers in an L or T form to get a bomb that will explode surrounding items.
• Match 5 pieces in a row to get a Color Bomb. It looks like the simple piece, but it is sparking. This bomb crushes pieces with the same color.
• Match 7 pieces in T form to get a Rainbow Heart. This is uncolored bomb that create a chain reaction of destroying pieces.
• Match 4 beautiful pieces in a square to get a ladybird that searches for the most attractive piece and destroys it.
• Use some better strategies to get more points. Mix two bombs can bring a special effect.
• After you fulfill all the requirements at a game level, you can move on to the next level.
• Finish the level with the least move possible to get higher scores and more candy stars.

bluejetty:00171185:ios.description:
About this app
Your smarter way to move around the city.
 ConnectSmart Mobility is your all-in-one travel companion designed to help you save time, save money, and discover the best ways to get around. Whether you’re driving, carpooling, or taking transit, we’ve got you covered with real-time updates and tools to optimize your journey—plus rewards when you pick green travel options.
Why ConnectSmart Mobility?
- Drive Smarter: Use your fav navigation app, or our optimized navigation that comes with real-time live traffic, road conditions, parking options and Appley CarPlay and Google Auto support. .
- Transit Made Easy: Find the best routes, compare options, and improve your trip with accurate travel times.
- Carpool with Confidence: Connect with family, friends, and coworkers to share trips, cut costs, and reduce stress.
- Go Green, Get Rewards: Earn great rewards for choosing sustainable modes like transit, biking, walking, and carpooling.
- Drive with Peace of Mind: ConnectSmart Mobility provides real-time alerts for road closures, accidents, and even flooding, plus special School Zone warnings and optional roadside assistance in select cities to keep your journey safe and stress-free.
Tailored for Your Commute
Your travel isn’t one-size-fits-all—and neither is ConnectSmart Mobility. Whether you want to shave minutes off your drive, find the fastest bus, split a ride with a coworker, carpool regularly, or earn rewards for going green, the app adapts to your needs.
Every Transportation Option in One App
Why juggle multiple apps when you can have everything in one? With ConnectSmart Mobility, you’ll:
- Get live traffic and road updates
- Plan, share, and manage carpool trips
- Optimize your daily commute or next trip
- Get rewarded when you choose greener ways to travel
ConnectSmart Mobility helps you travel smarter, stress less, carpool more, and make every trip more rewarding.

bluejetty:00074176:ios.description:
Want a free and easy to use A-Z guide to crystals and minerals packed with geological and metaphysical information for over 500 crystals, plus crystal quizzes and games? Meet the crystal app created by collectors, for collectors!
All the A - Z crystal information is, and will always remain, totally FREE! You can choose to upgrade for a small, one time fee, and unlock a huge amount more with our latest update, including the ability to photograph, catalogue, tag and organise your own collection, explore an interactive crystal world map, use interactive 3D models to learn about crystal systems and growth formations, a whole series of Quick Reference Guides covering both geological and metaphysical for on the go, plus a Moon Calendar explaining the different phase of the moon and the different special full moons each month.
We're the husband and wife team who founded and run The Citrine Circle and we built this reference guide app to help people keep track of their collection, and to learn more about the amazing world of crystals and minerals that keeps us loving going to work each day. We both have a passion for crystals, and education, so we'll keep on updating with new crystals, but if anyone notices anything missing, please let us know. We're only the two of us, we don't have a research team working for us, but we'll keep on working hard to keep the guide as full and up to date as possible!
Browse through the crystals by name or image gallery using either the artwork or real photos, search for different crystals by country, or use the extensive filters to hone down your search further. Want a blue crystal that corresponds to the Throat Chakra and aids meditation? No problem! Looking for a green crystal from South America with a vitreous lustre? We can show you loads! Looking to learn about a random new crystal? Use the dice button to pick one at random!

bluejetty:00086433:ios.summary: Welcome to the most fire neighborhood around! My Talking Tom Friends 2 brings together all your favorite friends for a next level virtual pet adventure. Talking Tom, Angela, Hank, Ben, and Becca have all moved into a fun filled new town, an
bluejetty:00086433:ios.description:
Welcome to the most fire neighborhood around! My Talking Tom Friends 2 brings together all your favorite friends for a next level virtual pet adventure. Talking Tom, Angela, Hank, Ben, and Becca have all moved into a fun filled new town, and they’re ready to share their world with you. Get to know each character’s unique style, visit their homes, and enjoy endless games and laughter in this vibrant Talking Tom and Friends experience.
Game Features:
Care & Bonding: Take care of Tom and his friends by feeding them, bathing them, and keeping them happy. Play with each pet – toss a ball, give a hug, or play music. They even talk now with their own voices, joking and reacting to make every interaction extra delightful!
Explore & Decorate: Stroll through a lively neighborhood with lots to discover. Each friend has a home you can visit and style them your way. Design Tom’s music loft, Angela’s art studio, Hank’s comfy cabin, Ben’s gadget garage, and Becca’s VR room with hundreds of cool decorations. You can also visit the local food market, clothes shop, or park for more adventures and surprises around town.
Fun & Mini-Games: Find a great set of mini games and activities at every corner! Shoot hoops at the basketball court, race cars (or lawnmowers if that’s your thing), splash some color with spray paint art, craft and fly paper airplanes, play soccer, and much more. There’s always a new game or challenge to master.
Fashion & Style: Dress your friends in the trendiest outfits and let their personalities shine. From funky costumes to cute accessories, there are tons of clothes to mix and match. Give Angela stylish makeovers, put Hank in a funny hat, or try out cool looks for Tom. You’re the stylist – express your creativity!
Cool gadgets & toys: Play with fun gadgets and toys around town. Fly a drone, launch paper planes, test Ben’s inventions, and more. Every friend has unique hobbies – try them and get to know them like never before.
Rewards & Surprises: Daily rewards await. Earn coins and bonuses as you play, and unlock new items, clothes, and decorations to make the game even more exciting. Keep an eye out for special events, gifts, and something new’s always happening in the world of Talking Tom and Friends.
Meet the Gang:
Tom is the playful leader who loves adventures and music. Angela is the creative soul with a flair for fashion. Hank is the chill guy who lives for food and fun. Ben is the genius inventor, always tinkering with a new gadget. And Becca is the bold one, who adds a spark of adrenaline rush to the group. Each friend has a big personality and they all need you to help them live their best lives!
Talking Tom Friends 2: Every day brings fresh adventures and playful moments where fun and endless possibilities await. Experience friendship with Talking Tom, Angela, Hank, Ben, and Becca like never before. Take care of your favorite virtual pets, personalize their houses, and dive into a world full of exciting activities. Ideal for fans of virtual pet sims and anyone seeking exploration and creativity in one game.
From Outfit7, creators of My Talking Tom Friends, My Talking Tom 2, and My Talking Angela 2.
This app contains:
- Promotion of Outfit7's products and advertising;
- Links that direct customers to Outfit7’s websites and other apps;
- Personalization of content to encourage users to play the app again;
- The option to make in-app purchases;
- Items to purchase (available in different prices) using virtual currency, depending on the player’s progress;
- Alternative options to access all functionalities of the app without making any in-app purchases using real money.
Terms of use: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/eula/en/ 
Privacy policy for games: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/privacy-policy-games/en 
Customer support: support@outfit7.com

bluejetty:00032987:ios.description:
Visory Security is a CCTV camera on mobile for incredible home protection or pet care. Use it as your pet monitor, and even CCTV camera recorder or video camera for your cam security system. To use it as a video dog monitor for live streams, you need to link together at least two devices (smartphones or tablets) – one for capturing a video and one for watching it. 
A wide range of applications: 
- monitor your pet when you leave them alone 
- perfect for using as a WiFi kids monitor 
- know what is going on in the room when you are not there 
- arrange a smart security and alert system: the intruder will not slip unnoticed 
General features: Compatible with many mobile devices, you can link together an iPhone and any smartphone easily. 
Quick setup via QR code 
To link two devices together you need to do as little as scan a QR code. 
Support two and more live streams simultaneously
Need to arrange a security camera and video dog monitor sessions simultaneously? With this app, you can do it easily. 
Need to arrange more surveillance sessions? The app is at your help. 
Impeccable user security and confidentiality 
This home security surveillance and monitoring app provides a secured connection and does not collect any user data. 
Add as many devices as you need for free. 
Rich features for incredible home protection and pet care (coming soon): 
- Night video camera Arrange overnight surveillance sessions. Or just keep your eye on what is going on in the darkroom to control and stay tuned. 
- Sound and motion detection Nothing will be left unnoticed. Get an instant alert as the system detects any sound or motion. Kids cry and bark detection The app detects kids cry and barking and send you an instant alert. Perfect for using as a pet monitor or nanny cam app. 
- Human detection Enhance your home IP cam security system with a human detection feature and get only useful alerts. The app distinguishes a human being from other objects – dogs, cats, etc. Get an instant alert as the system detects a human being in the room. Perfect for using as a home security app. 
- Cloud storage. All recordings are auto-saved to the cloud.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00159353:ios.description:
Nora is your anonymous AI designed for mental health therapy. Whether you're navigating depression, anxiety or trauma - Nora offers a private, judgment-free space to speak freely, right now. Nora is built to grow with you, learning your patterns and helping you develop the emotional clarity and resilience you deserve.
How Nora is built
Nora is designed with deep empathy and understanding, trained on evidence-based therapeutic principles and refined by mental health professionals that honor the complexity of human emotion. Use Nora for processing difficult emotions, building coping strategies, gaining clarity, working through patterns, or simply having a safe space to express yourself.
What People Are Experiencing with Nora
The early response has been deeply moving. Users who connect with Nora regularly are finding:
 • 93% Of users feel more optimistic about their future after 5 average sessions
 • 82% report feeling better equipped to handle daily stress
 • 78% say they've developed a more compassionate inner voice
*Based on early user experiences
What Makes Nora Different ?
True anonymity and privacy! Create a simple username—no real name, no phone number, no personal details required. Share your deepest thoughts knowing your identity stays completely protected. Nora supports you without ever knowing who you are.
Subscription Options:

Monthly: $9.99

Important Disclaimers
Nora is not a replacement for medical diagnosis or treatment and cannot provide medical advice. Nora is designed for users 18+. If you are in crisis, please seek professional help or contact a crisis line immediately. You can find resources at www.findahelpline.com.

bluejetty:00039187:ios.description:
You are staring at a message, wondering how to reply without sounding boring or desperate. VIBE gives you the words to keep the conversation moving, build attraction, and smoothly transition from texting to a date. 120,000 people have joined VIBE, and the app has generated over 7,000,000 reply suggestions to help keep chats alive.
GET CONTEXTUAL SUGGESTIONS
Upload a screenshot of a chat, a dating profile, or a social media story. You can also just type out the situation. VIBE reads the context and offers replies you can actually use. You always review the options and choose what to send.
PICK YOUR VIBE
Choose between four distinct styles: Spicy, Cocky, Direct, or Roast. You have full control over the length of the text, the balance of logic and humor, and exactly how you want your punctuation and capitalization to look.
UNDERSTAND THE CONVERSATION
VIBE analyzes specific messages to show you what worked, where the interaction slowed down, and what you can do next to improve. You get actionable advice to grow your communication skills. Get a normal review or a roast of your messaging style.
CHECK THE INTEREST TREND
See an AI estimate of the conversation dynamics. VIBE helps you understand who is taking the initiative, highlights important signals, and gives you a suggested next move based on the flow of your chat.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR CONTACTS
Organize your chats by person. You can save important details and maintain context across different conversations to keep names and past conversations in one place.
PLAN THE ACTUAL DATE
When it is time to meet, VIBE helps you plan a memorable date. Get venue suggestions, a route, ideas for what to do, and topics to talk about based on your budget and location preferences. View locations on a map and add the plan straight to your calendar.
Set up a VIBE shortcut in Apple Shortcuts to get reply suggestions while chatting in another messaging app.
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PURCHASES
An active subscription is required to generate replies. Some additional features require separate in-app purchases. The price, subscription period, and included features are shown before payment. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. Manage your subscription and turn off renewal in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.vibe.dating/privacy
Support: https://t.me/vibedating_support

PhotoWidget makes it effortless to decorate your iPhone and iPad.
Not just useful widgets — you can also change stylish app icons in one go and create stunning AI-generated wallpapers.

Key Features:
【All-in-One Home & Lock Screen Customization】
The easiest way to personalize your iPhone and iPad.
Set wallpapers, widgets, and app icons all at once — from minimal and aesthetic to cute, trendy, or elegant.
【Stylish Widgets】
Choose from a wide range of functional and beautiful widgets:
● Home Screen:
PhotoWidget / D-Day (Countdown) / Quotes / Zodiac / Shortcut / Battery / Calendar / Clock / Memo / To-Do List / Phost (Random Postcards)
● Lock Screen:
Animated / Inline / Shortcut / PhotoWidget / Battery / Calendar / Memo / D-Day / Quotes / Zodiac
Compatible with iOS 16, 17, 18, and 26.
【NEW! Quotes Widget – Daily Inspiration】
Start every day with motivation and mindfulness.
● Display daily quotes, motivational sayings, or your own custom text
● Customize fonts, colors, and borders to match your aesthetic
● Typography styles — serif, handwritten, modern, minimal, and more
● Perfect for self-care, study motivation, and aesthetic home screens
【Smart D-Day Widget – Countdown, Reminders & Date Calculator】
The ultimate countdown widget for every important moment:
● Count down to birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, exams, trips, concerts, or comebacks
● Push notifications & reminders — never miss a special day again
● Built-in date calculator — calculate days between dates or track days passed
● Display on both Home and Lock Screens
【Customization Tools – Fonts, Borders & More】
Make every widget truly yours:
● Wide selection of fonts — cute, aesthetic, handwritten, bold, minimal
● Stylish borders, frames, and background options
● Adjustable colors, opacity, and layouts
● Photo filters and effects for a polished look
【Themes & App Icons】
Apply complete themes — wallpaper, widgets, and app icons — with just one tap.
Decorate with your favorite photos, K-pop idols, anime characters, pets, quotes, and more.
【Wallpapers & AI Wallpaper Generator】
Create your own wallpapers using our templates:
● Polaroid-style layouts
● Heart-shaped collages
● Cute, cool, or anime-inspired designs
Generate one-of-a-kind backgrounds instantly with our AI wallpaper feature.
Your creativity, your screen.
【iPad & Apple Watch Support】
Full support for iPad Home & Lock Screen widgets (4 home sizes, 3 lock sizes) and Apple Watch faces.
【Constant Updates】
Discover new themes, wallpapers, widget styles, fonts, and quote collections every week.
Premium Subscription
Unlock all premium content and enjoy an ad-free experience with PhotoWidget Premium. Available in monthly and yearly options.
Subscription Details:

Name: PhotoWidget Premium
Duration: 1 month or 1 year (auto-renew)
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscription auto-renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the period.
Manage or cancel anytime in your iTunes Account settings.

* Terms of Use: https://photowidget.net/en/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://photowidget.net/en/privacy

【Latest News】
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ios.photowidget
Twitter (X): https://twitter.com/photowidget_ios
Partnership inquiries: contact@photowidget.net

bluejetty:00030846:android.name: Hi-Tech Live Wallpaper 4k
bluejetty:00030846:android.summary: Transform your phone into a high-tech battleground with HiTech Live Wallpaper 4k, a personalization app built for fans of hi-tech aesthetics, futuristic design, and cybercore visuals. Set animated, 3D live wallpapers for your home screen an
bluejetty:00030846:android.description:
Transform your phone into a high-tech battleground with HiTech Live Wallpaper 4k, a personalization app built for fans of hi-tech aesthetics, futuristic design, and cybercore visuals. Set animated, 3D live wallpapers for your home screen and lock screen, then complete the look with matching keyboard themes, call screen animations, and ringtones.
Futuristic 3D live wallpapers in 4K style:
Bring motion and depth to your background with live wallpapers designed around modern sci-fi themes: hi-tech silhouettes, cyber armour plates, glowing circuits, neon energy, digital grids, and sleek metallic textures. Enjoy animated wallpaper effects that feel interactive, with smooth movement, parallax depth, and subtle touch reactions that make the scene respond as you use your phone. Choose looks that range from clean and modern to bold cyber aesthetic and intense tech vibes. Many backgrounds are rendered in HD and 4K-style detail (device-dependent), so your wallpaper can look crisp on modern screens.
3D, animated, and interactive effects:
This wallpaper app focuses on effects that stand out while staying usable every day. Expect moving wallpaper scenes, live wallpaper 3d depth, parallax live wallpaper motion, and layered lighting that gives your screen a realistic, futuristic feel. If you like cool wallpapers and animated wallpaper styles that look sharp and modern, this collection is designed to match your style. Pick a subtle animated background for daily use or a more dramatic 4k wallpaper live look when you want your phone to feel powerful and futuristic.
Matching themes for a complete setup: 
- Make your customization feel consistent across your phone.
- Home screen wallpaper and screen lock wallpaper with coordinated colors and textures.
- Keyboard themes that pair with your wallpaper theme, including futuristic backgrounds and tech-styled key designs.
- Keyboard fonts and styling options that fit cybercore and modern digital themes.
- Call screen animations and caller theme looks that match the same futuristic mood.
- Ringtones inspired by modern tech and high-energy sci-fi sounds to complete the experience.
Cybercore and hi-tech theme variety:
The main focus is hi-tech wallpapers and transforming effects, with related themes such as cyborg, mech, android, sci-fi, digital, modern, neon, hologram, tech armor, and futuristic city light patterns. Whether you want a sleek minimal wall background or a dramatic animated wallpaper with glowing energy lines, you can set a theme that reflects your personality, interests, or mood.
Everyday personalization, made simple:
Switch between live wallpapers and matching themes whenever you want a fresh look. Use the app as your go-to wallpaper changer for a new background that feels futuristic and unique. Great for broad audiences who enjoy live wallpapers, modern designs, and interactive effects, and want one place for wallpapers, keyboard themes, call screen style, and ringtones.

bluejetty:00148758:ios.description:
Your phone is your car's large screen.
Through your phone or tablet device, you can view the dashboard information of your vehicle at any time, including key information such as speed, battery level, mileage, current, motor speed, system temperature, real-time signals for acceleration and deceleration, and device fault signs.
One click vehicle fault diagnosis: If your vehicle malfunctions, just click on the vehicle self check page in the Weichuang application to see the fault information, which is convenient for targeted vehicle maintenance and troubleshooting.
One click anti-theft and locking the vehicle: thoughtful security protection, one click locking and parking the vehicle, resistance in pushing, difficulty in moving, and inability to turn on and ride in anti-theft locking state! With one click lock, you no longer have to worry about being stolen.
One click location to find a vehicle: Forgot where the vehicle is parked? Just click on the map interface in the Weichuang application to find the precise location of the vehicle.
One click navigation to the car: It's like having a private navigator on your phone. The Weichuang application can provide you with the best navigation route based on your location and the location of your vehicle, making it easy for you to find your vehicle.
Electronic fence vehicle control: like having a security guard by your side. You can set the activity range of the vehicle in the application, and once the vehicle leaves this range, the application will immediately remind you.
Vehicle performance settings: It's like having a professional technician guiding you. You can adjust the vehicle's performance settings, such as power distribution, acceleration response, brake sensitivity, etc., through the Weichuang application as needed to make your travel more comfortable.
Vehicle ambient light settings: In the application, you can set the color and status of the vehicle ambient light according to your personal preferences, creating a car that belongs only to you.
Electronic key sharing: When traveling with friends, you can share the electronic key with them, allowing them to use your car for limited time, which is both convenient and safe. The shared key will automatically expire after 12 hours without worrying about the security of the key.
Overall, the "Weichuang" application utilizes modern technology to provide comprehensive intelligent support for electric motorcycles, electric bicycles, and electric scooters, making your travel more convenient and safe.
Whether you are commuting or leisure entertainment, you can enjoy a more comfortable and safe travel experience through the Weichuang app.

bluejetty:00033041:ios.summary: Stressed out? Need a break from the daily grind? Look no further than Ragdoll Break: Kick Master, the ultimate stress relief game where you can unleash your pent-up frustration by breaking dolls in the most satisfying ways imaginable! Prepa
bluejetty:00033041:ios.description:
Stressed out? Need a break from the daily grind? Look no further than Ragdoll Break: Kick Master, the ultimate stress relief game where you can unleash your pent-up frustration by breaking dolls in the most satisfying ways imaginable! Prepare to kick, smash, and demolish your way to relaxation as you embark on a journey of cathartic destruction.
How to Play:
-Choose Your Doll: Select from a variety of ragdoll characters, each with their own unique features and personalities.
-Break Them All: Utilize a range of kicks, punches, and special moves to break the dolls into pieces. Swipe, tap, or hold to unleash your fury and watch the satisfying destruction unfold.
-Explore Creative Destruction: Experiment with different environments, props, and tools to discover new ways to annihilate the dolls. From explosive barrels to gravity-defying launches, the possibilities are endless.
-Unlock Achievements: Complete challenges and earn rewards as you progress through the game. Show off your mastery of destruction and collect all the achievements!
Game Features:
-Satisfying Physics: Experience realistic ragdoll physics as you send dolls flying with every kick and punch.
-Endless Variety: Discover countless ways to break the dolls using a wide range of tools, environments, and creative techniques.
-Intuitive Controls: Simple swipe and tap controls make it easy to unleash your destructive instincts with precision and finesse.
-Dynamic Environments: From bustling city streets to serene countryside settings, explore diverse environments filled with interactive elements and surprises.
-Unlockable Content: Collect coins and unlock new dolls, environments, and special abilities to enhance your destruction experience.
-Stress Relief: Channel your stress and frustration into a fun and satisfying gameplay experience that's guaranteed to leave you feeling relaxed and rejuvenated.
Are you ready to become the ultimate Kick Master and unleash chaos upon the hapless ragdolls? Download Ragdoll Break now and let the demolition begin!

bluejetty:00062396:ios.name: SKIDOS Learning Games for Kids
bluejetty:00062396:ios.summary: SKIDOS is an award-winning, parent-approved learning platform for children aged 3 to 10 that provides mindful screen time through 1000+ curriculum-aligned activities. This Kid-Safe and Astro-Safe certified app transforms play into an enrich
bluejetty:00062396:ios.description:
SKIDOS is an award-winning, parent-approved learning platform for children aged 3 to 10 that provides mindful screen time through 1000+ curriculum-aligned activities. This Kid-Safe and Astro-Safe certified app transforms play into an enriching experience by integrating math and literacy learning directly into engaging games.
Academic Skill Building & Curriculum Alignment
SKIDOS offers learning experiences that adapt to a child's level, helping kids build skills while they play.
-Math & Logic: Covers number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and problem-solving.
-Literacy & Phonics: Introduces sounds, letters, vocabulary, and reading readiness through interactive activities and storytelling.
-Writing & Motor Skills: Guided tracing activities help children practice letters and numbers while strengthening fine motor skills.
Interactive Learning with Global Brands
SKIDOS combines learning with beloved brands and characters that encourage creativity, curiosity, communication, and social-emotional development.
-Angry Birds Play & Learn: Story-driven adventures that help children explore emotions, creativity, empathy, and logical thinking.
-SmileyWorld® Colours: Inspires artistic expression and focus through engaging coloring activities.
-Pinkfong Baby Shark Game: Music-based experiences that support healthy routines, cognitive development, and emotional expression.
-Pinkfong Dino World Game: Dinosaur adventures that strengthen memory, coordination, curiosity, and language skills.
-Pinkfong K-Pop Princess Dress Up Game: Encourages creativity, self-expression, and attention to detail.
-The Smurfs Playhouse: Promotes imaginative storytelling, cooperation, and open-ended play.
-Masha and the Bear: Fun songs and adventures that encourage language development and creativity.
-ChuChu TV: Popular stories and songs that introduce positive habits, everyday concepts, and early learning themes.
-The Fixies, KikoRiki, Beardy Bodo & Tina & Tony: Beloved animated series that inspire curiosity, friendship, exploration, creativity, and critical thinking through engaging stories and relatable characters.
21st Century Life Skills
Beyond academics, SKIDOS helps children develop essential life skills through purposeful play.
-Motor & Cognitive Skills: Activities strengthen coordination, focus, reaction time, and problem-solving.
-Social-Emotional Development: Encourages empathy, teamwork, communication, and self-expression.
-Executive Function Skills: Supports planning, decision-making, attention, and memory.
-Fitness & Wellness: Includes movement-based activities that promote healthy habits and active play.
Inclusive Design & Accessibility
SKIDOS follows accessibility best practices to support every learner.
-Personalized recommendations for children with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dyscalculia, and Dysgraphia.
-Adaptive learning experiences designed around individual needs.
-Offline access for uninterrupted learning and play.
Trust, Safety & Parental Support
SKIDOS provides a safe environment where children can learn, play, and grow confidently.
-COPPA and GDPR compliant.
-Parental tools and progress reports to track learning milestones.
SKIDOS Pass Subscription
-One subscription unlocks learning games, educational videos, and activities across multiple profiles.
-Weekly, Monthly, and Annual plans available.
-May Include a 3-day free trial.
-Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current billing period ends.
-Auto-renewal can be managed through Account Settings.
-Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle.
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00165490:ios.name: Outfit Tracker: Diary Planner
bluejetty:00165490:ios.summary:
Never have that embarrassing fashion faux pas moment...
...when you show up with the same outfit!
Did I already wear this in front of them? What did I wear to the party last Saturday? What should I wear? These are the questions you ask you
bluejetty:00165490:ios.description:
Never have that embarrassing fashion faux pas moment...
...when you show up with the same outfit!
Did I already wear this in front of them? What did I wear to the party last Saturday? What should I wear? These are the questions you ask yourself when deciding what to wear to the party tonight.
Don't waste time trying to take a picture of every piece of clothing in your closet. All you need to do is take a picture everyday and let the AI system handle everything.
App Features
Outfit Tracker is an app that helps you track what you wear, when you wore it, at what event, and who saw you in it. No longer will you have to suffer the embarrassment of showing up in front of the same people with the same outfit. Your attire will always be unique. Its like having a clothes designer who keeps track of your closet space and helps you find outfits and acts as your outfit picker.
Camera integration
Add outfits directly from your camera.
Photo library integration
Add outfits directly from your photo library. Change date if needed to import old pictures.
Events tagging
Tag each outfit with a custom event. Keep track of parties, birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, conferences, costume parties, and even what you wore to work.
Contacts integration
Tag each outfit with people that saw the outfit.
Notes
Keep notes for each outfit.
A.I. Search
Uses aritificial inteligence to find when you wore all or parts of an outfit. Will be able to match your top, pants, suit, jeans, jacket, hats, ties, frock, dress, and any other garmet. 
A diary of your outfits
See a history of all the outfits you've worn on a calendar.
Busy days
Add multiple outfits per day.
Never lose an outfit
Everything stored in the cloud.
Across all your devices
Ability to store and see history of your outfits from any device. Sign in so I can switch between devices.
Daily diary
Take a daily picture of your outfit.
Terms of Use is available at https://outfittracker.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00075154:ios.description:
Sword of Convallaria opens a new story: Sagas of Ice and Blood.
Set forth through snow and ice toward our final home...
What tomorrow awaits at the end of this road?
Sword of Convallaria revitalizes the beloved Japanese turn-based & pixel art genre! Immerse yourself in a world of strategic victories, breathtaking visuals, and epic soundtracks, all tied together by a captivating storyline. Your story, your move!
STRATEGIC TURN-BASED COMBAT
Sword of Convallaria brings to mobile the most authentic grid-based tactical battles! Deploy unique allies against diverse enemy types and use every battlefield detail to secure victory!
PROFOUND STORY
Journey through space and time to Iria, a mineral-rich country whose magical resources have drawn unwanted attention from dangerous external factions. As tensions rise and riots break out, it’s up to you as a mercenary leader to navigate complex situations whilst finding ways to save the fate of Iria.
CHOICE-BASED NARRATIVE
The fate of Iria rests on your choices! Your decisions shape how your town evolves and influence the unfolding story. Be sure to build relations and skills to your advantage, and watch as the storyline changes depending on your choices and achievements!
MASTERFUL SCORE BY HITOSHI SAKIMOTO
Global music producer Hitoshi Sakimoto - best known for scoring FF Tactics, FFXII, and Tactics Ogre - lends his musical genius to Sword of Convallaria with his finest musical pieces to date.
His flawless scores perfectly complement the game's atmosphere and plot twists.
ENHANCED 3D-LIKE PIXEL ART
The popular pixel-style graphics incorporates modern 3D renderings such as real-time shading, full-screen bloom, dynamic depth of field, HDR, etc., thereby contributing to premium HD picture quality and lighting effects.
STUNNING HERO COLLECTION & DEVELOPMENT
Recruit and train a roster of unique companions at the tavern, teach them amazing skills, build their equipment at the forge, improve their stats in the training field, and lead your self-built mercenary group into legendary quests with different factions!
JAPANESE VOICE-OVER STARS
Enjoy performances from over 40 anime and game voice-acting legends like Inoue Kazuhiko, Yuki Aoi, and Eguchi Takuya who bring each character to life.
OFFICIAL COMMUNITIES
Official YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SwordofConvallaria
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/swordofconvallaria
Official Support Email: soc_support@xd.com

bluejetty:00048312:android.description:
Abstract to learn the game: 
Welcome to the Rich Girl shopping game. This game is where rich girls go shopping to buy clothing, accessories, jewelry, shoes, luxury bags, etc. It’s a dream come true for a shopping and fashion girl.
Have a good time doing shopping, paying the bill with cash, and enjoying the day as you experiment with different fashions and accessories. Stores are filled with crazy fashion and dress-up accessories. Visiting different stores one by one and purchasing everything you need will transform you into a lovely stylist. Discover the life of luxury, and pick attractive outfits and accessories to become the fashion designer you've always wanted.
If you are a crazy shopaholic, you can buy a variety of dresses including pants, shirts, tops, skirts, gowns, beach dresses, and maxis. Shoes including heels, sandals, and belly shoes. Different varieties of necklaces are also available. Shop the most awesome luxury handbags, glasses and hats.
Play as cash manager on the cash counter by collecting cash for the items sold and giving the bill for the money collected and giving the bag with the purchased items along with the bill.
In preparation for going shopping, you are getting ready by moisturizing your face and washing it with a face wash before going out. Following that, it is necessary to pluck the unwanted hair and remove it. Next, the cream is applied to the face, while cucumber slices are applied to the eyes to ensure maximum cooling and clarity.
The eyebrows should be applied with different shades, the lipstick should be applied with different colors, your eyelashes should be applied with bright colors, and eyeliners should be applied with different styles of eyeliners. Then finish with a vibrant color of compact foundation.
Coming up next is a different variety of dresses, hats, hand gloves, socks, earrings, necklaces, glasses, purses and finally shoes.
Fabulous features of our Shopping mall games:
You are now ready to shop. There are 8 shopping malls.
 DIY FASHION is a place where you can purchase pants, tops, trousers and tops. Go to the billing counter, pay your cash and collect the bill along with the dress after you have finished buying them.
 THE JEWELSHOP - you can get several types of necklaces and earrings here with vivid colors and designs that will surely catch your attention.
 BEACH FASHION- here you can buy clothing to wear on beaches.
There is a CANDY FASHION shop where you can find dresses that have mixed colors like candies, which will make the dress look more appealing to the eye. 
 ACCESSORIES - here you will be able to find clutches, glasses, handbags, purses, high heels, flats, sneakers, and high heels, as well as sandals!
You can buy party wears with varying colors and designs at DIVA FASHION. 
SASS AND BIDE - here the outfit makes you look like you are in a different style that makes you look like you are wearing something that is a part of a new trend.
FAB FASHION - You will find there a fantastic selection of clothes such as shorts, skirts, trousers and tops.
Xmas dress up - You can find here necklaces, earrings, and other accessories for your Christmas outfit
Unleash your inner shopaholic and imagine you are a supermodel to try various outfits and makeovers to show off your style and talent.

bluejetty:00034541:ios.description:
Experience the freedom of managing multiple social and messaging apps with Parallel Space
Easily log in to a variety of popular social and messaging apps simultaneously with multiple accounts. Whether you want to keep your work and personal life separate or manage multiple accounts on your favorite apps, Parallel Space has you covered.
Key Features:
- Multiple Accounts: Keep multiple social and messaging accounts logged in simultaneously without any interference.
- Work-Life Balance: Manage your personal and work accounts at the same time, allowing you to efficiently balance life and work.
- Wide App Support: Most popular social apps support a second account in Parallel Space - Dual Account.
- Secure and Private: Data from different accounts remains separate, ensuring privacy and security.
Enjoy seamless multitasking with enhanced privacy and security.
===================================

- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00126094:ios.description:
Speech to Text - Voice Notes is the ultimate solution for anyone who prefers writing by voice or needs a fast, convenient way to take notes on their mobile device. Effortlessly talk to text and transcribe voice to text using AI voice to text technology, making voice typing more efficient than ever. Whether you’re writing messages, converting a voice note to text, or turning lengthy audio into text, this app captures your words accurately. With support for multiple languages, your voice text will be transformed into notes with precision. Plus, enjoy text to speech with AI voices whenever you want to listen instead of read.
Key Features:
Speech to Text: Dictate seamlessly—just speak and write! Instantly convert your speech into text, perfect for note-taking or writing by voice.
Multi-Language Support: Speak any language, and the app will convert your speech to text accurately.
Text to Speech: Need to listen to your notes? Convert your text back to audio using text to speech with AI voices.
Share Your Notes: Send your voice-dictated notes via WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, and more.
Fast and Easy: A user-friendly voice dictate tool that saves time for professionals, students, and anyone wanting to speak and write efficiently.
Download Speech to Text - Voice Notes today and experience the convenience of speech to text, voice to text, and voice note to text—all in one powerful app!

Download Speech to Text - Voice Notes today and experience the convenience of speech to text, voice to text, and voice note to text—all in one powerful app!

bluejetty:00096033:ios.description:
Unlock Your Growth Potential
Everyone dreams of being taller, more confident, and standing out in a crowd. With Taller AI, the ultimate grow taller app, you can finally take control of your growth journey. Designed for teenagers and young adults, this app combines AI technology, science-backed exercises, and lifestyle guidance to help you maximize your height potential. Whether you’re looking for a free stretching app to improve posture, a height predictor to see your future, or a growth day app to stay motivated, Taller AI gives you the tools to rise higher and transform your life.
AI-Powered Height Prediction
At the core of Taller AI is our advanced algorithm that predicts your future height with accuracy based on your age, genetics, and lifestyle. Instantly discover how tall you might grow, track your progress, and receive a full personalized height report. Our AI smart system doesn’t just guess, it adapts, giving you monthly updates and insights that show how your hard work is paying off. See your growth chart, compare your stats in our height comparison tool, and stay motivated as you level up.
Daily Growth Workouts & Stretches
Growth starts with movement. Taller AI delivers a wide variety of AI-personalized height workouts, including stretching routines, yoga-inspired postures, and spine-strengthening exercises. These grow taller workouts are carefully designed to support posture, flexibility, and overall body alignment—all key factors in maximizing your height. Whether you’re looking for a free stretching app or a structured daily routine, you’ll find exercises that fit your lifestyle. The more you train, the more you unlock new levels in your plan—just like a leveling app for your body.
Nutrition, Sleep & Lifestyle Guidance
Height isn’t just about exercise, it’s about living a growth-maximizing lifestyle. Taller AI provides nutrition tips, supplement reminders, and sleep tracking guidance to make sure your body gets what it needs. From growth-promoting foods to recovery habits, our routines are built to complement your workouts. Every day becomes a growth day app experience, motivating you to eat, sleep, and recover like someone who’s serious about getting taller.
Track & Compare Your Progress
Stay accountable with built-in tools to measure height, track streaks, and celebrate milestones. Our measure height app features and height comparison charts make it easy to see where you stand today and where you’re headed. Watch as your growth tracker updates and motivates you to keep going. Whether you’re just starting puberty, leveling up with consistency, or even aiming for late height gains, Taller AI helps you go tall and keep pushing forward.
Exclusive Community & Motivation
You’re not growing alone. Taller AI connects you with a private community of other motivated individuals who are also working on their height goals. Ask questions, share progress, and get inspired by others who have gained confidence and inches with the app. Whether you’re a grow girl, a teen starting your journey, or someone who wants to embrace looksmaxxing as part of your lifestyle, our supportive environment helps you stay motivated every day.
Why Choose Taller AI?
Unlike generic fitness apps, Taller AI is built specifically for people who want to grow taller and maximize their height. With personalized guidance, a smart AI height predictor, and structured plans, it’s more than just a grow app, it’s your AI-powered personal height coach. Teens, young adults, and anyone curious about their growth potential can benefit from this one-of-a-kind app.
Download Taller AI now, the ultimate height measure, grow taller, and elevate app. It’s time to tall up, growit, and go tall with confidence.

Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/get-taller-ai-terms-of-service

bluejetty:00043188:ios.description:
Zinli es una billetera digital en dólares que te ofrece una Tarjeta Visa Prepago Internacional y te permite transferir dinero al extranjero, enviar o solicitar dinero de amigos y familiares gratis, además puede solicitar una Tarjeta prepagada Zinli Visa Internacional física, ¡sin necesidad de una cuenta bancaria! Puedes crear una cuenta a partir de los 12 años. Solo debes contar con tu pasaporte vigente o cédula de identidad personal (aplica solo para Panamá y Venezuela).
¡Estamos trabajando para aceptar más identificaciones locales!
Podrás realizar compras en todos los comercios que acepten Visa con tu Tarjeta débito/prepago Visa Internacional sin necesidad de una cuenta bancaria
UTILIZA Zinli PARA
○ Enviar dinero a un familiar o amigo al instante
