○ Solicitar pagos a familiares y amigos
○ Obtener una Tarjeta Prepago Virtual Zinli Visa Internacional gratis para realizar compras en comercios electrónicos
○ Recibir dinero del extranjero gratis y al instante
○ Realizar pagos entre personas de forma rápida y segura
○ Realizar o recibir pagos con código QR
○ Solicitar una Tarjeta Prepagada Zinli Visa Internacional Física para realizar compras en todos los comercios afiliados a la red de Visa del mundo
CÓMO FUNCIONA Zinli
▬ Descarga la aplicación Zinli
▬ Regístrate utilizando tu correo electrónico y pasaporte vigente o cédula de identidad personal (aplica solo para Panamá y Venezuela)
▬ Recarga tu monedero digital con tu tarjeta de crédito o débito internacional, efectivo, transferencias bancarias ACH o solicitando a un amigo que te envíe dinero a través de Zinli
▬ Envía dinero entre usuarios Zinli Gratis con solo su número de celular o dirección de correo electrónico
▬ Confirma la cantidad y presiona enviar. El destinatario recibirá el dinero al instante
▬ Realiza compras con tu Tarjeta Visa Internacional en todos los comercios que acepten Visa en todo el mundo
PRINCIPALES FUNCIONALIDADES Y BENEFICIOS
■ Billetera digital en dólares
Zinli es un monedero virtual en dólares, por esa razón, tu dinero no pierde su valor en el tiempo
■ Envía y recibe dinero al instante
Envía dinero desde tu teléfono al instante de forma fácil y segura. Con Zinli podrás enviar dinero simplemente si conoces el número de celular o correo electrónico del destinatario
■ Transferencia internacional en dólares sin intermediarios
Sin necesidad de cuenta bancaria, sin tasas de cambio y sin comisiones ocultas. Realiza todas tus transacciones sin intervención de terceros 24/7
■ Pago movil y Tarjeta Prepaga Visa Internacional
Con nuestra Tarjeta Prepago Zinli Visa Internacional Virtual y Física podrás realizar compras en todos los comercios que acepten Visa y y suscribirte a tus plataformas de streaming favoritas
■ Solicitud de dinero entre personas
Con Zinli podrás solicitar y recibir pagos de manera instantánea sin importar donde te encuentres
■ Múltiples opciones de Recarga
Puedes recargar directamente desde tu tarjeta de crédito o débito internacional (Visa o Mastercard), efectivo, transferencias bancarias ACH o solicitando a un amigo que te envíe dinero a través de Zinli
■ Realiza pagos con Código QR
Con Zinli puedes generar un código QR para recibir y realizar pagos inmeditatos
■ Manejo seguro de tu dinero
Al utilizar nuestro wallet electrónico tendrás mayor seguridad en tus transacciones. Si pierdes o extravías los datos de tu tarjeta, puedes bloquearla o desbloquearla desde la aplicación
Descarga Zinli, regístrate gratis en tan solo unos minutos y únete a la comunidad de personas que ya están disfrutando de una Tarjeta Visa Prepagada sin costos mensuales, ni anualidad y de una mejor experiencia a la hora de enviar y solicitar dinero en dólares de amigos y familiares

bluejetty:00081152:ios.description:
Earn money easily with your smartphone, at home or on the go. 
People from all over the world can become part of the Clickworker community. You simply log in through the app or on your PC, complete micro jobs and quickly earn a little money on the side. 
There’s a variety of available tasks: 
Surveys
Online research
App testing 
Making audio and video recordings 
Mystery photography / store visits
Writing and proofing texts
Categorizing data 
And many other micro jobs...
There’s a lot to do, sometimes more, sometimes less! Checking in daily on the clickworker app is definitely worthwhile. 
Becoming a clickworker is super easy: 
1) Register online or on the app 
2) Fill out your profile so we can learn some more about you 
3) Get started with your first online jobs 
4) To keep the work interesting and fun, you should ideally also take some of the tests to become qualified to work on additional jobs. 
5) Have your earnings paid out weekly to your PayPal account. 
Do you still have questions about this kind of work? Contact us directly or connect with lots of other Clickworkers in our Clickworker forum!

bluejetty:00024577:ios.description:
Secure your privacy instantly with Auto Blur Face—the ultimate all-in-one AI solution for anonymizing photos and videos.
Whether you are a content creator, a journalist, or a parent sharing family moments, protecting identities has never been easier. Powered by advanced AI, our app automatically detects, tracks, and blurs faces, license plates, and sensitive details in seconds, saving you hours of manual editing.
Your privacy is our #1 priority. Unlike other apps, we process everything 100% OFFLINE on your device. Your sensitive photos and videos are never uploaded to any server, ensuring absolute security for your data.
HIGHLIGHT: SMART AI VIDEO TRACKING
You asked, we delivered! Censor moving objects in videos with unparalleled precision.
• Auto-Tracking AI: Simply select a face or object, and our AI will continuously track and blur it across every frame of your video.
• Batch Video Processing: Have multiple video clips? Let us automatically blur faces in every video simultaneously in the background! (Note: Batch processing is exclusive to videos).

PHOTO PRIVACY & MANUAL CONTROL
• Auto-Detect: One tap to instantly find and blur all faces in a group photo.
• Select & Deselect: Tap individual faces to choose who stays hidden and who stays visible.
• Manual Blur & Pixelate: Take full control! Use the brush tool to manually blur or pixelate any documents, license plates, or background details in your photos.
PROFESSIONAL PRIVACY TOOLS

• Meta Info Editor: View, modify, or completely remove sensitive metadata (GPS location, EXIF data) before sharing your photos online.
• Enhance & Edit: Crop, rotate, apply artistic filters, or add text and stickers to your media.
EXCLUSIVE BONUS CONTENT
• Photography Articles: Sharpen your skills with our curated tips and tricks.
• Wallpapers: Spruce up your device with our unique wallpaper collection.
WHY USE AUTO BLUR FACE?
• Hide children's faces before posting on social media.
• Anonymize bystanders, license plates, or brands in travel vlogs and news reports.
• Censor sensitive documents or passwords quickly.
Download Auto Blur Face today to track, hide, and share your world safely!

bluejetty:00061580:ios.summary:
Keep your conversations private. Proton Mail is encrypted email from Switzerland. Used by millions worldwide, our all-new email app protects your communications and has everything you need to easily manage your inbox.
The Wall Street Journ
bluejetty:00061580:ios.description:
Keep your conversations private. Proton Mail is encrypted email from Switzerland. Used by millions worldwide, our all-new email app protects your communications and has everything you need to easily manage your inbox.
The Wall Street Journal says:
“Proton Mail offers encrypted email, which makes it virtually impossible for anyone to read it except the sender and the recipient.”
With the all-new Proton Mail app, you can:
• Create a @proton.me or @protonmail.com email address 
• Send and receive encrypted emails and attachments with ease
• Switch between multiple Proton Mail accounts
• Easily manage your email with conversations
• Keep your inbox tidy and clean with folders, labels and simple swipe-gestures
• Receive new email notifications
• Send Password-protected Emails to anyone
• Keep important emails in focus with automatic, private categories
• Enjoy your inbox in dark mode
Why use Proton Mail?
• Easy to use — Our all-new app has been redesigned to make it easier to read, organize, and write your emails.
• Your inbox is yours — We don’t spy on your communications to show you targeted ads. Your inbox, your rules.
• Rigorous encryption — Your entire inbox is secured, on all your devices. No one can read your emails but you. Proton is privacy, guaranteed by end-to-end and zero-access encryption.
• Unmatched protection — We offer strong phishing, spam, and spying/tracking protection for all your communications.
Industry Leading Security Features
Messages are stored on Proton Mail servers using end-to-end encryption at all times and are transmitted securely between Proton servers and user devices. This largely eliminates the risk of message interception.
Zero Access to Your Email Content
Proton Mail's zero access architecture means that your data is encrypted in a way that makes it inaccessible to us. Data is encrypted on the client side using an encryption key that Proton does not have access to. This means we don't have the technical ability to decrypt your messages.
Open-Source Cryptography
Proton Mail's open-source software has been thoroughly vetted by security experts from around the world to ensure the highest levels of protection. Proton Mail only uses secure implementations of AES, RSA, along with OpenPGP, while all of the cryptographic libraries used are open source. By using open-source libraries, Proton Mail can guarantee that the encryption algorithms used do not have clandestinely built-in back doors.
Proton Mail in the press:
“Proton Mail is a Gmail-like email system which uses end-to-end encryption, making it impossible for outside parties to monitor.” Forbes
“A new email service being developed by a group who met at MIT and CERN promises to bring secure, encrypted email to the masses and keep sensitive information away from prying eyes.” Huffington Post
Follow Proton on social media for all the latest news and offers:
Facebook: /proton
Twitter: @protonprivacy
Reddit: /protonmail
Instagram: /protonprivacy
Our open-source code base: https://github.com/ProtonMail
EULA: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00182892:ios.description:
Defender! Are you ready to defend your castle? In this fast paced castle defense game you requires strategy and skill. Endless hours of action await you! Upgrade and grow your castle, defend against endless waves of monsters, gather resources, improve your defense, equip and combine dozens of crossbows, spells, traps, modules and legendaries to grow stronger and stronger.
The dark army does not sleep and is preparing attack after attack. Defend, fight back and kill the dark hordes - send the monsters back to the dungeon where they came from. 
Controls are simple: tap and hold the screen to shoot with your crossbows, drag and drop spells on monsters and strategically position traps. Grow your income and use gold, rubies and darkgold that you collect from monsters to create the best weapon combination. Grim Defender is praised for its diversity, endless equipment combinations, depth and fun gameplay. Enjoy huge action loaded battles with hundreds of enemies on the battlefield.
Endless levels, tons of upgrades, items, legendaries and infinite combinations
Challenging gameplay through endless levels and different game modes. Craft and customize your defense as you like. Non-linear defense and upgrade setup, hundreds of viable builds. Freely combine items to build the best defense, place explosives, lightning or stasis traps to destroy your enemies or use a cool strategy and maze up using palisades. Use fire, ice, lightning or pushback spells as well as powerful crossbows combined with modules to stop the dark monsters. Upgrade your bow to shoot stronger arrows, improve your modules to deal more damage, use multishot or have splintershot. Upgrade your castle wall, buy more defense turrets and magic towers or add an automatic turret to your castle! Choose active play to grind resources in endless mode or use the auto turret to idle grind money.
Lots of unique enemies, crazy monsters and bosses
Fight your way from easy zombies and skeletons to cannons, palisades and powerful epic boss monsters - can you defeat the strongest of dragons? Kill all bosses and become a legendary defender!
Dailies, quests and global leaderboards with other players
See how other players defend their castle and compete in global leaderboards. Participate in the season system: a fresh leaderboard is started every few month to create a fair competition with thousands of other defenders. Play dailies and quests to collect huge bonuses and get ahead of the competition. Reach the highest rank and have the highest level of all players with the best strategy and grow to be a tactical mastermind.
Offline play
Grim Defender does not require an internet connection to be played - play offline from anywhere and whenever you want.
Frequent updates and new content
Grim Defender is free to play and we are working hard to improve our game even more. Let us know what you think!
Game website: https://www.grimdefender.com
Company website: https://www.byteghoul.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/grimdefendergame
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/grimdefender
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/grimdefender
We love defense games and made this game with a lot of passion and focus on details. We really hope that you enjoy our work!
BYTEGHOUL GAMES

bluejetty:00092996:ios.summary: Hey y’all! Fashion and shopping has always been our passion and the idea of owning our own business has been our dream since we were very young! It seems like we have been on the craft show scene since birth. Both of our grandparents includ
bluejetty:00092996:ios.description: Hey y’all! Fashion and shopping has always been our passion and the idea of owning our own business has been our dream since we were very young! It seems like we have been on the craft show scene since birth. Both of our grandparents included us in their crafts and sewing projects and took us to shows and let us help. Our Mema, Nancy Perrin, made fabulous dolls and our Nana, Letha Perrin, made women’s apparel. They both sold their items at craft shows throughout Oklahoma and Texas! The Hayloft began in late 2015 with a tee shirt right after Whitney’s little boy, Braxton, was born. We opened our first shop, approximately 200 square feet, inside Past Perfect Too, a consignment store, in 2016. Later that year, we moved into our current location at 1811 NW Cache Road in Lawton, Oklahoma. We love styling and offering unique pieces for everyone.

bluejetty:00137136:ios.description:
Identify Bird by Sounds: Discover the Enchanting Bird World!
Welcome to Identify Bird by Sounds, an exceptional app tailor-made for bird enthusiasts and nature lovers alike. Embrace the joy of effortlessly identifying various bird species with our innovative features. This impressive application offers two primary functions: image recognition and bird song analysis. Whether you encounter a fascinating bird in the wild or hear a melodious chirp, our app is here to quench your curiosity.
Key Features:
- Effortless Identification: Record of the bird song or capture or upload a photo its, and our app will swiftly provide you with comprehensive information about the species.
- Vast Database: With accuracy, we can identify over 100,000 bird species, making sure you get the right answers every time.
- Visual References: For an enhanced visual identification experience, Bird Sounds Identifier provides a collection of captivating photos for each bird species.
- In-Depth Knowledge: Delve into the intricate details of each bird species, including their habitat, behavior, and diet, to gain a deeper understanding of the avian world.
- User-Friendly Interface: Our app boasts a seamless and intuitive interface for easy navigation, ensuring an enjoyable user experience.
Whether you are a curious bird watcher, a devoted learner of bird-feeding techniques, or a parent keen on educating your children about these winged wonders, Identify Bird by Sounds offers the simplest and most effective solutions. Join a thriving community of bird enthusiasts and embark on an enchanting journey into the captivating world of ornithology. Download the Identify Bird by Sounds app today and get ready to be mesmerized by the mesmerizing melodies and stunning beauty of birds!

Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00175206:ios.description:
Polycam turns a single phone scan into the documents jobs run on: floor plans, as-builts, estimates, roof reports, claims files, measurements, and CAD-ready exports. No tripod. No technician. No two-week wait.
WHAT YOU WALK AWAY WITH
• Floor plans — 2D and 3D, ready for AutoCAD, SketchUp, and Revit
• As-builts — weeks of documentation compressed into minutes
• Measurements — every dimension in the room, in the time it takes to cross it
• Estimates — priced off real conditions, not guesses
• Claims and damage records — dated, dimensioned, defensible
• 3D models and point clouds — .obj, .dae, .fbx, .stl, .dxf, .ply, .esx
• 360° tours — shareable links for clients and remote stakeholders
HOW YOU CAPTURE IT
• 3D scanner for fast, accurate interior and structural capture that works without LiDAR
• Photogrammetry and Gaussian splats from photos and video 
• Drone and aerial capture for roofs, exteriors, and whole-site coverage
• Measure, annotate, crop, rescale, and label directly on the scan
WHERE IT FITS IN YOUR WORKFLOW
• Construction documentation and progress tracking
• Renovation and design visualization
• Insurance, restoration, and damage assessment
• Site survey and drone-based mapping
• BIM coordination and CAD workflows
• Factory layout and equipment documentation
WORK FROM ONE TRUTH
Share scans and floor plans with clients and teammates by link. Control access with private or public permissions. Use shared libraries so the whole team is looking at the same site. View, edit, and export from any computer on Polycam Web, included free.
34 million scans. More than 10 million people. Over 2 billion square feet captured.
Privacy Policy: https://poly.cam/privacy_policy.pdf
Terms of Use: https://poly.cam/terms_and_conditions.pdf

listings.description:
Oregon ONE Mobile is an official State of Oregon app. You can securely mange and take steps to apply for public medical, food, cash and child care. You don’t always have to call, go into an office or find a desktop computer. You can do a lot from your smartphone. Try it out. Available in English and Spanish.
•	See if your case or application is approved, denied, pending, closed and what actions you need to take.
•	See and download notices that were mailed to you 
•	Check out your next renewal/periodic report due date, for SNAP, CASH, ERDC, and Medical Assistance.
•	Get important, time-sensitive alerts and notifications about your benefits.
•	Take pictures of supporting documents and attach them to get benefits.
•	Manage your ONE Online account email and password
•	Find a guided tour of the app, FAQs, and referrals for additional resources. 
You must have an existing ONE Online account. No costs except for data rates.

bluejetty:00014671:ios.description:
Manage your requests, tasks, and approvals—regardless of whether you are on the floor or on the move. 
With a suite of intuitive ticketing capabilities, real-time dashboards, and an AI-powered voice assistant, you can enhance service delivery not only in IT but across HR, finance, facilities, and beyond.
Discover the key features that can transform your service experience
● Multiple instance management: Switch effortlessly between service desk instances and access different modules. 
● Request management: Create, edit, and manage incident and service requests with ease.
● Advanced filtering and search: Quickly filter and search for requests by type, ID, subject, or name, ensuring you find what you need without hassle.
● Request details: Access comprehensive request details, including conversations, history, and resolutions. Add notes and upload attachments directly to requests, enriching context and collaboration.
● Task management: Create, edit, and manage tasks across all modules. Filter and search tasks, track work logs, and delete tasks as needed.
● Approval management: View and manage approvals for requests, changes, releases, and purchase orders.
● Real-time notifications: Stay informed about help desk events and request updates with timely push notifications. 
● Dynamic dashboard: Keep track of organizational announcements and monitor key performance metrics, including pending requests and daily due requests, to stay ahead of your tasks.
● Change management: Filter, sort, search, and take action on change requests. 
● Asset management: Add, view, and manage your organization’s assets by scanning barcodes, QR codes, or RFIDs. Track asset details, raise requests related to assets, and modify asset information on the go.
● Knowledge base access: Power up self-service and accelerate resolutions by accessing solutions from the knowledge base.
● AI-powered smart assistant: Connect with Zia for instant support through conversational chat or voice commands.
● Interactive widgets: Pick up requests, handle approvals, or even call end users from your home screen through interactive widgets.
If you haven't installed ServiceDesk Plus yet, go ahead and try out out the fully featured, 30-day, free trial at https://mnge.it/install-servicedesk.
Note: This is not a stand-alone application. To log in, your organization must have an account with ServiceDesk Plus.

bluejetty:00017588:ios.description:
Con Banca Móvil BCP llevas el banco más grande del Perú en tu bolsillo. Más de 9 millones de clientes ya gestionan sus finanzas desde la app: consultan sus cuentas, transfieren dinero, pagan servicios y hacen crecer sus ahorros, todo sin ir a una agencia. 
¿Todavía no eres cliente BCP? Abre tu cuenta de ahorros digital en minutos directamente desde la app. Sin papeleos, sin filas, sin salir de casa. Recibes tu tarjeta de débito activa y acceso inmediato a todos los servicios digitales del BCP. 
Tus operaciones están protegidas con biometría facial y dactilar, token digital y encriptación de datos. Si en algún momento pierdes tu tarjeta, puedes bloquearla al instante desde la app, sin llamar a nadie. 
¿Qué puedes hacer con la app BCP? 
• Consulta saldos y movimientos de tus cuentas y tarjetas en tiempo real 
• Transfiere dinero a cualquier banco del país de forma inmediata y sin comisiones 
• Transfiere dinero al exterior con menos comisión y más ahorro, directo desde tu app 
• Paga tus recibos de luz, agua, teléfono, universidades y más sin comisiones adicionales 
• Activa el Pago Automático de servicios y olvídate de vencimientos 
• Retira efectivo sin tarjeta en cajeros y agentes BCP en todo el país 
• Paga con QR en miles de comercios de manera rápida y segura 
• Pasa a cuotas una compra con tu tarjeta de crédito BCP en segundos 
• Yapea a celular desde tu app Banca Móvil a cuentas BCP 
• Solicita préstamos personales, tarjetas de crédito y otros productos sin ir a una agencia 
• Paga tu tarjeta de crédito, crédito vehicular, hipotecario, personal, Mivivienda y más, de forma fácil y segura 
• Cotiza y contrata tu seguro vehicular o de salud en minutos 
• Invierte en fondos mutuos y depósitos a plazo fijo directamente desde tu celular 
• Cambia soles a dólares con el tipo de cambio BCP en tiempo real, sin hacer filas 
• Crea metas de ahorro con Wardaditos y haz seguimiento de tus gastos para tomar mejores decisiones financieras 
• Usa Apple Pay y olvídate de cargar tarjetas o efectivo: solo acerca tu iPhone a cualquier POS contactless y listo 
La app BCP está en constante evolución. Cada actualización trae nuevas funciones pensadas para simplificarte el día a día. ¿Tienes alguna duda? Escríbenos por el chat de la app o llámanos al 311-9898. 
Nota: la aplicación no es compatible con dispositivos con privilegios de administrador (root). 
Descarga Banca Móvil BCP y toma el control de tus finanzas desde hoy.

bluejetty:00119193:ios.description:
Harri Live is a highly intuitive and useful team scheduling and communication platform, built specifically for the hospitality industry by seasoned hospitality professionals. Featuring a simple design and real-time collaboration features, the app allows you to easily view your employees work schedule and seamlessly communicate with your staff, all from your mobile device.
The app gives you the freedom to manage your team's schedule while you're on the floor. With Team Scheduling, you can dynamically view everyone's schedule across devices by day, week, or month; be alerted to shift trade requests and early or late clock ins and clock outs; and take comfort in the built-in functionality to prevent scheduling conflicts (because there’s nothing worse than being understaffed for dinner rush).
The Harri Live app is modeled after the social media you use every day, so communication has never been easier. With Team Communication, you and your team can stay in sync with company goals, status updates, and more—all from one dashboard. Easily approve time-off requests, edit and send upcoming schedules, and approve shift trades from employees—all from the app (so you can say goodbye to those group chats forever.)
The Harri Live app has all of the scheduling & communication tools you need, in one place!

bluejetty:00069009:ios.description:
Salatuk is your Muslim prayer companion.
By automatically locating you, this app provides appropriate prayer times and the direction of the Qibla corresponding to your position.
Salatuk's algorithm supports a large number of calculation methods adopted in the Islamic world. Depending on your location, the app chooses the appropriate method and Fiqh school. However, you also have the option to manually change this information in the 'Settings' tab if you wish.
Salatuk is currently available in 3 languages: Arabic, English, and French.
***** Important Note ***** 
If you are familiar with Salatuk on other systems, please note that this version DOES NOT SUPPORT certain functions like "Silent mode after Adhan," "Full Adhan," or the use of a "Custom Athan." This is due to technical limitations that we will try to remove once the iOS system allows it.
***** About Prayer Times ***** 
Please note that we pay great attention to the accuracy of prayer times. However, in some countries, these times may not be exact. In such cases, please refer to the official Islamic institutions in your locality and manually adjust the prayer times in the app settings.
***** About the Adhan ***** 
Salatuk reminds you that it is time for prayer using "4 takbeerats" instead of the full Adhan.
***** Tips for Better Use ***** 
To refresh prayer notifications, it is recommended to open the app frequently (once a day). This should also be done when you change location or time (daylight saving time).

bluejetty:00023144:ios.description:
Get ready to discover a new fun match 3D puzzle adventure! Play today and enjoy addictive gameplay filled with cool features and amazing puzzles. 
Practice your skills with plenty of well-designed brain training levels. 
Sort and match three objects from a pile of items and eliminate them from the board. Use boosters at the right time to quickly complete the challenges and win the level. 
Once you start matching 3D tiles -you can’t stop! Practice your skills, connect tiles and enjoy a triple win! 
PLAYING Tile Match 3D is easy to learn, here’s what you need to do:
- Drag different objects to collect them
- Complete the goal that is set at the start of each level
- NOTE! Each level has a timer, so you must move fast & reach the level goal!
- Use the boosters to help you pass tricky levels
- Use Shuffle to rearrange the items on the board
- Boost your match 3d game with the Hint and Super Hint
- Enjoy the fun gameplay and cool features like cards and gem collections
- Win great rewards along the way!
Enjoy these Awesome Features:
Plenty of FUN match 3d puzzles- Sort through the hidden objects and clear the board! 
Amazing boosters and hints to help you pass tricky levels
Enjoyable brain training levels that will boost your memory and matching skills
Beautiful, vivid visual effects
Easy to learn and super fun matching game
Relaxing triple matching 3D game
Free to play online or offline, no Wi-Fi or internet connection is required
Fans of mahjong and matching games will be pleased to discover a new awesome gameplay experience that is fun for everyone to play. Sharpen your logic skills and train your brain to solve addicting triple 3D puzzles.
Download Tile Match 3D now and join the matching fun!

*** The Barclays Private Bank app is currently available for Barclays Clients booked in Switzerland, Monaco, Jersey and Ireland. You must be a registered Barclays Online user and enable the mobile access from your desktop to access and use the App. ***
Enjoy 24/7 access to your investment portfolio with the Barclays Private Bank App.
You can use your iOS device to benefit from the following features:
* Accounts: check your account balances and transactions
* Assets: track the market value of your portfolios and custody accounts
* Alerts: benefit from notifications about any activity impacting your account
* eDocs: review your account statements and transaction advices online
* Payments: create and submit payments and account transfers
* Secure Messaging: communicate with your Private Banker / Relationship Manager or with the support team using a secured environment (Subject to jurisdiction)
Login made easy:
The Barclays Private Bank app offers you the same level of security as online access for your desktop, using SMS One-Time Passcode authentication. 
Thanks to effective methods of identification and stronger encryption of the data, access to your banking is very well protected. 
For your protection certain transactions may require additional authentication via ‘hard token’ or SMS.
Compatibility: iOS 15 or higher

View and teach directly from your daily schedule, curriculum, activities, and care routines
Communicate with families
Save & share photos, videos, and other media across devices

Take attendance, move children or staff, and complete name-to-face checks*
Track care routines and share Daily Reports with families*
Conduct health screenings for children and/or staff*
*Feature availability is dependent on which Teaching Strategies products your classroom licenses.

- Point out your favorite audios.
- Access the Scripture quote or quotes that accompany each audio or any other relevant text ...
- Backup copies of notes and favorites.
- Download audios to the device to listen to them offline.

Power Master 48: Learn to Think Like the Powerful
Power Master 48 is the ultimate experience for fans of Robert Greene’s 48 Laws of Power and those who seek real-world mastery of strategy, influence, and dominance. Whether you're climbing the corporate ladder, leading a team, or navigating social dynamics, understanding the laws of power gives you a lasting edge.
This educational experience challenges you to internalize key strategies used by influential leaders, CEOs, political figures, and public icons—not just through theory, but through real-life application. Want to learn why Elon Musk controls the narrative, or how Steve Jobs used silence as a weapon? Power Master 48 decodes these moves through interactive lessons and thought-provoking challenges.
What Makes Power Master 48 Unique:
Full Mastery of the 48 Laws of Power: Get an immersive breakdown of all 48 laws and how they apply in real-world settings.
Modern-Day Examples: Each law includes practical insights—like how Jeff Bezos subtly asserts dominance in boardrooms, or how top negotiators use calculated delays to gain leverage.
Learn Through Strategy: Strategic decisions, scenarios, and pattern recognition train your mind to think in moves, not moments.
From Novice to Power Player: Track your rise through 8 ranks—from Apprentice to Emperor—as you build real strategic fluency.
Continuous Growth: New content drops regularly, offering deeper mastery of influence, manipulation, leadership, and protection against others' tactics.
Whether you're a student of psychology, an entrepreneur, or simply someone who wants to understand how power works behind the scenes, Power Master 48 sharpens your instincts and strengthens your position.
Download Power Master 48 now and start mastering the laws that silently shape success, leadership, and control in today’s world.

bluejetty:00185656:ios.description:
ATTENTION!
THIS GAME IS MEANT TO BE PLAYED WITH FRIENDS IN PERSON. IF YOU ARE ALONE YOU CANNOT PLAY!
Dark Stories is an easy to play and fun game but some of the stories are quite difficult. All the stories are fictional. To solve them, the players will need to prove their skills as detectives.
HOW TO PLAY
Dark Stories must be played in group. A person -chosen as narrator- picks a mystery and reads its description aloud.
Then he/she reads its solution without telling the other people. The rest of the players then have to make questions in order to solve the mystery.
The narrator can only answer the questions using "Yes", "No" or "It is not relevant". The only possible solution is the one given at the back of each mystery card. If the answer is still not clear enough, the players must follow the narrator's interpretation of the mystery.
EXAMPLE
A typical fragment of a gameplay could be: 
Player1: "Did he die because of the shot?"
Narrator:"No"
Player2: "Was he poisoned?"
Narrator: "No"
Player3: "Did he have children?"
Narrator: "It's not relevant"
Player1: "Are there other people in the story?"
Narrator: "No"
Player2: "Did he commit suicide?"
Narrator: "Yes"
...
END OF THE GAME
When the narrator considers that the story has been solved enough, the narrator can conclude the game and read the whole solution.
It is up to the narrator to give some clues if the story is in a deadlock.
WHEN TO PLAY
It is perfect for birthday parties, camps... and every situation in which you join several friends.
STORIES
This free App includes more than 200 stories and we will add new stories periodically.
Accidents, suicides, thefts... Will you be able to solve every mystery?
Special thanks to Lorena Rebollo, mcwc307 Chan, Rachel Long and Zak Freckelton for their help with the English translation.
Rated 18+ by the Indonesia Game Rating System (IGRS).

bluejetty:00071072:ios.summary:
BUILD THE BEST ZOO
Zoo Life: Animal Park Game is a brand new zoo simulation game from Sparkling Society, famous for their city building games, where you can create the ZOO of your dreams! Build and manage your zoo and take care of your anim
bluejetty:00071072:ios.description:
BUILD THE BEST ZOO
Zoo Life: Animal Park Game is a brand new zoo simulation game from Sparkling Society, famous for their city building games, where you can create the ZOO of your dreams! Build and manage your zoo and take care of your animals. Discover and collect all animal species to attract visitors from all over the world! Breed cute baby animals, design to your wishes and become the best zoo park manager ever! Join our community of millions of players with the most popular casual zoo building game series on mobile! Are you a fan of our city building games and looking for a refreshing challenge? Then Zoo Life: Animal Park Game is the perfect management game for you to pick up next! Wait no longer and build the best animal park that ever existed!
NO INTERNET REQUIRED
Zoo Life: Animal Park Game can be played offline, which means you do not need a wifi connection to play! Build the best zoo from anywhere you like, without internet!
COLLECT ALL ANIMALS
Discover exotic wild animals from as far as the ice cold Arctic all the way to the scorching deserts of Africa! Dive deep to search for rare sea animals or fly high for some feathered friends! Complete challenges to earn cards and collect all your favorite animals! Manage your zoo the most efficiently or make it the most beautiful, the decision is yours!
BREED CUTE ANIMALS
Take care of cute domestic and wild animals: Playful penguins, enormous elephants, adorable bunnies, vigorous tigers and many more that are waiting to play with you! Find your favorite animal! A giraffe, zebra, polar bear, rhinoceros, or gorilla? We have it all! Or maybe some of the scarier ones such as crocodiles, lions or bears? Or what about a silly monkey or lemur? We offer a wide range of all your favorite animal species that you can not resist to love!
LEVEL UP
Level up in this animal simulation game to unlock new tycoon features, animals, buildings, decorations and more! Guide your visitors, water your flowers and make sure your animals are well fed! Make sure your visitors enjoy their day at the animal park by building lots of different animal enclosures, shops, benches, restaurants and of course… toilets! Build and manage your dream zoo!
IMPRESSIVE GRAPHICS
Enjoy the beauty of our graphics and animal animations and view the animals up close to learn more about their quirky or lovable characters! Dive into a wide collection of customization options to build the perfect animal park to your wishes! As in all of our city building games, we uphold only the best quality for our players in this brand new zoo management game!
JOIN THE ADVENTURE
Be part of an immersive story! Complete challenges, earn special rewards and progress into becoming the best zoo manager ever! Enjoy this new refreshing Sparkling Society simulation game! Build and manage the best animal park of the world!
A NEW CHALLENGE
Do you love our city building games, but are you looking for a bit more challenge? In Zoo Life: Animal Park game we take our simulation games to the next level with new management gameplay! Manage your employees, feed your animals and upgrade habitats with items your animals long for! Your visitors are picky, so make sure your zoo becomes the most popular!
ENJOY UPDATES
The Sparkling Society team is still working hard on creating new features and loads of content, so let us know if your favorite animal is missing, and we will do our best to get your wish granted! As you might have experienced in our other city building games, we do our best to keep our fans satisfied on the long term!
PLAY NOW
So wait no longer, and start playing Zoo Life: Animal Park Game right away, offline or online! No internet required to join! This will be the most fun wild animal simulation game you do not want to miss! Prove your skills as a manager and turn your zoo park in the best paradise island there is! Download now! Enjoy playing!

bluejetty:00172632:ios.name: Moms Into Fitness
bluejetty:00172632:ios.summary: Embrace fitness with at home workouts that transform your body. After age 30, our bodies start to change. We must redefine our workouts and move in ways that honor it. With strength and walking, you can feel vibrant and confident again. Sim
bluejetty:00172632:ios.description:
Embrace fitness with at home workouts that transform your body. After age 30, our bodies start to change. We must redefine our workouts and move in ways that honor it. With strength and walking, you can feel vibrant and confident again. Simple. Sustainable. Seriously Effective. 
Try our most popular, Weekly Schedule, which provides new workouts each week including strength, barre, cardio and mobility. You choose the length of workouts and how many days a week you need. You’ll feel challenged, not depleted. 
From beginners to seasoned athletes, our programs are built to support women’s changing bodies and real life schedules. You’ll get seriously effective workouts 15-35 minutes, three times a week. No experience necessary—just show up and hit play. Here’s where to begin:
GETTING STARTED: If you're new to exercise, get started with our initial two week program. 
WEEKLY SCHEDULE: Weekly workouts where you choose your plan: 3x a week, 4x a week, or 5x a week. These workouts create cardio endurance, build strength, and keep you motivated no matter your fitness level. New workouts are uploaded every week.
SPECIALIZED PROGRAMS: For all stages of life including prenatal, postnatal and core restore for ab separation. They focus on core stability, pelvic floor, healing diastasis, strength and mobility during pregnancy, postpartum and after.
NUTRITIONAL GUIDANCE: Learn how to fuel your body with recipes, coaching and small groups with our registered dietitian following simple nutritional guidelines. We believe in integration not elimination.
MORE WORKOUTS:
Sculpt – Think traditional strength training utilizing both isolation and compound exercises with dumbbells, sliders and bands for maximum effectiveness. 
Barre – Burn out targeted muscle groups through unique high repetition moves, with added challenges like pulses & isometric holds. This class is unlike any other.
Mat Core – A mat core and Pilates workout that emphasizes strengthening deep core muscles and enhancing flexibility and body alignment.
WHO WE ARE: I’m Lindsay! In my 30’s, high cardio workouts worked. By my 40’s, they left me drained and stuck. That’s why I’ve spent the last five years diving into the science of age, hormones, walking, HIIT and strength training. The result? A method that works with your body, not against it. It is fitness redefined! Simple. Sustainable. Seriously Effective. 
It’s my mission to spread my health and fitness knowledge to help women feel great! We’ve worked with over 80,000 women do much more than “work out.” They’ve rebuilt strength, renewed energy, and redefined what fitness means for life
--

bluejetty:00016811:ios.description:
iWare Designs brings you My Golf 3D, a casual mini golf game which features real 3D physics, 36 unique holes based over four environments with a variety of interactive obstacles and hazards to avoid and negotiate.
Whether you are a serious or casual golfer this game will give you hours of enjoyment.
Download My Golf 3D now, you will not be disappointed. 
System Requirements:
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
∙ Supports iOS 15.0+
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices
∙ Game Center compatible
Game Features:

∙ Full 3D physics at 60 FPS.
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own. 
∙ Quick Play: Play against other friends, family members or computer opponents. 
∙ Multi player hot seat up to 4 players.
∙ Fully adjustable address including position and direction.

∙ Play left or right handed. 
∙ Track your game progress and achievement progress locally in the new 3D Trophy Room. 
∙ Save your favourite shots and watch them with complete video playback. 
∙ Top 10 leader boards for all courses. 
∙ 5 levels of CPU difficulty. 
∙ 15 achievements to collect locally or via Game Center.
∙ Leader boards and via Game Center.

bluejetty:00152430:ios.description:
Turn one product photo into a scroll-stopping video ad in minutes. No studio. No shoot. No agency.
VideoMagic is the AI ad maker for online sellers and small businesses: product videos, AI models wearing your products, UGC ads with AI influencers and store-ready product photos, all in one app.
PRODUCT PHOTO → VIDEO AD
Upload a photo, pick a template and generate your video. VideoMagic brings your product to life as a polished, ready-to-post video ad. It renders in the background, and your video is waiting in Gallery when it's done.
PUT IT ON AI MODELS
Show jewelry, clothing, bridal looks, eyewear, shoes and bags on realistic AI models in real-life scenes. No model booking, no photoshoot.
UGC ADS WITH AI INFLUENCERS
Pick an AI creator from the library, write your script and choose the voice, language and captions. Get a 10, 20 or 30 second UGC-style video in standard or pro quality.
TEMPLATES FOR EVERY PRODUCT
Hundreds of ready ad templates: jewelry on model, product on model, animated products, scene morphs, product with text, food, bridal and seasonal packs. New templates are added regularly.
GHOST MANNEQUIN & 360° SPIN
- Ghost Mannequin: turn a flat-lay garment into a clean, 3D invisible-mannequin look
- Product 360: upload two angles and get a smooth 360° spin
- Camera Movement: add zoom in, zoom out, tilt and pedestal moves
STORE-READY PRODUCT PHOTOS
Studio-lit product photos for your online store in 9 lighting looks, from soft studio glow to golden-hour shadows.
PROMPT STUDIO
Describe a scene or start from an image. Create text-to-video and image-to-video clips with the latest AI video models.
READY FOR EVERY PLATFORM
Edit in Gallery: extend your video, resize it to 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9, merge clips and add sound effects. Export in HD and share to social media, your online store or any marketplace.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Upload your product photo
2. Choose a template or an AI tool
3. Generate your video and post your ad
WHO IT'S FOR
Online store owners, marketplace sellers, boutiques, jewelry and fashion brands, cafes and restaurants, dropshippers, social media managers and agencies.
NO STUDIO. NO SHOOT. NO AGENCY.
Create ads for every product, campaign and channel right from your phone. Collect free credits with daily rewards and start creating today.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- VideoMagic offers weekly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions that include credits for creating videos.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Idle Dunk Masters is one of a kind hyper casual idle clicker game. Become a legend basketball player!

Idle Dunk Masters also has a lot of collections. Travel to many locations in Idle Dunk Masters hyper casual idle clicker game: School Yard, California, Washington, Arizona, Florida, South Carolina
Transform into the legend basketball player in Idle Dunk Masters. Enjoy throwing balls and become the best basketball player of all time!
Idle Dunk Masters Prestige collection: Alley-Oop, Free Throw Line, Tomahawk, Two Hands, Windmill, Between The Leg, Double Clutch, Rock the Cradle, Off the Backboard, Superman, and more!
HOW TO PLAY Idle Dunk Masters
1 - Tap to throw basketball
2 - End of each level, tap to slam dunk the basketball
3 - Unlock more balls to get the high score faster
3 - Upgrade balls to get more powerful throws
4 - Upgrade player skill to get better stats
5 - Upgrade 10 slam dunk skills: Alley-Oop, Free Throw Line, Tomahawk, Two Hands, Windmill, Between The Leg, Double Clutch, Rock the Cradle, Off the Backboard, Superman
6 - Join Youth, School, College, League, Professional, National cup.
If you love our game. Feel free to give us your comment. If you have any idea to improve the game. Give it to us. We will make it come true.

bluejetty:00015345:ios.summary:
NEW Kharty AI. Say what you want to learn, Kharty creates a game for you!
Kharty turns learning maps and diagrams into an exciting game! Choose from our catalog or easily create your own with AI. Quickly master any diagram with Kharty’s pr
bluejetty:00015345:ios.description:
NEW Kharty AI. Say what you want to learn, Kharty creates a game for you!
Kharty turns learning maps and diagrams into an exciting game! Choose from our catalog or easily create your own with AI. Quickly master any diagram with Kharty’s progressive learning method!
Main Features:
- Download or create your own diagrams
- Multiple and engaging game modes
- Progressive learning
- Track and beat your best records
- Dictation of terms in many languages
- Share your creations with friends, students and the community
- Study offline
Kharty is free to download. To play and create, you need a Kharty+ subscription, monthly or yearly (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial). Kharty+ includes 10 AI Khartys a month; more are available as separate in-app purchases.
No more staring at textbooks, learning is now a game to have fun with: As terms are displayed and dictated, locate them in the illustration before time runs out and don’t make errors to beat your own records. Master what you’re studying and challenge your friends!
Download diagrams, maps or charts: Browse the gallery for any subject, from geography and anatomy to history and vocabulary.
Create your own: It couldn’t be easier, just pick an image and add in your terms, all right within the app. In no time, your new diagram will be available to study with all game modes provided by Kharty. Play and share your creations with anybody: friends, students, classmates or the entire Kharty community!
Progressive learning: Don’t get overwhelmed by complex diagrams, our method makes it easy by focusing on a few terms at a time. As you master each term, more will be added, with checkpoints to ensure maximum retention. You’ll surprise yourself with how much and how fast you learn!
Help us improve! Send us your feedback and diagram suggestions: contact@kharty.com
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.kharty.com/en/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.kharty.com/en/privacy

bluejetty:00144721:ios.summary: Great photos are everywhere you look, and inspiration can come at any time. With ON1 RAW for Mobile you can capture, edit, and organize on the go. The camera captures pro-grade raw format photos with all the manual controls you need. You ca
bluejetty:00144721:ios.description:
Great photos are everywhere you look, and inspiration can come at any time. With ON1 RAW for Mobile you can capture, edit, and organize on the go. The camera captures pro-grade raw format photos with all the manual controls you need. You can edit anywhere too; adjust color and tone using the same raw processing engine as ON1 Photo RAW.
RAW PROCESSOR
You can process your RAW photos you capture on your device as well as ones you import from an attached interchangeable lens camera, hard drive or memory card.
LOCAL EDITING
Make targeted edits to your photos with powerful masking tools. Apply changes to a portion of your image, and adjust those areas with a full range of tone, color, and sharpening sliders. You can apply these adjustments using either the Adjustment Brush or Masking Bug shapes.
RETOUCH
Use the Retouch Brush to remove small imperfections or distractions. The tool looks at the neighboring areas in your image and fills in the brushed area with an area of similar color and texture.
PROFESSIONAL EFFECTS & PRESETS
Pro-grade filters and powerful masking tools. Apply filters like Dynamic Contrast, Black and White, Vignette, an interactive Curves pane and more. Stack multiple filters to build your signature look and masking tools for targeted editing. A curated collection of the best factory presets to speed up your workflow and get professional results with the hottest looks and styles.
ON1 CLOUD SYNC
Access your photos seamlessly between your computers and mobile devices. ON1 Cloud Sync gives you access to your photos to view, organize, edit, and share them between your computers using Photo RAW and your mobile devices using ON1 Photo RAW for Mobile. With ON1 Cloud Sync you unlock all the powerful tools the mobile app offers. 
ORGANIZE
Add star ratings, likes, dislikes, or rejects. Designed to help you find photos in your photo library, based on a variety of criteria specific to photos and the metadata embedded in them. Search and filter your library with text, as well as likes and star ratings. Adjust the grid sort order in a number of different ways

bluejetty:00132052:ios.name: The New York Review of Books
bluejetty:00132052:ios.summary: Since 1963, The New York Review of Books has been the place where the world’s leading authors, scientists, educators, artists, and political leaders turn when they wish to engage in a spirited debate on literature, politics, art, and ideas
bluejetty:00132052:ios.description:
Since 1963, The New York Review of Books has been the place where the world’s leading authors, scientists, educators, artists, and political leaders turn when they wish to engage in a spirited debate on literature, politics, art, and ideas with a small but influential audience that welcomes the challenge. Each issue addresses some of the most passionate political and cultural controversies of the day and reviews the most engrossing new books and the ideas that illuminate them.
The print edition of The New York Review of Books, included in the app, is published 20 times a year. The app also includes all of our online-only content. Articles can be bookmarked for later reading, and the app includes a link to browse our shop, The Reader’s Catalog.
Current print and online-only subscribers receive full access to the app through existing website login credentials (email and password). The app may also be purchased directly through the app store. Purchases made through the app store do not include access to The Review’s website and complete archive.
SUBSCRIBERS’ AUTOMATIC-RENEWAL FEATURE:
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged at the same price for renewal, as stated above, within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Current subscriptions may not be cancelled during the active subscription period, but you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
NOTE: WHEN PURCHASING A SUBSCRIPTION OF THIS TITLE, YOU AGREE TO THE PRIVACY POLICY AND TERMS OF SERVICE WHICH CAN BE VIEWED BY GOING TO:
Privacy Policy: https://www.nybooks.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://www.nybooks.com/about/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00127867:ios.description:
Merge burgers, donuts and more delicious food, and decorate your beloved restaurant. This is a food merge game you can't refuse! Once you start trying Happy Cooking Merge, you will love it! Satisfy your taste buds while merging, start your culinary journey now!
In Happy Cooking Merge, you can:
- Merge various ingredients to make delicious food
- Easy and fun like other merge games
- Keep exploring the next stage of the merger
- Renovate the old rooms
- Choose from many different styles of furniture
- Complete merge missions to get amazing rewards

Merge and Cook - Do you want to run your own restaurant? Here, you can tap the food machine to produce new food, and merge the same food to get more advanced food. Simple and easy to play - just drag two identical foods together and discover new stories!
Decorate your restaurant - combine food, serve your customers and you can earn coins! Let's renovate an old room together, you can choose a variety of furniture for your room. Decorate different styles of rooms and experience different delicious food!
Merge and cook, renovate and decorate, you can experience a different cooking story here, come and experience a different merge game!

bluejetty:00089497:ios.description:
Serene helps you understand yourself better through personalized quizzes, guided journaling, daily insights, and short self-growth courses.
Whether you want more clarity, better habits, stronger relationships, or a deeper understanding of your thoughts and emotions, Serene gives you a simple space to reflect, learn, and grow at your own pace.
Key Features
Personalized Self-Discovery Quizzes Explore your personality, focus style, emotional patterns, relationship habits, motivation, procrastination, communication style, and more. Each quiz is designed to help you notice patterns and better understand yourself.
Guided Courses Learn practical ideas for everyday growth, including emotional awareness, confidence, focus, communication, motivation, boundaries, and relationship skills. Courses are short, structured, and easy to follow.
AI Journal & Reflection Write or speak freely, then receive thoughtful summaries and reflection prompts. Serene helps you organize your thoughts, recognize recurring patterns, and create more clarity in your daily life.
Daily Personal Insights Receive simple, meaningful insights tailored to your self-discovery journey. Use them as a moment of reflection, motivation, or personal reset.
Mood & Pattern Tracking Track how you feel over time and notice what influences your daily energy, motivation, and emotional balance.
Relationship & Communication Tools Explore how you connect with others, express care, handle conflict, and build healthier communication habits.
Popular Topics Include
• Personality and self-awareness • Focus and procrastination • Motivation and habits • Emotional patterns • Confidence and self-image • Relationship communication • Boundaries and personal growth • Daily reflection and journaling • Stress awareness and balance • Burnout prevention and energy management
Serene is designed for personal growth, self-reflection, and educational purposes. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, therapy, or crisis support. For medical advice, please consult a qualified professional.

Privacy Policy: https://upriseapps.com/privacy

AInvest helps investors and active traders find stock ideas, analyze market moves, track watchlists, and make faster decisions with Aime, your AI investing assistant. From stock screening and real-time quotes to AI signals, analyst ratings, portfolio analysis, and market news, AInvest brings the tools you need into one simple investing app.
AI STOCK SCREENER
Find potential opportunities faster with AI-powered stock screening. Build custom stock lists based on technical indicators, fundamentals, analyst ratings, dividends, market trends, and more.
Aime can help you screen for growth stocks, dividend stocks, undervalued stocks, momentum movers, penny stocks, and other market opportunities.
AI INVESTING ASSISTANT
Meet Aime, your AI financial assistant for stock research and investing decisions.
Ask Aime to explain stock movements, summarize market news, compare companies, analyze watchlist stocks, review portfolio trades, calculate valuations, and validate your investment ideas before you act.
STOCK ALERTS & MARKET SIGNALS
Stay closer to the market with timely alerts and AI-powered signals.
Track price moves, bullish or bearish trends, market movers, analyst opinions, news catalysts, and technical signals. AInvest helps you spot important changes without checking the market all day.
PORTFOLIO TRACKER & BROKERAGE SYNC

Use AInvest to review your holdings, analyze portfolio performance, understand trading behavior, and get AI-powered insights based on your investing activity.
STOCK NEWS & MARKET ANALYSIS
Follow the latest market news with fast summaries and AI analysis.
AInvest scans breaking news, earnings updates, market trends, and Wall Street opinions to help you understand what is moving stocks and why it matters.
ADVANCED CHARTS & TRADE SIGNALS
Analyze stocks with simple and advanced charts, technical indicators, and AI-powered commentary.
Use chart signals to identify potential trends, entry and exit points, bullish or bearish momentum, and overvalued or undervalued conditions.
WATCHLIST & REAL-TIME QUOTES
Track US stocks, ETFs, indexes, and global markets in one place.
Follow NASDAQ, NYSE, S&P 500, Dow Jones, DAX, FTSE 100, Nikkei 225, and more with real-time quotes, watchlists, alerts, ratings, and research tools.
PERFECT FOR:
• Investors looking for AI-powered stock research
• Traders who want alerts, signals, and market analysis
• Users tracking portfolios and brokerage accounts
• Dividend, growth, value, and momentum investors
• Beginners who want stock ideas explained clearly
• Active traders who need faster market insights
Try AInvest and make stock research faster, clearer, and easier with AI.

bluejetty:00089081:ios.summary:
Fire up the typewriter, it’s time to play Qwert. Stretch your thumbs and get ready for a new TYPE of word game that will put your vocabulary skills to the test.
In Qwert, there are no letter tiles – it's just you, your brain and the keyboa
bluejetty:00089081:ios.description:
Fire up the typewriter, it’s time to play Qwert. Stretch your thumbs and get ready for a new TYPE of word game that will put your vocabulary skills to the test.
In Qwert, there are no letter tiles – it's just you, your brain and the keyboard. Come up with words based on open-ended prompts like "Starts with A" or "Ends with B" and type as quickly as you can in fast-paced multiplayer matches and brain-training solo games. Challenge friends and opponents in real-time head-to-head battles or fly solo to beat your personal best.
Qwert combines the best features of classic word games and speed typing games and rolls them into one unique and challenging experience! Keep your thumbs nimble with different game modes. Think fast in Time Attack and come up with as many words you can, or slow your roll with Wordplay where the highest scoring word wins. Need a break from the competition? Outsmart the swarm in Splat, a solo survival mini-game, and squash a pesky infestation of flying letters! And in our newest game Daily Definundrum, guess a new word every day based only on its definition and a few hints – it's like Wordle for word nerds!
Qwert offers a new take on word-building games with next-level challenges that will test your vocabulary like never before. Download now and climb the leaderboards to become the next top wordsmith and challenge your own personal best.
Qwert Features:
• 6 unique & challenging game modes
• Daily brain teasers to stretch your hippocampus
• Fast-paced gameplay for a quick-witted fun
• Open-ended prompts that give you the freedom to flex your vocabulary
• A manual typing mechanic that inspires creative, unencumbered wordplay
Multiplayer and Solo Gameplay
• Reinvigorate your word knowledge every day with Daily Definundrum
• Challenge friends in a head-to-head war of words in Time Attack and Wordplay
• Guess textbook definitions of words and see if your bestie knows the meaning of the word "beastie" in Cupid's Arrow
• Become a word sleuth and uncover the missing word in Sentence Case, a hardboiled version of Wordle
• Fly solo in Splat and survive the swarm by forming words with pesky, flying letters
• Climb the leaderboards and beat your personal best
• Develop your vocabulary and increase your hat size
Unique Visuals With Customizable Games
• Enjoy a charming vaudevillian style that's packed with quirky, vintage vibes
• Customize your keyboard and build an impressive dictionary of words with definitions and point value*
• Honk at your opponents with a dedicated horn button, because why not?
Train your brain, boost your vocabulary, and top the leaderboards in Qwert! Download today for a uniquely fun take on word games and prove your linguistic prowess.
*Only available in Qwert premium (in-app purchase).

bluejetty:00032763:ios.summary:
Shark's 5th generation robot can be adjusted from an excellent beginner to a full-scale AI expert player. 
Shark Bridge offers unlimited hands, duplicate bridge games, and Daily Tournament with MP (%) scoring.
Play bridge with friends or pr
bluejetty:00032763:ios.description:
Shark's 5th generation robot can be adjusted from an excellent beginner to a full-scale AI expert player. 
Shark Bridge offers unlimited hands, duplicate bridge games, and Daily Tournament with MP (%) scoring.
Play bridge with friends or practice on your own.
Study the hands of your bridge teacher.
Play deals online from your library, classroom hands, and generator
You can play and review boards with the complete auction and play details from International, North American, and European competitions.
Internet is not required, except for Daily Tournaments and the Online Bridge Club.
Shark Bridge won the 2014 and 2011 World Bridge Computer Championships.
You can email hands to your partner or other bridge friends for discussion if they have Shark or another bridge app capable of opening PBN/LIN files. Share the fun! You can also import bridge deals from your computer disk or the Internet. 
Shark Bridge features:
- Bidding systems: Standard American 5 card major( SAYC or Shark flavor), 2/1 Game Force, Std English Acol (in development) bidding systems.
- Duplicate bridge game.
- Bridge tournament boards.
- Play bridge offline ( no Internet ) or live on the Internet with your friends and foes.
- Never wait for a bridge table to fill in; our high-quality robot will play bridge when needed.
- Hints and auction analysis are available at any time. Ask the Shark Bridge, and it will help.
- Get suggestions when the declarer is on the lead to a trick; Shark will recommend a play strategy.
- Open PBN (Portable Bridge Notation) and LIN ( VU-Graph) files from your email.
- Choose from regular and 4-color card decks.
Bridge Enthusiast In-App purchase ($29.99) upgrade offers:
- Play an unlimited number of random deals.
- 9 WBF, ACBL, and European bridge tournaments from 2014,2013,2011.
- Email bridge hands from your Personal Deal Library.
- Basic Online Bridge Play: create, join, and kibitz at any table.
- Deal Analysis.
- One year free VIP subscription.
VIP subscription ($34.99/year) unlocks additional features and services:
- Daily tournament with 16 boards; compare your skill with the rest of our VIP members. Study the deals from past competitions.
- 32 WBF, ACBL, and European bridge tournaments in recent years, including 2016. More are in the works.
- VIP online play: create, join, and kibitz at any table, manage friends, block players, invite players.
- Par Contract Calculator.
- Personal Deal Library: all saved deals are instantly available to all of your devices.
- Advanced Deal Generator.
- Classroom hands
- Access to The CommonGame hands, via the Classroom hands module
- Highest priority for feature requests.
Bridge Bidding Systems: Standard American 5-card major( SAYC or Shark flavor), 2/1 Game Force, Acol, and Swedish 5-card major bidding systems, and more are in the works.
Each bridge system includes the most popular conventions, and you can further customize it with :
1NT / 2NT range and hand distribution options
Gambling 3NT or strong 25+ HCP 3NT
Stayman
Jacoby and Texas Transfers
Weak two Spades, Hearts, Diamonds
Strong 2 Clubs
Blackwood: 4 Aces / 5 Aces, RKCB, RKC 1430, Exclusion Blackwood
Jacoby 2NT
Sandwich 2NT
Two-way new minor forcing (XY-NT)
Leaping Michaels
Michaels Cue Bid
Maximum Overcall Double
Negative Doubles
Takeout Doubles
Responsive Doubles
Support Double
Splinter Bids
Lebensohl
Unusual 2NT
Drury
DONT
Landy
Multi Landi
BPH
The Shark Play bridge engine was designed and programmed by John Norris, an international bridge master and Danish Bridge Champion.
Shark robot is the most human-like playing bot; it has been tested against professional players and proved a worthy opponent.

bluejetty:00161268:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00161268:ios.description:
“Even when it’s grey outside there’s blue beyond the clouds”
Take control of your fitness, diet and happiness with the Beyond app. With in-app fitness guides, recipes and the ability to journal, Beyond is here to boost your positivity and wellbeing.
With over 1m followers, Meggan Grubb is known for her fun take on fitness and motivation and now, for the first, time, users can access her workout plans and positivity all in one place, combined with an exclusive collaboration with The Good Bite for meal ideas and recipes.
That’s not all!
Beyond is also here to connect you to like-minded users through the community feature. It’s a place to help bring everyone together, to make friends and to discuss a variety of topics and share your own messages of positivity, or wellbeing tips.
Meggan is also here to offer daily messages of positivity and motivational quotes, so you always start your day right!
Look beyond the typical fitness app, diet food and your own constraints - look Beyond:
- WORKOUT GUIDES -
Choose to workout in the home or gym, with guides written by Meg herself. Boost your endorphins and make progress with your fitness with over 30 unique guides, with something to suit you no matter your experience!
- REAL TIME WORKOUTS -
Fancy following Meg’s workout for the day? Take a look at the workout library and get motivated training with Meg in real-time.
- RECIPE LIBRARY -
The Good Bite has collaborated with Beyond for an exclusive library of wholesome food. Choose from simple recipes, to meals that will seriously impress - and with lots of healthy options, your meals will leave you feeling energised and ready to take on the next part of your day!
- PLANNER -
Beyond allows you to plan your day and week in advance. Get prepared for your workouts and switch in and out meals to enable you to use our ‘shopping list’ feature and feel on-top of your week, before it’s even began!
- JOURNAL -
Make time for yourself and change your perspective on your day-to-day life with the Beyond Journal. Choose from questions that will help you reflect, or write your own to inspire positive thoughts
- COMMUNITY -
Support one another with positivity and motivation and share your own recipes or workouts with like-minded users. You can also see updates from Meg and other musings in the community feature!
- SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION -
The download of Beyond is free of charge. Once users register they will have to subscribe in order to get access to the app content. We offer the following auto-renewing subscriptions:
* £11.99 monthly - 7 day free trial
* £27.99 quarterly
* £89.99 yearly
Your subscription will work across your devices and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings within iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, no refunds will be provided for any unused portion of the term.
By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Conditions, which can be found at: https://beyondapp.co.uk/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00130424:ios.description:
CalcMate is a powerful notepad with a built-in calculator that lets you write naturally while solving calculations instantly. Enter numbers, text, percentages, currencies, dates, and units—all in the same note.
Whether you’re calculating invoices, tracking expenses, creating budgets, or making quick estimates, CalcMate eliminates the need to switch between a notes app, calculator, and spreadsheet.
What you can do
• Perform calculations directly inside your notes.
• Calculate percentages, taxes, discounts, and tips.
• Convert currencies and units.
• Calculate dates and durations.
• Create invoices, budgets, bills, and shopping lists.
• Reference previous calculations and keep everything organized.
Try these examples
• 100 + 5 tip
• 1000$ + 20% fee
• 900$ + 20$ delivery + 1.5%
• 500 USD in EUR
• 10 BTC in USD
• Today + 5 days
• Tomorrow + 10 days
• 1 kg in lb
• subtotal — calculates the total of all previous lines
• line5 — uses the result from line 5
• # this is a comment
…and much more.
Features
• Smart note editor with live calculations
• Organize notes with folders
• Trash folder to restore or permanently delete notes
• iCloud sync across your Apple devices
• Optional custom number keyboard
• Optional running total displayed above the keyboard
We’d love your feedback
Have questions, suggestions, or need help?
Contact us at:
lazyboardapp+calcmate@gmail.com

listings.name: CalcMate – Notes Calculator
listings.description:
Stop switching between Notes and Calculator. Type “1000$ + 20% fee” and CalcMate shows the answer instantly, right next to your words.

CalcMate is a notepad with a built-in calculator. Mix numbers, text, percentages, currencies, dates and units in the same note, and every line is calculated live as you type.

Use it for budgets, expenses, invoices, splitting bills, shopping lists, quotes and quick estimates — no spreadsheet needed.

TRY THESE EXAMPLES

• 100 + 5 tip
• 1000$ + 20% fee
• 900$ + 20$ delivery + 1.5%
• 500 USD in EUR
• 10 BTC in USD
• Today + 5 days
• 1 kg in lb
• subtotal — total of all previous lines
• line5 — reuse the result from line 5
• rent × 12 — use saved variables from your Variables list
• 20 #food, then sum(#food) — total everything with a tag
• # this is a comment

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Calculate directly inside your notes, line by line
• Percentages, taxes, discounts and tips
• Live currency and crypto conversion
• Unit conversion: weight, length, volume, time and more
• Date and duration math
• Variables and line references to reuse results
• Calculation tags: sum, average and count lines by #tag
• Running total shown above the keyboard

STAY ORGANIZED

• Folders for every project, trip or budget
• Highlight text in eight colors
• Dividers to start a fresh calculation section
• Share notes as PDF
• Trash to restore deleted notes
• iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad

MAKE IT YOURS

• Custom number keyboard with quick symbols
• Number formatting, precision, font and font size
• Alternate app icons

FREE TO USE

CalcMate is free. You can optionally remove ads or leave a tip to support development.

WE’D LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK

Questions or ideas? Email us at lazyboardapp+calcmate@gmail.com

bluejetty:00154098:ios.description:
Become a CEO and Build Your Farming Empire Today!
Start an exciting journey as the ultimate Farm Manager! Strategize, expand and grow the lands in this immersive farm management game. Whether you dream of running a small farm or ruling a global industrial empire, you create your adventure yourself. Prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers to top the leaderboards by creating the most successful empire.
Key Features
- Fields Worldwide: Choose from over 22 million real-world fields across the globe - all based on actual geographic data. Acquire new farms anywhere and expand your empire!
- Realistic Agriculture Data: Farm Manager leverages real-world inspired data, including pH levels, soil types, contamination classifications and regional agricultural trends. Real-world weather conditions update every hour.
- Realistic Tractor Models: Indulge yourself in vehicle models similar to John Deere, New Holland, Case, Fendt, Ferguson, MAN and CLAAS. Equip your machines with implements to complete essential tasks such as plowing, fertilizing, seeding, and irrigating.
- Diverse Crops: Choose from a growing variety of seeds to plant and manage — each with its own characteristics, needs, and market value.
- Keep Farm Animals: Care for your animals by keeping them well-fed and content. Improve their quality through smart breeding and proper management.
- Dynamic Marketplace: Experience realistic economic scenarios and market fluctuations. Stay on top of supply and demand to buy seed and sell crops at the perfect time!
- Customizable Tractors: Upgrade your farm machines to suit your style and enhance performance.
- Global Connections: Track your farms live in each city on the interactive map.
- Achievements & Rewards: Earn valuable rewards as you grow your business and prove your skills as a top-tier farm manager!
Whether you're delivering farm goods across a single town or creating a multinational supply chain, this Farm Manager tycoon lets you take control of every detail. The immersive interface, engaging gameplay, and realistic mechanics make this the ultimate farming simulator for fans of strategy and management games.
Why Choose Farm Manager?
From strategic decisions to hands-on management, this game offers unparalleled depth for those who love logistics, data, animal and city-building games. Build your empire and prove you’re the ultimate manager tycoon!
Download this Farm Manager tycoon now and start your journey toward farmer greatness!
Note: An online internet-connection is required to play this game.
Please see the Trophy Games Privacy Statement to know more about your data protection at: https://trophy-games.com/legal/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00138721:android.summary:
FCM25 is an in depth Soccer Club Management Game designed for mobile and tablet devices.
FCM25 is the ONLY game available that lets you take on the role of a Chairman, Director, Head Coach or Manager in a fast paced soccer management envir
bluejetty:00138721:android.description:
FCM25 is an in depth Soccer Club Management Game designed for mobile and tablet devices.
FCM25 is the ONLY game available that lets you take on the role of a Chairman, Director, Head Coach or Manager in a fast paced soccer management environment.
Experience Realistic Soccer Club Management as you build your title winning squad and deliver success for the fans
Brand New Features for FCM25
NEW 3D Match Highlights
NEW Replays and Camera Angles
NEW European and World Cup Competitions
NEW Leagues added inc Rest Of Europe League
NEW Countries added
NEW User Interface
NEW Academy/Youth System
NEW Pre-Match Team Talks
NEW Post Match Team Talks
NEW Fans Area
NEW Rewards System
NEW Rating/XP System
and Much More!
BE A CHAMPIONSHIP MANAGER
Now you can take on the role of Manager or Head Coach and handle first team training, tactics and selection as you attempt to take your team to the top
NEW 24/25 SEASON DATA
Accurate player, club and staff data from 24/25 season.
CHOOSE FROM HUNDREDS OF SOCCER CLUBS
Choose from 870 Football clubs in 40+ leagues from 16 different countries across the world. Create your legacy and build your own team from scratch including home country, club, stadium name, and kit design and take them to the top!
MANAGE THE CLUB IN DIFFERENT ROLES
Choose to take on a career as a Sporting Director of, a Manager, a Head Coach or buy the club and be the Chairman/Owner. No other game allows you to manage a club in so many different ways!
UNRIVALLED CLUB-LEVEL SOCCER MANAGEMENT
Manage every aspect of your soccer club’s development and how you invest funds. Develop & upgrade your club's facilities, inc the stadium, fitness centre, medical, training ground, & youth Academy. Increase revenues by negotiating sponsorships. Hire & fire your management team and build your dream squad by negotiating transfers & offers with player agents as well as handling contract negotiations with players and staff alike.
EVERY DECISION COUNTS
Just like in real life, your decisions affect the attitude of the board, team morale, & even the fans. How you engage with press and media, ticket prices, the quality of your squad & the potential of your Academy prospects all have a bearing.
LIFELIKE STATS ENGINE
Comprehensive live-action stats engine mirrors real-life player behaviour and match outcomes, processing over 1000 decisions per game & generates real-time statistics for both individual players and teams.
DEVELOP THE CLUB
Create your own area for the club & develop your stadium, training ground, academy, facilities, fitness centre & medical facilities.
MATCH HIGHLIGHTS
FCM25 shows key match highlights during the game so you can see those key goals and misses!
COMPREHENSIVE PLAYER DATABASE
Buy or loan players from a database of over 30,000 players, each with their own unique play styles, stats, personalities and behaviours. FCM25 continuously generates new players on a regular basis, ensuring you have plenty of talent to choose from whether you’ve been in the hot seat for 1 season or 10! Player cycles continue beyond the pitch as some retiring players go into staff roles just as they do in real life!
FULL EDITOR
FCM25 has a Full in-game editor that allows you to edit team names, ground, kits, players avatars, staff avatars and share them with other players
