ChatApp.AI – Smart Chatbot & Writing Assistant
ChatApp.AI - AI Chat assistant is a powerful next-generation AI chatbot and personal assistant, built on the latest leading AI models including GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, GPT-4o, Grok-4, DeepSeek V3, and Gemini. It understands your questions with high accuracy and delivers fast, human-like responses for writing, learning, research, coding, and everyday problem-solving. By combining the strengths of several advanced AI technologies in one simple app, AI Chat gives you smarter answers, deeper insights, and a more natural conversation experience whenever you need it.
ChatApp.AI is your all-in-one AI companion designed to assist, create, and entertain — anytime, anywhere. Whether you need help writing, solving problems, generating visuals, or just asking questions, ChatApp.AI is always ready.
No sign-up. No hassle. Just type and go.
What You Can Do with ChatApp.AI
• Chat with AI
Get instant, intelligent responses to any question. Learn, explore, or simply have a conversation.
• Write Anything
Generate essays, emails, stories, poems, or social media captions. Say goodbye to writer’s block.
• Create Visuals
Turn your ideas into AI-generated images, including profile pictures, yearbook-style shots, and fun edits.
• Solve Problems
Ask math questions, get code snippets, or receive suggestions for fitness plans and daily routines.
• Play with AI
Try GuessAI, our built-in mind-reading game — fun, smart, and surprisingly accurate.
Built for iOS
ChatApp.AI is deeply integrated with your Apple device for a seamless experience:
• AI Keyboard Extension – Use AI while typing anywhere
• Safari Extension – Chat with AI from your browser
• iMessage App – Get assistance directly in conversations
• Siri Shortcut – Launch the assistant with your voice

bluejetty:00179162:ios.description:
Discover the World of Drone Sounds and Rhythms with Drone Piano
Transform your musical experience with Drone Piano, the ultimate app for creating mesmerizing drone sounds and captivating rhythms. Whether you're a professional musician or just starting out, Drone Piano provides an expansive library of ambient drone sounds and rhythmic loops to inspire your creativity.
From deep, sustained tones to intricate beats, Drone Piano blends traditional piano elements with global rhythms and drone layers, giving you the power to create immersive soundscapes right from your device.
Features:
• Rich Drone Library: Explore a wide range of atmospheric drone sounds, perfect for ambient, experimental, and meditative music.
• Rhythmic Loops: Play along with professionally crafted drum loops and beats from various musical genres.
• Customizable Soundscapes: Layer drone sounds with rhythms and piano to craft your unique sonic experience.
• Real-Time Scale Converter: Use microtonal scales to add depth and complexity to your music.
• MIDI Input Support: Connect your MIDI keyboard and take full control of your compositions.
• Import and Edit Sounds: Bring in your own sounds in Korg KMP or SFZ format and fine-tune them to your liking.
• Advanced FX Section: Enhance your sound with effects like Reverb, Delay, Tremolo, and more.
• Save and Share: Save your favorite sounds and rhythms, and share your creations with the world.
Subscription Plans: Unlock the full potential of Drone Piano with a premium subscription:
1 month: $5.99
1 year: $29.99
These prices are for the US. Pricing in other countries may vary.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• An account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Why Drone Piano? Whether you're meditating, composing, or improvising, Drone Piano brings an extraordinary depth to your music. With its seamless integration of drone sounds and rhythms, it's the perfect tool for anyone looking to explore new sonic landscapes.
Download Drone Piano today and start your journey into the world of drone music!

bluejetty:00084763:ios.description:
Celebrate every phase of your maternity journey with our Cloudine App
Experience the 3 Cs of Cloudnine — Clinical Excellence, Comprehensive Care, and Celebration — all in one place.
Designed for your convenience, the Cloudnine app brings expert care right to your fingertips — no more waiting in queues!
Key Features
Manage Appointments
Easily schedule in-person consultations, video consultations with doctors, lab tests, and scans — all in just a few taps.
Consult from Anywhere – Online Appointment Booking
Connect with leading Cloudnine specialists from across the country via secure video consultations, regardless of your location.
Home Care Services
Access premium services from the comfort of your home — including pharmacy delivery, baby vaccination and flu vaccinations, ear piercing and more.
Track Pregnancy Milestones
Stay informed about your body and your baby’s development with our detailed Pregnancy Growth Tracker.
Monitor Child Growth & Vaccinations
Never miss a vaccination with our intuitive Vaccination Chart, and keep track of your child’s development using our Kid Growth Chart.
Access Medical Records
View all your prescriptions, invoices, scans and lab reports — securely stored and accessible anytime, anywhere.
Explore Premium Delivery Packages
Discover, compare and book our premium maternity packages directly through the app.
Health Tips & Expert Blogs
Read curated articles, doctor advice, and wellness tips tailored for every stage of pregnancy and parenting.
Live Events & Webinars
Join interactive webinars and online sessions hosted by trusted healthcare professionals — all accessible through the app.
Ovulation Tracker
Log your symptoms, track your menstrual cycle, and receive personalized insights with our smart ovulation tracker.
Online Shopping for Pregnancy & Baby Care products
Access our expertly-curated collection of products from trusted brands with Momeaze – Cloudnine’s own online shopping store. Find the best deals on diapers, baby formula, feeding essentials, nursery & gear, bath, skincare, and more.
Mamas Community
Connect with fellow Moms and Expecting Mothers to discuss and share experiences of your journey. Get your queries answered by our doctors in Q&A with experts.
Note: The information provided in the app is generic in nature. Please consult your doctor for personalised medical advice.

bluejetty:00074612:ios.name: Naija Whot
bluejetty:00074612:ios.summary: Naija Whot is an exciting, classic and healthy card game for everyone. It is simple to play. Become a winner by finishing your cards before the beast in your palm. It keeps you comfort when it's needed and your mind focused when you are idl
bluejetty:00074612:ios.description:
Naija Whot is an exciting, classic and healthy card game for everyone. It is simple to play. Become a winner by finishing your cards before the beast in your palm. It keeps you comfort when it's needed and your mind focused when you are idle. The artificial intelligence keeps it challenging all the time.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO PLAY
To play Naija Whot is not difficult. 
We have two decks: Market and Played decks.
When it is your turn, you must drop a card that is of same type(Image) or same number with the card played by your opponent. For instance, if your opponent drop Triangle11, you can either play a Triangle irrespective of the card number or you play any other card with same number(11). If you don't have any matching card to play, you must pick a card from the MARKET DECK.
A player who first finish his cards is declared winner.
Apart from the above scenario, we have some ACTION CARDS. The action cards are: 
1. Hold On = any card with number(1). It puts every player on hold thereby giving you opportunity to play again.
2. Pick Two = any card with number(2). The next player can either defend the card or pick two cards from market deck.
3. Pick Three = any card with number(5). The next player can either defend the card or pick three cards from market deck.
4. General Market = any card with number(14). All the player except the player who dropped the card must pick one card from market deck.
5. Suspension = any card with number(8). Suspends the next player.
6. Crown = any card with number(20). Request any card of your choice.
The above configuration is by default. They can be changed to any number of your choice.
In TOURNAMENT, when game ends, cards are counted and a player with the highest number is eliminated.
CRITICAL RULE
Star card face value is always doubled during card counting. For examples:
* Star1 = 2
* Star2 = 4
* Star3 = 6
* Star4 = 8
* Star5 = 10
* Star7 = 14
* Star8 = 16
TIP: Avoid keeping STAR cards during tournament.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GAME FEATURES
**QuickPlay mode --- our old style. You and one artificial person
**Tournament mode ---- compete with three artificial persons (Wazobia)
**Multiplayer mode ---- play with one of your friends ONLINE or OFFLINE. This mode supports two players only.
***Defence ---- you can now defend special cards (turn it on from settings).
****Continuous play ---- this feature is only available in Tournament mode. You can decide whether game continues even when you lose (Enable it from settings).
And many more.
****You can now configure your game the way you want
You can turn on/off all or any of the special cards(pick two, pick three, general market, hold on, suspension, Whot). Just enter game settings and you are good to go.
****Anthem can also be enabled/disabled to your choice.
****Reset scores and coins when needed.
****Turn on/off avatars(images) at your will
****French language is added. It can automatically detect your device default language and switch between English/French language respectively.
******Many more

bluejetty:00042028:ios.name: Playground: AI Design & Editor
bluejetty:00042028:ios.summary: Type what you want — a logo, a t-shirt graphic, an SVG cut file — and Playground designs it in seconds. Edit it in plain English, remix until it's exactly right. More than 9 million people have made over 1 billion designs here. No design sk
bluejetty:00042028:ios.description:
Type what you want — a logo, a t-shirt graphic, an SVG cut file — and Playground designs it in seconds. Edit it in plain English, remix until it's exactly right. More than 9 million people have made over 1 billion designs here. No design skills needed.
From logos and t-shirt graphics to cut files, social posts, wallpaper, and memes, Playground is like your very own, always available graphic designer.
STUNNING AI TEMPLATES
• No more "blank page" — hundreds of highly customizable templates that become unique designs in seconds
• Generate professional designs for your business and hobbies: logos, social posts, stickers, signs, t-shirts, mockups, even custom memes
• Remix any image with dozens of styles for a completely different vibe in a single tap
• Remove backgrounds and upscale in a tap for crisp, print-ready artwork (included with Pro)
• Resize your design and Playground's AI recomposes it to fit the new dimensions
FROM SCREEN TO CUTTING MACHINE
• Turn any design into an SVG vector file and fine-tune it in a built-in vector editor — scale it to any size for cutting machines, large-format printing, or signage (included with Pro)
• Describe it and it appears: monograms, decals, and designs sized for vinyl, sublimation, tumbler wraps, and iron-on transfers
• Start from a photo in your camera roll — restyle it into artwork, a sticker, or a design ready to cut
CHANGE ANYTHING WITH AI
Pick a template, then tell Playground what you want: "Make the cat into a dog." "Add the text 'Happy birthday, Henry!' at the top." "What if the scene were Halloween-themed?" Make as many revisions as you like.
When you're happy with it, erase the background, upscale it, then export it wherever it needs to go.

bluejetty:00139624:ios.summary:
Plan your day with the reminders and calendars you already use. GoodTask builds on Apple Reminders and Calendar, bringing your to-do lists, schedule and projects together.
"a masterful blend of power-user task management features and the i
bluejetty:00139624:ios.description:
Plan your day with the reminders and calendars you already use. GoodTask builds on Apple Reminders and Calendar, bringing your to-do lists, schedule and projects together.
"a masterful blend of power-user task management features and the inherent simplicity of Reminders."
- Federico Viticci, MacStories, on GoodTask for iOS (2018)
Start with a simple checklist. Add Smart Lists, flexible views and Quick Actions as your needs grow. Use iCloud to keep your reminders and calendar events in sync across devices.
PLAN A DAY THAT WORKS
Choose what to work on in Today Page without changing your tasks' due dates. See your calendar events alongside your plan, then use Next Page to focus on one task or subtask at a time. Set a focus timer and look back on completed work and daily notes in Reports.
FIND WHAT NEEDS YOUR ATTENTION
Create Smart Lists that bring together tasks from different lists. Filter by dates, priorities, tags and more to see what matters now: overdue work, errands or the next steps in a project. Update a task wherever you find it, and the change stays with the original reminder.
SEE YOUR WORK YOUR WAY
Switch between list, day, week and month views. Organize tasks in kanban-style boards by date, priority, list or tag. Use Matrix View to compare priorities in four customizable quadrants, or Project View to follow tasks and events across dates.
SPEND LESS TIME ORGANIZING
Capture tasks with presets and text snippets. Customize Quick Actions to reschedule work, change priorities, move tasks between lists or add tags. Make changes to several tasks at once with bulk actions.
SIMPLIFY RECURRING WORK
Break tasks into subtasks, set flexible repeating schedules and save reusable Templates for routines such as a weekly review or packing for a trip.
KEEP YOUR PLAN CLOSE
Personalize colors, fonts and task displays. On iPhone and iPad, use widgets to keep your lists in sight. On supported iPhones, follow a focus session with Live Activities on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. The Apple Watch companion lets you check tasks and add new ones from your wrist when used with an iPhone.
RECOGNITION
GoodTask for iOS was named Federico Viticci's App of the Year in MacStories Selects 2018 and featured in the App Store's Apps We Love.
FULL ACCESS
Try GoodTask for 14 days without starting a subscription. To continue afterward, choose the one-time Unlock Everything in-app purchase or the optional GoodTask Supporter subscription. The Mac app is sold separately.
ABOUT SUBSCRIPTIONS
- GoodTask Supporter is an optional auto-renewing subscription with a one-year term. It provides full access while active and supports continued development.
- The subscription price is shown before purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the applicable annual subscription price.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Learn more: https://goodtaskapp.com
Support: contact@hahaint.com
Terms of Use: https://hahaint.com/tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://hahaint.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00183643:ios.name: SC Mobile Pakistan
bluejetty:00183643:ios.summary: About SC Mobile: The new and improved SC mobile app offers a fast, secure, and user-friendly mobile banking experience, designed to take care of its customers banking needs on the go anytime, anywhere ! Indulge in effortless app interface
bluejetty:00183643:ios.description:
About SC Mobile: The new and improved SC mobile app offers a fast, secure, and user-friendly mobile banking experience, designed to take care of its customers banking needs on the go anytime, anywhere ! Indulge in effortless app interface to get customized alerts, quick access to statements, dashboards, cards management, making online bank transfers & much more. Prime features & services: Home with Glance: With just one swipe, get access to all your financial transactions. Transfer funds, pay bills, manage your accounts and cards from the home screen, view account balances in real-time and much more! Fast, Secure & Easy Access: Enhances digital security enables you to login with touch/face ID without the need of PIN or password New modern look and feel with simplified navigation and faster loading times so that banking becomes a quick and easy experience. QR Pay: Make the best of the QR pay for quick & easy payments at merchant Hassel-free Payment: Transfer funds instantly between your SC account or other accounts by selecting Local Transfer & other payment methods; Add beneficiary at ease and transfer funds without registering a beneficiary (RAAST). Manage Cards Easily: Apply for a credit card right from the app, pay credit card bills & even block/hotlist credit or debit card. All Products under one roof: Enjoy the convenience of digital banking at your fingertips, open & apply for Cards, Accounts, Fixed Deposits & term Deposits and other product offerings in the market without any hassle. Effortless & Convenient Bill Payments: Pay utility bills, Credit Card bills, Electricity bills, Insurance bill & Mobile bills & pay for recharge, instantly. Even set up scheduled funds transfer and set standing orders so you don’t miss any payment. Insta Account Opening: Non-SC Bank customers can now Open an account in a few simple steps. Download the app and click on open an account today! And SC Bank customers can apply for product of their choice with their data pre-filled for the convenience of easy application submission. Locate us: Locate nearest Standard Chartered ATM or Branch by just over a click Other Services: Our new services on SC Mobile App allow you to bank on your fingertips without having to visit a branch or calling the client centre. Register for SC Mobile today and enjoy unlimited convenience. Learn more on the new release:
 ^ Order a Cheque Book & Activate – You can order a cheque book through SC Mobile and receive at your mailing address. You can also activate your cheque book through the app.
 ^ Stop Cheque – You can instantly stop your cheques , single or multiple, or the entire cheque book through the app. We strive to keep your finances safe and secure. 
 ^ Manage Debit Card – Control your card usage at your convenience. Choose yourself to enable/disable channels or increase/decrease your limits – all in just a few taps.
 ^ Debit Card issuance – order a new card or replace damaged card on your fingertips
 ^ Credit Card Block and Replacement – Credit Card lost or stolen? You can now block your Credit Card instantly and get it replaced through the app.
 ^ Signature Capture – New to bank? Want to update your signature? You can add or update your signature for all your accounts through the app.
 ^ Pay Order – Request for Pay Order through SC Mobile App, save yourself a trip to branch.
 ^ Bank Certificates – Request for Account maintenance, Withholding tax, PRC certificates from SC Mobile App & receive at your email address!

The world tells us that freedom is doing whatever you want, whenever you want, with whomever you want: to do your own will.
True freedom, however, is to do God's will. Freedom is for worship, sacrifice, and love.
Men, if you’re tired of being held back by the comforts and distractions of our time and desire to grow closer to God, Exodus 90 is the path you’ve been searching for.
Since we started in 2015, more than 250,000 men have experienced new freedom. Take the first step, join the brotherhood, and download the Exodus 90 app today.
It's time to break free from the modern Pharaohs that keep us enslaved. By living a life of prayer, asceticism, and fraternity, you will become more of who you are, a son of God who has been called forth by the Father to experience his love and to give that love to others. 
Why Exodus 90?
• Exodus 90 is effective. More than 99% of Exodus Men report growing in freedom from unhealthy attachments.
• Exodus 90 increases men's faith satisfaction, helps them spend 46% more time in prayer, and increases their participation at church.
• Exodus 90 provides an action plan for spiritual growth year-round. Learn to stand firm in Christ Jesus through St. Michael's Lent (starts August 12, 2026), pray for our departed brothers and sisters during the Month of the Dead (starts October 31, 2026), and join us for the Exodus 90 Challenge (starts January 11, 2027). Become the man God created you to be. 
Download the app today to begin your 14-Day Free Trial. After the first two weeks of your spiritual journey, you'll be invited to join Exodus+.

Why MEGATEXT Stands Out Among LED Display Apps
MEGATEXT offers flexibility and creativity unmatched by other scrolling text apps. It’s perfect for marquee displays at events, digital signage for businesses, or even just fun personal messages.
Download MEGATEXT Now
Start creating your own professional scrolling text and marquee displays. Download MEGATEXT today and turn your device into a versatile LED text display.

bluejetty:00137113:ios.summary:
Elevate your music practice with customizable backing tracks generated with audio from real instruments (guitar, mandolin, and standup bass).
Strum Machine can play any chord progression, in any key, at any speed. It's the only backing-tra
bluejetty:00137113:ios.description:
Elevate your music practice with customizable backing tracks generated with audio from real instruments (guitar, mandolin, and standup bass).
Strum Machine can play any chord progression, in any key, at any speed. It's the only backing-track app built specifically for players of bluegrass, old-time, fiddle tunes, and other such genres. (Although it works pretty good for some jazz/swing now, too!)
Why musicians of all levels love Strum Machine:
• Realistic Sound: Backing tracks are assembled in real time from studio-quality instrument recordings.
• Quick Adjustments: Instantly adjust the speed/tempo, change the key, loop part of a song, etc.
• Auto-Speedup: Gradually increase the BPM at the end of every repetition for training purposes.
• Chord Reference: Clean, beautiful chord charts, which can be displayed in letters or numbers (i.e. "1-4-5").
• Extensive Library: Over 1,300 songs (mostly from bluegrass and old-time) ready to go, with thousands more posted on the community forum.
• Simple Song Editor: Add your own songs (or edit existing ones) in minutes. Almost every chord you can play on a guitar is available for use.
• Customize the Band: Choose from a variety of built-in band styles, then optionally customize each instrument individually – adjust the strumming pattern, add automatic bass runs, and more.
• Organize & Share: Create song lists for practicing or even performing, and share them with your friends or on the community forum.
• Cross-Platform: Sync your custom songs, lists, and preferences with any device you use Strum Machine on: phone, tablet, or computer. (It works offline, too!)
• Responsive Support: If you run into any problems or have questions, write us an email or post a message on the forum and someone will get back to you within a few days!
Strum Machine is under active development and we're always working on ways to make the app even more useful to our users... while keeping it uncluttered and intuitive first and foremost.
Discover how Strum Machine can improve your music practice today! Download Strum Machine and play a handful of demo songs instantly, without signing up. For the full experience, including access to all built-in songs and the ability to create your own, start a free trial.
Terms of Use: https://strummachine.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://strummachine.com/privacy

Ne
bluejetty:00185065:ios.description:
Nepali FM Radio is one stop iOS app for all Nepali with more than 200 radios from Nepal and more than 100 audio books that you can download to listen offline. Nepali FM is the first Nepali iPhone app for Nepali radios published in 2009.
Nepali FM Radio has not only all the videos from Nepali TV and Nepali songs but also the latest news from different news portal including but not limited to Kantipur, Onlinekhabar, Nagariknews, Himal Khabar, Saptahik and from many other sources for daily breaking news, educational news and filmy news.
Nepali Calendar/Bikram sambat partro is also a part of Nepali FM where you can convert BS to AD and vice versa, find all the incoming festivals and occasions, daily currency conversion (USD, AUS, GRB to NRS) and daily Rasifal.
"BBC Nepali Sewa", Kantipur FM, Kalika FM and Hits FM are few popular radios along with Lok Radio and many other online and regional radios stream here in Nepali Radio FM .
You will find Nepali jokes, Type in Nepali, Nepali written stories, Nepali poems, Nepali gazals and muktak, load shedding schedule and everything about Nepal, you name it.
You don't need another app. Nepali FM is a universal app that means you can use your iPad, iPhone, or iPod and enjoy unlimited Nepali music.
Features:
-----------------------------------------------
- Close to 200 online Nepali Radio (Recordable and Bluetooth enabled)
- It has many Nepali Radio like lok radio, lok geet,classic geet etc. 
- More than 5000 Nepali songs for streaming on demand.
- Nepali Recorded Audio section with fast-forward/backward functionality with download option.
- Video section with popular TV Serial eg: Tito Satya, Meri Bassai, Jire khursani, Bhadragol, Nepali Movies and so many other videos related to Nepal.
- Add your favorite radio on your favorite list.
- Current Nepali Time and weather
- Nepali Jokes ( Hathi kamila, Sere, Buda budi etc)
- Type in Nepali, Nepali stories and daily gold price.
- Nepali ukhan tukka and child stories.
This application includes "Kantipur FM", "Hits FM", "Kalika FM ", "Sagarmatha" and many more Nepali FM stations. Not all Nepali FM stations stream 24/7 so you can hear only when they stream live.
This is the app you need if you want to know everything about Nepal, Nepali News and Nepali ways of doing things. Don't wait, Install it and enjoy the depth of Nepali Music on iOS devices.
• E-cards: Create shareable Nepali greeting cards with themes, background photos, and your own gallery images. Optional Nepali FM branding; remove the logo by watching a rewarded ad.
• Nepali Translate: Full-sentence English ↔ Nepali translation with an easy language swap.
• Offline dictionary: Look up words without the internet.
• Type in Nepali: Quick access from the home shortcuts.
• Radio: Refreshed home with search, category chips, recent stations, and popular picks.
• Samudaya, News, and more: Community and web content in one place, plus games and tools.
• Stability and performance improvements.

bluejetty:00077113:ios.description:
Transform your body, confidence, and mindset to get lasting results with LEANSQUAD's workout challenges! Whether you're a beginner or fitness pro, Phil Mackenzie will coach, motivate, and sweat alongside you every step of the way! Get the motivation you have been looking for to make this fitness journey be the one that lasts a lifetime!
Founded by former professional athlete Phil Mackenzie, LEANSQUAD’s core focus has always been to change the narrative in the health and fitness space. As a father to 4 boys aged 5 and under, Phil wants to help everyone incorporate exercise and healthy eating in a way that is sustainable, realistic, enjoyable and most importantly works with real life!
In turn, this approach has helped 10’s of thousands of mothers, entrepreneurs, students, business men and women achieve incredible results both physically and mentally. No matter how crazy your lifestyle, LEANSQUAD will transform your life!
The workouts are short, effective and unbelievably motivating. The recipes are simple, tasty and incredibly enjoyable. Most of all, the support and motivation is constant. You will never be alone on your fitness journey.
Burn Fat. Build Confidence. Transform Your Life.
Once you join with a paid subscription, you will get full access to all of the following features:
Flex Challenges: Customize a challenge to your liking by choosing how many days per week you want to workout, which workouts, and whether you want them with or without music. Build a challenge that fits your schedule and watch yourself transform!
30 Day Lean Challenges: Lean Foundations, Lean Hypertrophy, Lean Sculpt & Tone and Accelerate Your Leanness
Over the course of the 30 Days your body and most importantly your confidence, energy levels and happiness will transform!
- Stream five 30 minute workouts per week on demand, with two guided recovery sessions
- No equipment required (workout from home, outdoors, or at the gym)
- For beginners to workout pros, with low impact modifications and optional dumbbell finishers
6 Week Lean Challenges: *Phases 1 - 20
Incorporate weights into your daily workouts! Each session in your 6 Week Lean Challenge is specifically designed to build off your progress from your previous workout. Press play and follow along as we complete 5 dumbbell workouts and 2 guided Leancovery sessions (bodyweight yoga-style) per week.
- Stream five 30 minute workouts per week on demand, with two guided recovery sessions
- Weighted workouts that build on previous progress to help you build, sculpt and tone lean muscle unlike ever before
- High tempo HIIT Style to ensure we are burning fat while building muscles to give you toned and lean look
- Body Part Specific Dumbbell Finishers
21 Day Low Impact Challenge *Phases 1 - 6
The 21 Day Lean Low Impact Challenge is a low impact, jumping free, equipment free, lean challenge created to get your body, confidence and life back to its best in just 21 minute workouts.
- Stream five 21 minute workouts per week on demand, with two guided recovery sessions
- Equipment free, jumping free workouts that are perfect for anyone!
*CUSTOM MEAL PLANS*
- Hundreds of easy, tasty and healthy recipes that are tailored to your body and dietary preferences
- Pre-calculated macronutrient and portion size breakdown for your body
- Recipes for meat eaters, vegetarian, dairy free and gluten free
*DAILY PLANNER*
- Plan your meals and workouts for the week
- Get reminders to stay on track
- Stay accountable by extending your Lean Streak
- Access to hundreds of workouts you can do at home, the gym, or on vacation
- Listen to curated running workouts on the go

bluejetty:00019124:ios.summary:
Happy Color® is a relaxing color by number game with over 40,000 FREE high-quality pictures. From nature and fashion to iconic Disney scenes and artworks, there’s something for everyone.
Color by numbers can reduce stress and help you to u
bluejetty:00019124:ios.description:
Happy Color® is a relaxing color by number game with over 40,000 FREE high-quality pictures. From nature and fashion to iconic Disney scenes and artworks, there’s something for everyone.
Color by numbers can reduce stress and help you to unwind. Just tap and color – anytime, anywhere.
Reasons to download Happy Color®:
FIND PICTURES YOU LOVE
Happy Color® now includes a powerful search feature, that helps you explore the world of paint by number. 
Search, discover, and color the pictures that matter to you, whether it’s your hobbies, passions, or favorite topics. That’s what makes our coloring book so special – everyone can find joy in coloring what they love most.
UNIQUE DISNEY CONTENT
Happy Color® collaborates with world-renowned studios to bring you unique content. Rediscover unforgettable moments and color some of your favorite characters in iconic scenes from Star Wars, Disney's Beauty and the Beast, The Lion King, Aladdin, Cinderella, Winnie the Pooh, and many more in Happy Color®.
NEW POSTCARDS CATEGORY
Happy Color® brings you a brand-new category, Postcards—a truly special way to experience paint by number. Color postcards, add a heartfelt note, and share your creations as thoughtful messages to friends and family: a thank you, a wish, or just a warm hello. Turn coloring into a gesture of love and attention.
NEW DESIGN & THEMES
We’ve refreshed the design of Happy Color® to make it even more enjoyable and easier to use anytime, anywhere. Another nice addition is our 4 atmospheric themes: Milky Mist, Pink Dawn, Calm Water, and Warm Night. Create a cozy space for coloring for adults and make every paint by number session more comfortable for your eyes.
COLOR ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
No Wi-Fi needed. Play this coloring game at home, on the go, or during a quick break – coloring fun is always just a tap away.
COLOR FOR A GOOD CAUSE
Happy Color® partners with trusted, high-impact charitable organizations around the world. By coloring special pictures, our users can take part in making a difference and contribute to meaningful causes – you color, we donate.
ART MADE BY REAL PEOPLE AND PROFESSIONAL ARTISTS
Over 100 talented artists worldwide create hand-drawn pictures exclusively for Happy Color®. Each picture in our coloring book reflects human creativity and care.
FREE FOR EVERYONE
All 40,000+ pictures are absolutely FREE. We believe everyone deserves access to high-quality, inspiring paint by number content without paying a cent.
Give yourself a moment to relax and light up your life with Happy Color®.
With Happy Color®, you can be part of a global community of coloring enthusiasts, in a safe space where joy and creativity can be shared.
We're constantly working to improve. Share your feedback at:
support@happycolorapp.com
Join our community and share your creations:
Facebook: https://mobile.facebook.com/happycolorbynumber/
Instagram: https://instagram.com/happycolor_official
Terms of Use: https://xflowgames.com/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://xflowgames.com/privacy-policy.html
Happy Color® includes many unique pictures handmade by professional artists, as well as pictures of famous characters, comics, cartoons, etc., owned by well-known studios.

Running out of storage? Let Total Cleaner do the hard work.
Thousands of photos, screenshots, videos and duplicate files quickly build up over time. Total Cleaner makes it simple to reclaim valuable storage space and organise your device without spending hours scrolling through your photo library.
Whether you want a quick clean-up or prefer to review your memories one at a time, Total Cleaner gives you fast, intuitive tools to stay organised.

► Photos & Video Cleanup (PREMIUM)
► Swipe Cleanup (PREMIUM)
► Duplicate Contact Finder (PREMIUM)
Total Cleaner Premium Features include:
Photos & Video Cleanup
► Free up valuable storage space
► Remove duplicate, similar and burst photos
► Quickly clear unwanted screenshots and videos
► Organise your photo library in just a few taps
Swipe Cleanup
► Review photos and videos one at a time with simple swipe gestures
► Keep the moments that matter and remove the rest in seconds
► Browse media month-by-month for manageable clean-up sessions
► Receive gentle monthly reminders to help keep your photo library organised all year round
Duplicate Contact Finder
► Find and merge duplicate contacts
► Tidy cluttered contact lists
► Manage contacts across iCloud, Gmail and other accounts
By signing up to a premium account you will be able to activate your subscription and enable our powerful features.

Renewal of your annual Total Cleaner subscription is automatic. You can cancel this automatic renewal at any time, at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
Payment is charged to your App Store Account
Subscriptions are managed on iOS devices by tapping Settings > tap your name > Subscriptions. You will be able to see when your next payment is due, or cancel your automatic renewal.

bluejetty:00131152:ios.name: Dawnbeat - Sampler
bluejetty:00131152:ios.summary:
Dawnbeat inherits the best part of the classic hardware samplers and takes it further by adding features only possible on a multi-touch device. 
Create more natural patterns by tapping and swiping pads. 
Focus on creativity, you don't need
bluejetty:00131152:ios.description:
Dawnbeat inherits the best part of the classic hardware samplers and takes it further by adding features only possible on a multi-touch device. 
Create more natural patterns by tapping and swiping pads. 
Focus on creativity, you don't need to select a tempo before hit record to finally play a pattern until you get the right take, just play and forget about to record! Dawnbeat is always recording! 
Multi-touch and draggable pads:
- Pads are multi-touch, play a single pad with two fingers at the same time!
- Pads are individually configurable, allowing re-triggering when dragging for amazing fills, tone variations .
- Mute and Solo buttons for pads available.
- Mute groups.
Memorizer:
- DawnBeat is always recording pad events, you'll never miss a beat, play and experiment and when you hear something you like, it's already recorded! simply go to Memorizer and select the desired events. 
BRIIKS sampler:
 - Advanced loop manipulator. Rearrange and combine your loops. Also available as standalone, AUv3 and MacOS.
Mixer:
- 4 assignable BUSSES and one MAIN BUS. Assign pads to busses, assign internal effects or AUV3 effects to busses. 
- Mute and Solo buttons.
Polyphonic pads:
- Pads can be turned polyphonic, import a piano-like sample and play and sequence chords with a single pad.
MIDI IN and MIDI OUT:
- Trigger samples from a MIDI controller, play melodies from a MIDI piano. 
- Sequence hardware drum machines and synths from Dawnbeat.
- Use Dawnbeat as an intermediary between a midi keyboard and a synth, save the sequences you are playing. Dawnbeat can save poliphonic sequences!
Pattern sequencer with piano editor. 
- Swing, count-in, metronome. 
Audio Units:
- Dawnbeat support AUv3 effects and instruments! 
Built in Effects:
- Reverb, Delay, Compressor, Flutter, Gate, Tremolo, Noise, Filter, Chorus, Equalizer, Stutter and Tape slow motion. 
- Effects can be rearranged.
Built-In sample browser:
- 6 drum kit sample libraries, and 1 bass sample library.
Selectable internal sample rate:
- Internal sample rate can be changed, choose between HI-FI and LO-FI sample rates.
AUTO-SLICER:
- AutoSlicer detects hit points and slices audio into individual files minimizing the need for manual editing. Chop up any audio file in a few seconds.
Recording sample rate can be selected.
Export movies with images and animated GIFs .

bluejetty:00070897:ios.description:
Telemundo Chicago es una app de noticias locales en español, clima y alertas para la comunidad hispana de Chicago e Illinois. Mantente informado con noticias de última hora, pronósticos, radar en vivo, alertas meteorológicas, cobertura electoral y transmisiones en vivo.
Recibe cobertura local confiable en una sola app. Sigue noticias de Chicago, Aurora, Joliet, Naperville y Cicero, además de inmigración, política, elecciones, tráfico, seguridad pública, nieve, tormentas y clima severo.
Personaliza tus alertas de noticias, clima y elecciones según tu zona.
¿Por qué usar la app de Telemundo Chicago?
Si vives en Chicago o Illinois, Telemundo Chicago te ayuda a estar informado de noticias locales, clima, inmigración, elecciones, nieve y radar en vivo.
¿Qué puedes hacer con la app de Telemundo Chicago?
Sigue noticias locales de Chicago
* Recibe alertas de noticias locales, nacionales e internacionales
* Sigue inmigración, política, seguridad pública y tráfico
* Lee artículos y mira videos de Telemundo Chicago
Sigue las elecciones en Chicago e Illinois
* Obtén cobertura de elecciones locales y estatales
* Sigue elecciones de Chicago e Illinois
* Infórmate sobre primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales
* Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados
Consulta el tiempo para Chicago
* Mira condiciones actuales y alertas meteorológicas
* Accede al pronóstico de 10 días para Chicago e Illinois
* Consulta pronósticos por hora
Usa los widgets del tiempo
* Agrega widgets a tu pantalla de inicio
* Ve condiciones actuales según tu zona
* Toca el widget para ver el pronóstico completo
Sigue el tiempo con radar en vivo
* Accede a radar en tiempo real

bluejetty:00132043:ios.description:
Everything you need for the next solar eclipse, all in one app! Introducing Solar Snap: a camera filter + app combo that can help you take amazing photos of the sun, whether there’s an eclipse, or any other day. Simply attach the filter to your phone, open Solar Snap, and snap away! Solar Snap also includes an interactive, offline global solar eclipse simulator, with detailed information and times to prepare you for the next eclipse, no matter where you are, where you are going, even if you don't have a signal!
Solar Snap can be used with our Solar Snap filter kit available at: https://www.eclipseglasses.com/products/solar-snap-the-eclipse-app. This filter protects your phone camera from damage by the bright sun. You may optionally re-use old eclipse glasses by cutting a pair in half and taping it over your camera lens. Video instructions by Astronomer Doug Duncan included in the app.
Total solar eclipses are crossing Europe and the Middle East in 2026 and 2027. Get ready!

bluejetty:00093315:ios.summary: SONU provides personalized, drug free, acoustic resonance therapy to treat nasal congestion symptoms caused by allergic and non-allergic rhinitis. SONU is backed by FDA authorization, extensive clinical trials, and enhanced by AI. SONU work
bluejetty:00093315:ios.description:
SONU provides personalized, drug free, acoustic resonance therapy to treat nasal congestion symptoms caused by allergic and non-allergic rhinitis. SONU is backed by FDA authorization, extensive clinical trials, and enhanced by AI. SONU works with iPhone X or later models and uses Bluetooth to connect with your iPhone. 
To get started simply download the app and follow the on-screen instructions to get to your 15 minute treatment session. You can choose to relax with the gentle micro vibrations or go about your daily activities. The SONU app takes a scan of your face using the front facing camera and personalizes the acoustic therapy based on your facial anatomy and other proprietary factors. The acoustic resonance is delivered via medical grade bone conduction transducers in the SONU band (a lightweight, wearable headband purchased separately). 
SONU is proven to be safe and effective and also has a history of your treatment sessions in the app so you can track your usage over time. 
Medical Disclaimer: This app does not replace or provide medical advice and diagnosis. Always seek the advice of a physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. 
Regulatory Jurisdiction: The SONU band is authorized for use by regulatory authorities only in the USA (FDA) and Singapore (HSA). 
Any feedback? Contact us at https://soundhealth.life/contact/
Additional information including the privacy policy, biometric notice and terms of use can be found at https://soundhealth.life

bluejetty:00027200:ios.summary:
From the developer of 'Read by QxMD', 'The ECG Guide' and 'Pedi STAT' comes 'Calculate', a next-generation clinical calculator and decision support tool, freely available to the medical community.
"We recommend medical users try the free C
bluejetty:00027200:ios.description:
From the developer of 'Read by QxMD', 'The ECG Guide' and 'Pedi STAT' comes 'Calculate', a next-generation clinical calculator and decision support tool, freely available to the medical community.
"We recommend medical users try the free Calculate by QxMD first..."
-from iMedicalApps review "The best free Medical Calculator apps for the iPhone"
'Calculate' highlights tools which impact clinical practice either by simplifying diagnosis, clarifying treatment options or displaying prognosis.
Helping you make decisions, not just calculate numbers...
Features
• Developed by a collaboration of clinician experts from diverse backgrounds
• Point-of-care tools in the areas of cardiology, internal medicine, primary care, nephrology, hematology, hepatology, gastroenterology, emergency medicine, oncology, orthopedics, critical care/ICU, ENT, radiology, rheumatology, mental health, respirology, neurology, pediatrics, infectious disease, neurosurgery, general surgery, vascular surgery, and obstetrics.
• Converts recent research publications into practical handheld tools - knowledge translation at its best 
• Automatically adapts to your clinical practice
• Unique ‘Question Flow’ technology gets you answers, fast
• Detailed references with PubMed & Read integration
• Comprehensive and insightful results
• Elegant design and intuitive interface
• SI and Imperial units
More than 200 unique calculators and decision support tools
While too extensive to list them all, here is a small sampling of included content:
Guide treatment
• Determine cardiovascular risk using ACC/AHA, Framingham, Gupta and VQI Cardiac Risk Index
• CHADS2 & CHA2DS2-VASc to guide treatment in atrial fibrillation
• Understand bleeding risk in atrial fibrillation using HAS-BLED & OBRI
• TIMI risk score in ACS
• CIWA in alcohol withdrawal
• Rule of 9s & Parkland formula in burns
• Water deficit in hypernatremia 
• Timing of surgery with Aortic Stenosis Risk Score
• Risk stratify pneumonia (CURB-65, PORT)
• NIH Stroke Scale in acute stroke
• Imaging in possible subarachnoid hemorrhage with Ottawa SAH Rule
Determine Prognosis
• Cirrhosis (MELD, Child-Pugh)
• Chronic Kidney Disease (Kidney Failure Risk Equation)
• Heart failure
• Lymphoma (NCCN-IPI, IPI24, R-IPI)
• Myelodysplastic Syndrome (IPSS-R, WPSS)
• Myeloma (ISS, R-ISS)
• Hemodialysis
• COPD (Bode)
• Pancreatitis (BISAP, Ranson's)
• Cardiac surgery (Euroscore II, Cleveland Clinic, Mehta)
• Critical care (APACHE II, SOFA)
• Neurologic outcome (DRAGON, CAM-ICU, modified Rankin, FOUR score, Hunt & Hess)
Calculate
• Ideal body weight, BMI and BSA
• Due date and gestational age
• Extensive formula used in echocardiography and invasive hemodynamic monitoring
• Kt/V in dialysis patients
• eGFR with CKD-EPI, MDRD & Schwartz
• A-a gradient
Classify
• Angina (CCS)
• Congestive heart failure (NYHA)
Screen
• Diabetes
• Breast cancer
Reduce and predict perioperative complications
• WHO Surgical Safety Checklist
• Predictive models for cardiac surgery, vascular surgery and coronary angiography
• Postoperative Respiratory Failure Risk score
Manage
• Head, neck, ankle and knee injuries (NEXUS, Ottawa ankle/knee, Canadian C-spine and CT head rules)
• DVT and PE (PERC, Wells, PESI)
• Pulmonary nodules
• TIA (ABCD2)
Stage
• Lung cancer
• Renal cell carcinoma
• Head & neck cancers
Understand
• TTKG in hypokalemia and hyperkalemia
• Dermatomes
Diagnose
• Heparin Induced Thrombocytopenia
• Infective Endocarditis
• ARDS
• Autoimmune Hepatitis
• Sleep disorder (Epworth Sleepiness Scale)
And much, much more...
Researchers, contact us to see your research in our app at contact@qxmd.com
Founded my medical professionals, QxMD Software is dedicated to creating high quality, point-of-care tools for practicing health care professionals. Recognized as a leading developer of free medical software for mobile devices, QxMD develops content in cooperation with expert physicians from their respective fields.

bluejetty:00186495:ios.summary:
Introducing your secret weapon for learning a new language…

Build a deep vocabulary with thousands of picture flashcards
• T
bluejetty:00186495:ios.description:
Introducing your secret weapon for learning a new language…
LingoPix is a vocabulary building system that combines pictures, audio, and interactivity to make words memorable.
Build a deep vocabulary with thousands of picture flashcards
• Tap the picture to hear the word for it spoken by a real person. 
• Tap again to hear it pronounced s-l-o-w-l-y.
• Trying to remember a word and want a hint? Rub the empty area of the flashcard to reveal the word letter by letter.
Learning words with pictures is great!
• Pictures help your brain connect the letters and sounds of a new word with its meaning.
• They enable immersive learning. See just the words of your new language along with pictures to explain them. Keep away words in your native language.
• Learning with pictures is casual and digestible. When you have a little downtime, instead of picking up your phone for something mindless, treat your brain to a few new words.
LingoCam. A fun new way to learn the words for things around you.
Just point your camera at an object and hear the word for it spoken aloud. LingoCam operates with AI object recognition built with machine learning. A telescope lets you see faraway things. A microscope lets you see small things. LingoCam lets you see things in a new language.
Perfect your accent with Speech Studio
Record your voice, then hear your pronunciation compared with the teacher’s. You’ll be amazed as your accent melts away.
Learn anytime with hands-free mode
Press the Play button and cycle through words hands-free. Learn while exercising, doing housework, or cooking.
Smart shuffle. Like a pipeline to pour words into your long-term memory.
Smart shuffle is a unique spaced repetition system where each word to learn has a temperature. New words start “hot”. Hot words are reviewed frequently. “Cold” words are reviewed periodically, enough to retain them in long-term memory. 
Make an action plan
Within seconds, create a personalized action plan to target the most useful words in the language. Just pick a goal and date, tap a button, and plot a course over the coming days and weeks to reach your goal. Receive a reminder on days of the week you’ve chosen for learning. Open the app and find a pack of “words for the day” prepared for you.
Customizable flashcards
With different program modes, you can choose to:
• practice recognition of words from writing or from speech.
• practice recall of words from memory.
• fine-tune your accent.
• repeat words many times in a row, when you want something to play in the background.
A roadmap through the language
LingoPix has an enormous database of pictures. Build a deep vocabulary, or explore a variety of topics that interest you. What excites you? Food? Travel? Shopping? Sports and games? Technology? A day at the beach? Or want to brush up on important words for school or your profession? LingoPix has a word pack for that. And it’s not just pictures… LingoPix offers audio cards for important words and conversational phrases that aren’t visual.
Night Review
Review everything that you saw earlier in the day. Perfect to reinforce words in your mind before you go to sleep.
Flipboards
A flipboard is an interactive overview of a collection of words. Each word has a tile on a gameboard. One side shows the word you are learning. The other side shows its translation. Tap tiles to flip them to the other side.
iCloud Sync
Sync your learning progress and plan across all your iOS devices. 
4500 pictures and 6000 audio cards:
English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Mandarin Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Arabic, Russian, Hebrew, Greek, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Swedish, Dutch, Irish Gaelic, Hungarian, Catalan, Indonesian, Tagalog, Cantonese, Vietnamese.
600 pictures and 1200 audio cards:
Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Czech, Croatian, Romanian, Malay, Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi
Enjoy learning words with LingoPix!
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

Whether you're selling online, marketing digitally, or sharing
bluejetty:00022687:ios.description:
Creatic is an easy-to-use and powerful graphic design editor, perfect for anyone looking to create stunning social media posts, flyers, collages, logos, wallpapers, and more. 
Whether you're selling online, marketing digitally, or sharing on social media, Creatic has you covered. Get your design superpowers today!
Amazing Templates
• Make stunning designs with one click.
• Use high-quality templates for Instagram posts, Facebook posts, Insta layouts, IG Story, phone wallpapers, and more.
• Grow your business by using professional cards, invitations, banners, flyers, logos, and profile pictures. Create custom wallpapers and contact posters to enhance your social media presence.
• Access elements like filters, fonts, stickers, shapes, vectors, brushes, color palettes, and gradients.
Photo Editor
• Use fabulous effects and filters to enhance your photos.
• Utilize features like background remover, transform, perspective, and shadows for professional-quality edits.
• Extract an element from a photo and save it as a shape for future use.
• Edit with advanced tools like Selective Color, Curves, Color Balance, and Color Tint.
• Adjust brightness, contrast, film grain, vibrance, shadows/highlights, blur, and more.
• Enjoy an ad-free and watermark-free editing experience.
Vector, Text, and Logo Maker
• Create illustrations with pen, node, and smart shape tools to make stunning vector art.
• Organize custom color palettes and gradients in folders.
• Add and edit text with custom fonts, color palettes, or gradients, and use curved text to match any shape.
• Easily import/export SVG files for seamless vector graphic work.
• Save vector shapes and organize them in folders for easy access.
• Mask with brushes any part of the shapes to create unique designs.
Powerful Drawing
• Draw using custom brushes and color palettes for personalized artwork.
• Utilize the Predictive Brush to assist you while drawing.
• Use the VectorPaint tool to create highly precise drawings.
• Save highly customizable brushes and organize them in folders.
• Load your own brush shapes and textures to add a personal touch.
• Fill your line work with ColorFill for vibrant illustrations.
Unlimited Layers
• Add unlimited layers with blend modes and opacity for complex designs.
• Use clipping masks for non-destructive editing.
• Mask with brushes for every layer to achieve detailed effects.
• Merge, duplicate, hide/show layers, and more options for flexible editing.
• Import layers from other templates to build intricate designs.
Colors and Folders
• Manage templates, images, brushes, vectors, fonts, gradients, and color palettes with the Folder Manager.
• Import/export, arrange, duplicate, delete, and rename your content effortlessly.
• Use the colors manager to import and export color palettes and gradient palettes.
• Edit colors with the color wheel, square, and values.
• Utilize the classic gradient manager with palettes for smooth gradients.
• Guides, rulers, and grid to assist in real-time design work.
Social Media
• Create unique profile pictures and collages for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Snapchat, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and more.
• Design high-quality aesthetic videos in one tap with our new animator tool.
With Creatic, you can seamlessly merge creativity and functionality. Whether you need a poster maker, flyer maker, wallpaper creator, or logo maker, Creatic provides all the tools you need to bring your vision to life. Create stickers, design custom wallpapers, and make professional contact posters with ease. Draw, edit, and customize your art with advanced vector and text tools, making Creatic your go-to art editor for all graphic design needs.

Privacy Policy: https://creaticapp.com/term-of-use/

support@creaticapp.com

Get new experiences of searching jobs professionally on mobile with VietnamWorks – Job Search application. With only one app on your devices, you will able to find the best jobs in the fastest way, easily apply for jobs and create your own online resume, impress employers and get a dream job right from your smartphones.

SEARCH JOB ON THE GO
- More than 6,000 jobs posted daily with 71 categories in Vietnam and International. 
- Search jobs by keywords, locations and filter by many more criteria: industry, salary, level, …
- Fulfill of information from employers, job descriptions and benefits for each job post.
JOB ALERT NOTIFICATION 
- Easily create “Job Alert” with your own criteria.
- Receive new job notifications matching with your expectations daily and be the first one to apply for best jobs.
CREATE ONLINE RESUME FASTER 
- Create your own online resume within 1 minute.
- Easily update or edit your profile, such as: working experiences, skills, education, … 
THE EASIEST WAY TO APPLY FOR BEST JOBS
- Apply jobs in just one step.
- Save your favorite jobs and apply later.
Job searching is now easier than ever with VietnamWorks - Job Search mobile application. Grab your next career opportunity and get hired today!
VietnamWorks is the leading and longest-running online recruitment in Vietnam. We understand that job-seekers come to us not only for a job, but for an opportunity to realize their professional dreams and move up in their careers. We, the Dream-Makers, are here to help. With 98,000 job opportunities just only in 2016, the largest of any job website in Vietnam, and thousands of in-depth career tips on VietnamWorks.com, we are here to make your dreams come true.

bluejetty:00159745:ios.description:
Nail those popular dance trends that you've always wanted to learn, and get automatic real time feedback as you do them. Groovetime makes learning and taking dance challenges like a video game!
Whether you're dancing solo, having fun with friends, or taking on the world, Groovetime brings the joy of dance right to your fingertips. Explore the world of trending dances as seen on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, match the moves, and unleash your inner dancer. Groovetime is an addictive dance experience that'll have you grooving all day long. Say goodbye to endless scrolling and hello to endless dancing. Download Groovetime now and make every moment a dance floor!
FEATURES:
> Our AI Groovetracker tracks your moves as you dance, and gives you a fun score that helps you know when you've nailed the moves! It's a great tool for learning.

> A feed of dance challenges tailored just for you. The more you bookmark your favorite dances, the more we personalize your feed.
> Search our huge library of past and trending dance challenges. You can even search by the difficulty level of the dances. We have over 1,000 dance challenges from all over the world!
> Weekly contests featuring the latest viral dance challenges added every week.
> A safe environment for dancing. We've made sure that every reaction you experience from others is always positive. Plus you get to control who sees your dance submissions.
Groovetime offers endless fun and entertainment. It's also an amazing workout. You need dance in your life. Try Groovetime now. Stop scrolling and start dancing!

bluejetty:00185702:ios.name: Link-a-Pix: Nonogram Links
bluejetty:00185702:ios.summary: Find the way clues are linked, paint the paths and discover a hidden pixel-art picture! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clue-pairs in various places. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by linking the clues and painting the p
bluejetty:00185702:ios.description:
Find the way clues are linked, paint the paths and discover a hidden pixel-art picture! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clue-pairs in various places. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by linking the clues and painting the paths so that the number of squares in each path equals the value of the clues being linked together.
Link-a-Pix are exciting logic puzzles that form whimsical pixel-art pictures when solved. Challenging, deductive and artistic, this original Japanese invention offers the ultimate mix of logic, art and fun while providing solvers with many hours of mentally stimulating entertainment.
The game features a unique fingertip cursor which enables playing large puzzle grids with ease and precision: to create a link, press and hold fingertip anywhere on the screen, wait until cursor fills the square and start dragging to neighboring squares. To delete a link, double-tap or use the eraser button above the puzzle.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Link-a-Pix contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 125 free Link-a-Pix puzzles in color and B&W
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Puzzle shop continuously updates with new content
• Manually created by artists, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Grid sizes up to 100x160
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Enlarge, reduce, move puzzle for easy viewing
• Exclusive fingertip cursor design for solving large puzzles
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Show errors during gameplay
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Link counter option for easy link length viewing
• Auto-solve starting clues option
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Link-a-Pix have also become popular under other names such as Paint by Pairs, Enigma, PathPix and Pictlink. Similar to Picross, Nonogram and Griddlers, the puzzles are solved and the pictures revealed using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00127052:ios.name: touchscaper
bluejetty:00127052:ios.summary: Touchscaper is an instrument designed for anyone who wants to make music on their iPad simply by touching the screen. You don’t have to be a serious musician to enjoy touchscaper, but if you are, touchscaper is highly configureable under t
bluejetty:00127052:ios.description:
Touchscaper is an instrument designed for anyone who wants to make music on their iPad simply by touching the screen. You don’t have to be a serious musician to enjoy touchscaper, but if you are, touchscaper is highly configureable under the hood.
Main features:
• Multi-touch based interface with “radar”, “ribbon” and keyboard surfaces
• Touch the screen to play a note, move your fingers to change the sound
• Semi-generative engine selects the “good notes” for you
• Touch movement can control volume and pan for each individual note
• Total control over chords, keys and scales (fully chromatic)
• Multiple chords can be generated from keys and scales to create “scenes”
• Chord "navigator" helps you create inspiring chord progressions
• 40 built-in sounds can be combined in 2 layers to create “instruments”
• Built-in sounds include samples from moodscaper, pianoscaper, numerous analog synths and guitars
• Comes with preset example scenes and instruments
• Random instrument generator function with one tap of a button
• Hold and orbit modes for hands-free evolving soundscapes
• Ribbon style keyboard with touch vibrato
• Chord looper with Ableton Link support
• Arrangement view for longer / more complex chord progressions
• 16 step probability-based sequencer for touch, drums, percussion and synth automation
• "jam grid" sequencer view for live performances
• Supports file sharing for scenes and instruments
• Built-in effects including ping-pong delays, reverb, limiter and EQ
• Supports IAA (Inter-App Audio) as a generator
• Control other music apps using MIDI out and CCs with optional MPE support
There are several demo videos in circulation which should give you a better idea of what touchscaper can do - just search for “touchscaper”.
*** Please note that this app is now in maintenance mode / updates for bug fixes only. This is due to the heavy dependency on deprecated technology such as IAA ***

bluejetty:00174916:ios.name: The Secret To Money
bluejetty:00174916:ios.summary:
The Secret to Money is an app that is designed to change the way you think about money, and to radically change the circumstances of money in your life.
Inspired by Rhonda Byrne's worldwide best selling phenomenon, The Secret, in this app
bluejetty:00174916:ios.description:
The Secret to Money is an app that is designed to change the way you think about money, and to radically change the circumstances of money in your life.
Inspired by Rhonda Byrne's worldwide best selling phenomenon, The Secret, in this app you will develop a whole new perspective on your own personal finances and potential to live a life of abundance.
The Secret to Money is a personal development program of games and daily activities created by Rhonda Byrne herself, featuring 6 powerful Secret-inspired practices that will help you develop a wealth mindset:
DESIRES
PURCHASES
MANIFESTED MONEY
DAILY INSPIRATIONS
AFFIRMATIONS
GIVING
DESIRES: In this practice, you create a list of 7 things you would buy if money were no object. This "Secret" list reminds you of why you want more money in your life, and what it would actually feel like to have the things you desire most.
PURCHASES: In this practice, you will change your mindset about money by spending large amounts of money in your imagination. Every day, you will receive virtual checks in escalating amounts from the Bank of the Universe, as first introduced in The Secret book. Using your imagination, you “spend” each check on whatever you want or need, and record these purchases within the app. Currencies are localised for each country and set according to the language and location setting on the phone or tablet.
MANIFESTED MONEY: In this practice, you record all the ways that you have manifested money today - money you have received, saved, were gifted or refunded. You will be surprised by how much "Secret" money you begin to manifest every day that you are practicing The Secret to Money.
DAILY INSPIRATIONS: When it comes to money, a little bit of inspiration goes a long way towards increasing the money in your life. In this daily practice, you will receive inspiring, financially themed messages drawn from The Secret books in order to help you change the way you think about money. Each inspiration is available to share.
AFFIRMATIONS: Affirmations are positive statements that you make to create a positive mindset and change your life on a particular subject. In this daily practice, you will read 25 unique affirmations of wealth and abundance inspired by The Secret to help change your money mindset.
GIVING: In this practice, you record all the ways that you have given to others - charitable donations, tips, gifts and giveaways, covering the check at dinner, or buying coffee for a friend. You will be surprised by how much you give to others every day that you are practicing The Secret to Money.
The Secret to Money was designed specifically for you as your invitation to use The Secret in order to live the life of your dreams. As Rhonda says herself:
"Like many people, I was brought up with the belief that money is hard to come by, and that you have to work really hard for money. I even had the belief that I would never have much money because my family didn’t have money.
"All these beliefs came from just one belief – a belief in a lack of money.
"So, in 2004, while researching for The Secret film, I created many different money practices and invented lots of imaginary money games in order to change my belief in a lack of money to a belief in an abundance of money. I committed to these practices, and did them every day. And today, there is no lack in my life whatsoever.
"The Secret team has taken my life-changing money practices that took me from lack to abundance and put them into The Secret to Money App. The App is simple, practical, and designed to radically change the circumstances of money in your life, as it did for me."
Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Mandarin.

bluejetty:00131842:ios.name: Speed Tracker. Pro
bluejetty:00131842:ios.summary:
Speed Tracker is the most elegant and unique combination of GPS speedometer and Trip computer in just one application.
Speed Tracker is YOUR answer to the eternal questions: What is my speed? What distance have I covered? How much time did
bluejetty:00131842:ios.description:
Speed Tracker is the most elegant and unique combination of GPS speedometer and Trip computer in just one application.
Speed Tracker is YOUR answer to the eternal questions: What is my speed? What distance have I covered? How much time did I spend from work to home? How to share my trips with friends and relatives?
With lot of features built-in, Speed Tracker will help you to gather all the necessary trip statistics. Just start the application and it will let you record your speed, time, distance, heading, elevation and many more.
HUD
Head-up display – outstanding feature available ONLY in Speed Tracker application. Just enable HUD and put your iPhone or iPad under the windshield. Specially designed HUD interface will display the most accurate speed right on the windshield.
Map your trip.
Built-in GPS tracker will help you not to get lost. You can always switch to navigation mode and check your current position on the map together with the track you’ve already traveled in Satellite or Hybrid view. 
Trip Log
You don’t remember the trip or how much time does it take to visit your friends or the distance to your office? - Trip Log will help you!
Trip Log records and saves the information within the application. You can easily have the access to ALL the trips with just one click. Inside the Trip Log you can check the trip on the map, see the speed, average speed, maximum speed, distance, total time and the detailed speed graph. Don't want to get lost in all the trips you have? Just name them the way you like. Want to share your driving experience or just compare your every day trips? With Trip Computer it’s easy as A, B, C.
Export all the trips in available formats (CSV, KML, GPX) or even share with your friends on Facebook, Twitter or via email.
Trip Computer
Track important trip statistics in real time. Average and Maximum speed, distance covered, moving and stopped time.
Dashboard Display Layout
Designed exclusively for iPad big screen it shows all the important trip information at a glance on a single screen and supports both portrait and landscape orientation. Full screen GPS Navigator Map mode is also available. Landscape mode allows you to mount your device horizontally on your car dashboard. If you prefer seeing things at wider angle then you find new landscape mode especially useful and practical.
Scalable Speedometer Dial
Speed Tracker features unique scalable speedometer dial. Select the maximum possible speed for you vehicle and watch your speed with greater precision either your are on a plain, train, car, bike, boat or bicycle
Statistics
All the aggregated data from the very first trip will be saved in one single place.
Automatic Stop Detection
Automatically identify either you are moving or standing and calculate your average speed basing on that. Generate trip report showing travel and stoppage time separately.
Support for Apple Watch.
Start and stop tracking and see your trip data on your wrist.
NOTE:
Speed Tracker is not compatible with WiFi only iPad or iPod touch.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.
Data connection is required to see map.
Make sure that you have location services enabled for the application. To enable - Settings> General> Location Services
Privacy Policy: http://appannex.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023486:ios.description:
Sua seguradora em um só lugar: seguros, apólices, pagamentos, assistência 24h e benefícios 
O aplicativo da Tokio Marine Seguradora foi desenvolvido para oferecer mais praticidade, segurança e controle na gestão dos seus seguros. Com uma experiência simples, rápida e intuitiva no iPhone, você acessa apólices, consulta coberturas, realiza pagamentos, emite segunda via, aciona assistência 24 horas, abre sinistro online e aproveita benefícios exclusivos em um único app. 
Tenha seus seguros sempre à mão em um ambiente digital seguro, com documentos, serviços, pagamentos e vantagens reunidos em uma jornada mais prática. O app Tokio Marine facilita sua rotina, reduz burocracias e oferece mais autonomia para cuidar da sua proteção quando e onde precisar. 
O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NO APP TOKIO MARINE: 
CONSULTA E CONTRATAÇÃO DE SEGUROS 
Consulte suas apólices ativas de forma rápida, prática e segura, com acesso a informações importantes dos seus seguros. Visualize coberturas contratadas, vigência, documentos, dados da apólice e detalhes essenciais para acompanhar sua proteção no dia a dia. Utilize os canais digitais disponíveis para contratar novos seguros diretamente pelo app, com mais autonomia, conveniência e menos burocracia. 
PAGAMENTOS, SEGUNDA VIA E APPLE PAY 
Realize o pagamento de parcelas das suas apólices diretamente pelo aplicativo, com praticidade e segurança. Pague uma parcela ou múltiplas parcelas dentro do app utilizando Apple Pay, Pix, cartão de crédito ou boleto. Emita segunda via de apólices e parcelas com poucos toques e mantenha seus seguros em dia com mais facilidade, controle e agilidade. 
ASSISTÊNCIA 24H E SINISTRO ONLINE 
Acione a Assistência 24 horas de forma rápida sempre que precisar de suporte. Realize a abertura de sinistro online de forma digital, diretamente pelo app, com uma jornada simples, direta e acessível. Acompanhe o andamento do sinistro com mais transparência, praticidade e controle em cada etapa do processo. 
CLUBE DE BENEFÍCIOS: TOKIO INDICA 
Acesse o Tokio Indica, o clube de benefícios da Tokio Marine Seguradora. Aproveite descontos, ofertas especiais e vantagens em parceiros nacionais. Além de gerenciar seus seguros, você conta com benefícios pensados para trazer mais economia e conveniência ao seu dia a dia. 
CULTURA E LAZER: TOKIO MARINE HALL 
Aproveite condições especiais na compra de ingressos para o Tokio Marine Hall. Tenha acesso a experiências de cultura, lazer e entretenimento com vantagens para clientes Tokio Marine. O app reúne serviços de seguro, benefícios e facilidades para tornar sua jornada ainda mais completa. 
DESTAQUES DO APLICATIVO 
Centralização: acesse apólices, documentos, pagamentos, segunda via, assistência 24h, sinistro online, contratações e benefícios em um único app. 
Segurança: utilize um ambiente digital protegido, desenvolvido para preservar a privacidade dos seus dados e das suas informações. 
Agilidade: conte com uma navegação simples, intuitiva e rápida para resolver o que precisa em poucos toques. 
Praticidade: gerencie seus seguros diretamente pelo iPhone, com mais autonomia e menos burocracia. 
Conveniência: pague parcelas, consulte informações da apólice, abra sinistros, acione assistência e aproveite benefícios sempre que precisar. 
Experiência digital: tenha uma jornada moderna para cuidar dos seus seguros, realizar pagamentos, acompanhar solicitações e acessar serviços essenciais da Tokio Marine Seguradora. 
Baixe agora o aplicativo da Tokio Marine Seguradora e tenha seus seguros, apólices, contratações, pagamentos, assistência 24h, sinistro online, segunda via, documentos e benefícios sempre à mão. 
Tokio Marine Seguradora. Mais praticidade, segurança e tranquilidade para cuidar dos seus seguros em um só app.

bluejetty:00152183:ios.summary:
Goat Deeper: Dive Into the Weirdest Text-Based TTRPG Ever Made
Welcome to Goat Deeper, a text-based role-playing game where the chaos of tabletop RPGs meets a world of absurd humor, unpredictable dungeons, fearsome dragons, and ridiculous
bluejetty:00152183:ios.description:
Goat Deeper: Dive Into the Weirdest Text-Based TTRPG Ever Made
Welcome to Goat Deeper, a text-based role-playing game where the chaos of tabletop RPGs meets a world of absurd humor, unpredictable dungeons, fearsome dragons, and ridiculous glory. Create your hero, explore the bizarre medieval city of Trublion, and survive the depths of a dungeon that was never meant to be opened.
Inspired by classic tabletop role-playing games, Goat RPG combines dice rolls, meaningful choices, unpredictable adventures, and AI-powered storytelling.
Craft Your Hero. Shape the Story. Embrace the Chaos.
Choose your race, your class, and even your phobias (cats, perhaps?). Build a character with quirks, scars, and an uncanny sense of destiny—or at least hunger. In Goat Deeper, every decision has consequences, and sometimes those consequences involve being eaten by a giant frog.
A Text-Driven TTRPG Like No Other
Fully interactive storytelling with branching paths and unpredictable events.
Deep role-playing mechanics inspired by classic tabletop adventures.
Eat. Equip. Explore.
Manage hunger, loot absurd weapons, and gear up to survive bizarre traps and questionable encounters.
Just survival, storytelling, and satire.
Hilarious Companions, Weird Conflicts
Meet companions with absurd personalities and conflicting goals. Mages who explode. Warriors with stage fright. Goblins with too much to say.
Dying Is Part of the Fun
Death isn’t the end. In Trublion, you’re digested by oversized toads and resurrected—slightly confused, but mostly intact.
Goat Deeper is 100% free to download and play. Dive as deep as you want, replay as many times as you like, and explore every strange branch of the story.
Daily Gems & Goat Gold
Every day, you’ll receive free gems to keep your adventure going. A daily usage limit applies to free players.
For even deeper chaos, Goat Gold is an optional subscription that gives you a monthly stash of gems. The number of gems varies depending on your subscription plan. Gems don’t stack and will expire at the end of each subscription period.
Your dumbest and greatest adventure starts now.
Download Goat Deeper and experience a world of cursed loot, questionable decisions, and dungeons that definitely need safety regulations
Questions or suggestions? Contact us at contact@goat-deeper.app
Privacy Policy: https://www.storia-ai.app/goat-deeper/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.storia-ai.app/goat-deeper/terms-of-use
