bluejetty:00119890:ios.description:
ARD Sounds. Der Playbutton für deinen Tag. Die kostenlose Podcast App für Deutschland: exklusive ARD Podcasts, spannende Hörspiele, Hörbücher kostenlos, Live-Radio und verlässliche Nachrichten – alles in einer Audio-App. Für unterwegs, zu Hause oder auf Reisen. Hier bist du verbunden mit den Stimmen, die du liebst – aus deiner Region und aus der ganzen ARD-Welt und dem Deutschlandradio.
Entdecke eine neue Art des Hörens: emotional, informativ, inspirierend. Ob Krimi für die Autofahrt, True-Crime-Podcast, Fußball-Live-Reportage oder Kinderpodcast zum Einschlafen – die ARD Sounds App bringt dir Audio auf höchstem Niveau, wann und wo du willst.
Deine kostenlose Podcast & Radio App
• Podcasts auf Deutsch: Politik, Kultur, Wissen, True Crime, Dokus, Comedy, Sport und mehr – alle wichtigen ARD Podcasts in einer App.
• Hörbücher & Hörspiele: Fantasy, Klassiker, Romane und Kinderhörspiele – viele Inhalte kannst du kostenlos streamen und zum später Hören merken.
• Live Radio: Höre deine Lieblingssender wie NDR 1 Niedersachsen, WDR 2, SWR3, BR-Programme oder Deutschlandradio jederzeit live – Digitalradio in bester Qualität.
• Nachrichten & Live-Sport: Von NDR Info über BR24 bis zu großen Sportereignissen – bleib mit aktuellen News, Hintergründen und Reportagen immer auf dem Laufenden.
Mehr Komfort beim Podcast Hören
• Podcasts offline hören: Lade Folgen herunter und nutze die App als Podcast Player – perfekt für Bahn, Flugzeug oder unterwegs ohne Empfang.
• Eigene Playlists & Merkliste: Erstelle persönliche Playlists mit deinen liebsten Podcasts, Hörbüchern und Radiosendungen.
• Weiterhören auf allen Geräten: Mit deinem ARD-Konto synchronisierst du Favoriten und Verlauf zwischen Smartphone, Web und anderen Geräten.
• Intuitive Bedienung: Finde schnell neue Podcasts kostenlos auf Deutsch – nach Thema, Sender oder Stimmung.
Radio & Podcasts in einer App
ARD Sounds bündelt das Beste aus Podcast, Hörspiel, Hörbuch und Radio: die Programme von BR, HR, MDR, NDR, RBB, Radio Bremen, SR, SWR, WDR und dem Deutschlandradio in einer modernen Radio App.
Für alle, die Audio lieben
ARD Sounds ist deine App für Podcasts, Hörbücher, Hörspiele, Live-Radio, Nachrichten und Wissen – mit Tiefe, Herz und Haltung. Für alle, die Qualität schätzen. Für alle, die gern hören. Für alle, die verbunden bleiben wollen – mit den Stimmen, die sie lieben. Jetzt kostenlos herunterladen und eintauchen.

REACH AMAZING NEW HEIGHTS 
- Complete 1500+ interesting quests
- Play 90 hidden-object and puzzle-solving mini-games

bluejetty:00144667:ios.description:
OENO By Vintec is your virtual cellar management app and personal sommelier, powered by Vivino.
With OENO, wine lovers can effortlessly keep track of which wines they have, where they are located in their cellar(s) and know how to enjoy them at their best – with expert recommendations on when to open bottles, serving temperatures, decanting and glassware.
Whether you have a wine cabinet, a cellar, or even just a rack or a place where you keep your wines, OENO allows you to create a replica of your storage space so you can enjoy your wines at their best!
HOW IT WORKS
1. CREATE a virtual replica of your wine cellar(s)
2. SCAN labels and see detailed information about wines
3. MANAGE your collection and keep track of your bottles
4. PAIR wine & food. Get recommendations of wines from cellar to match your meals
5. BUY wines and restock your collection directly from the OENO app (Powered by Vivino Market).
WHY ‘OENO’?
The app is named OENO ('eno') after the Goddess of Wine. According to Greek mythology, Oeno was the great-granddaughter of Dionysus, God of the Grape Harvest and Winemaking, who gave her the power to transform water into wine.
‘Oeno’ (UK) is commonly used as a prefix for words semantically connected to wine such as in oenology, the study of wine – or oenophile, a wine lover.

bluejetty:00144933:ios.description:
Digital Purse is a digital payment platform that provides easy access to virtual cards and digital gift cards for online use. It is built for individuals and businesses who need a simple way to pay for products and services on the internet without relying on traditional physical cards.
With Digital Purse, users can instantly create virtual cards that work like regular cards and can be used on a wide range of websites and mobile applications. These virtual cards are suitable for online shopping, subscriptions, advertising platforms, software tools, travel bookings, and other digital services. Each card can be used immediately after creation, allowing users to make payments without delays.
Digital Purse virtual cards are flexible and easy to manage. Users can create multiple cards for different purposes, making it easier to organize spending across subscriptions, business tools, or personal purchases. Cards can be used for both one-time payments and recurring charges, depending on the user’s needs.
In addition to virtual cards, Digital Purse offers digital gift cards from popular global brands. These gift cards can be used to pay for apps, games, entertainment, digital content, and online shopping. Digital gift cards are delivered instantly and can be redeemed directly on supported platforms, making them convenient for personal use or as gifts for others.
Digital Purse is designed to be simple and accessible. Users can manage their virtual cards and gift cards through an intuitive interface, making it easy to create cards, check balances, and complete purchases from anywhere. The platform supports fast setup and does not require complex processes to get started.
Whether you are paying for online services, managing digital subscriptions, purchasing gift cards, or handling everyday online payments, Digital Purse provides practical tools that fit modern digital lifestyles. By offering both virtual cards and gift cards in one platform, Digital Purse helps users handle online spending in a more organized and convenient way.
Digital Purse brings together essential digital payment products in one place, making it easier to pay, shop, and subscribe online.

listings.name: Real Pads: DJ electro drums
listings.description:
Real Pads provides all the tools you need to be a music beat maker DJ on your smartphone or tablet. Now, you can effortlessly create any song, anywhere! Perfect for those who have a passion for making music!

Learn the basics of music creation and mix music beats! 
With Real Pads you can be a beat maker, mixing loops, play drums, create mixtapes and record samples with your own melodies. Play on a launchpad by tapping the super pads!

Don't have access to a sampler, drum machine or drum pads? 
No problem! Real Pads offers a variety of sound packs with high-quality sounds, empowering you to create any music you desire! Additionally, you can create your own kit, allowing you to choose your own sounds and record your own samples.

Make beats like a professional music producer! 
Design your own beats and share them, as well as videos of your performances, with your friends and on social media! 

You don't need a physical sampler, drum machine or drum pads! 
Real Pads is an excellent choice for making beats quietly, without causing disruptions or needing ample space. Enjoy the freedom to produce music wherever you please!

Real Pads is a complete music studio! 
Real Pads enables children to make music while having fun and enhance their cognitive abilities. This app will nurture your musical talents!

With Real Pads you can make music beats like: 
- Hip-Hop 
- Rap 
- Electronic Music
- House
- Techno
- EDM
- Dance
- Dubstep
- R&B
- Experimental
- Dancehall
- Reggae
- Dub
- Jazz 
- Soul Music
- Alternative
- and more!

So, what are you waiting for to become a music producer? Start making music with Real Pads today! Download now and unleash your creativity!


Explore the features of Real Pads:

- More than 200 kits to create music 

- Customize your kits: upload your sounds and record your samplers

- Wide array of tools to create beats

- New kits introduced weekly

- 30 drum pads

- Studio-quality audio

- Recording mode

- Share your recordings and customized drum kits on social media

- Export your recordings to MP3 format

- Compatible with all screen resolutions – Phones and Tablets (HD Images)

- Free application

- MIDI support

- Multitouch capability

The app contains the following subscription:
- Premium Version (Remove ads and Unlock all Kits)
- Monthly payment ($3,90).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal.
- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription).
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Terms of use and Privacy Policy:
http://www.kolbapps.com/privacy_policy_and_terms.pdf

The app is free but you can remove the ads and get the premium version by purchasing a license. 

Designed for DJ's, music producers, beat makers, professional musicians, enthusiasts, and beginners alike!
From the same creator of Real Drum!

Follow us on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube for tips on utilizing the app: @kolbapps

Kolb Apps: Touch & Play!

bluejetty:00121570:ios.description:
Make your iPhone truly yours—customize your Lock Screen, Home Screen, and Apple Watch with 17,000+ wallpapers, widgets, themes, and AI-powered designs.
What is MyScreen? 
MyScreen is the ultimate iPhone personalization app, trusted by over 50 million people. Want a custom look for your phone that nobody else has? MyScreen makes it easy. Browse a massive library of 4K wallpapers, apply animated wallpapers, customize widgets and icons, design Apple Watch faces—all in one app.
Why do millions choose MyScreen? 
Most wallpaper apps offer a static gallery. MyScreen is a full personalization studio that combines a massive, weekly-updated wallpaper library, live wallpaper engine, AI image generator, widget customization, icon packs, and Apple Watch face design. One tap––perfect fit, every time.
What can you do with MyScreen? 
— Browse thousands of high-resolution wallpapers across categories such as Nature, Anime, Abstract, Neon, Urban, Minimalist, Cars, Dark Mode, and more—with new designs added every week.
— Set animated live wallpapers with seasonal and trending collections updated monthly. 
— Generate unique AI wallpapers and avatars, exactly as you want them. Type a prompt and get a design no one else has.
— Style your Home Screen with custom widgets and icon packs for a fully cohesive aesthetic layout.
KEY FEATURES
LIVE & 4K WALLPAPERS LIBRARY
Explore thousands of high-resolution wallpapers and animated live wallpapers from landscapes and abstract art to neon patterns and anime.
AI WALLPAPER & AVATAR GENERATOR
Describe what you want and let AI create it. Custom wallpapers and avatars no one else has. Just type a prompt and export.
ONE-TAP OPTIMIZATION & INSTANT APPLY
Every image auto-adjusts to your exact screen dimensions. No cropping, no resizing. Set to Lock Screen, Home Screen, or both in one tap.
WIDGETS & ICON PACKS
Customize interactive widgets and swap icon packs for a fully themed Home Screen aesthetic.
APPLE WATCH FACES & STANDBY MODE
Custom watch faces and iOS 17+ StandBy screens—extend your style to every Apple device you own.
How It Works 
1. Browse our library of backgrounds, live wallpapers, themes, widgets, and watch faces.
2. Tap any design to preview it on your Lock Screen, Home Screen, or Apple Watch.
3. Want something original? Open the AI generator, type a prompt, and get a custom wallpaper in seconds—auto-optimized, no cropping needed. 
4. Apply instantly or save to Photos. The whole process takes under 10 seconds.
Who is MyScreen for?
Anyone who’s tired of defaults and wants their iPhone to feel personal, with clean minimalist aesthetics, bold neon visuals, anime-inspired themes, or culturally meaningful designs.
Download MyScreen now—17,000+ backgrounds, live wallpapers, AI design tools, and fresh content every week.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES 
Subscribe for unlimited access to wallpapers, live wallpapers, themes, widgets, AI generation, and more. Weekly and annual plans available. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
By using MyScreen, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00019493:ios.description:
Tennis Manager is back for the 2026 season with an updated tennis world tour and new goals and achievements!
Become the best tennis manager ever! Build your own tennis academy, find the next tennis super stars and make your team of pro players climb the worldwide ranking. A game inspired by Patrick Mouratoglou, coach of Serena Williams!
2 GAME MODES
* Play in career mode to train the next world number 1
* Play in multiplayer mode to show you are the best manager!
BUILD YOUR OWN TENNIS ACADEMY
* Develop facilities such as your training center, your youth camp, your sponsors and medias area...
* Hire the best staff members: sparring partner, assistant coach, fitness trainer, doctor, agent…
MANAGE YOUR DREAM TEAM
* Create your pro team and manage up to 4 different players
* Scout the best young talents across the world and sign them to join your team
COACH YOUR PROTÉGÉ
* Choose the next top young tennis player from your tennis academy and make him climb the worldwide ranking
* Win junior tournaments to the most prestigious competitions: the Grand Slams and the Finals
* Plan training sessions to improve your player's skills (physical, mental and technical)
* Reinforce his playing style: Serve & Volleyer, Power Player, Counter Puncher, Defensive Baseliner
* Develop tactics and strategies to win matches and tournaments
* Unleash the right instruction at the right time to make the difference on the turning points
* Manage your player’s entire career plan from tournament schedules to sponsorship deals & media appearances.
CHALLENGE OTHER MANAGERS WORLDWIDE
* Play Live Event match during a real-life Grand slam or Masters tournaments
* Play 3v3 tournaments in ITT League (a brand-new PVP mode, sort of mixed Davis Cup & Fed Cup)
REALISM
- Our 3D tennis match simulation is the most realistic simulation ever made.
- Men’s and women’s pro circuits are evolving season after season inspired by real ATP and WTA circuits.
Start your career; become "The Manager"
Ever dream to build your own tennis academy? Train the next Roger Federer, Rafa Nadal or Serena Williams? Win the Australian Open, Roland Garros, Wimbledon and US Open? Your place in tennis history awaits! 
Download the game now!

We welcome your feedback!
Contact us: support@reboundcg.com

bluejetty:00122002:ios.description:
Feared by many, a force of nature, the obsession of way too many screenwriters in Hollywood… That’s right, you got it: SHARKS! Sharks are the lions of the sea – they’re regal, astute and, above all, carnivores. 
It might be those big bulging eyes or the lack of a silky mane, but they’re actually waaaay scarier than their terrestrial counterparts. This is why we decided that YES, the world needs a sharklicious version of the Evolution saga (maybe we just want to see the world BURN)! It’s a new wave of entertainment!
Why settle for an ordinary shark? Sharks are scary by nature but with a little help of Shark Evolution they can get EXTRA scary and you can create and develop many fishy shark species, just combine them to see them evolve! Have a sea of fun mixing, matching and combining these villains of the water world!
FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the sharks
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar sharks to create new mysterious creatures
• Use sharks poop coins to buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a shark to make coins pop when sharks poop
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many shark species to discover
• A mind-blowing story yet untold
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution, 2048 and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No sharks were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Bait the hook and download Shark Evolution now!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00153966:ios.description:
Grow Your Brain on the Farm!
Discover a fresh twist on puzzle games where crops meet calculation! Arrange colorful numbered blocks across your fields, strategically matching rows and columns to their target sums. Every cleared harvest rewards you with cheerful achievements and unlocks vibrant farm upgrades.
Smart Planting Strategy: Drag and drop numbered seeds (5, 15, 25, 35) into plots. Use simple math to balance rows/columns perfectly—like aligning a 15+5 combo to hit the 20 target!
500+ Evolving Fields: Start with easy arithmetic in sunny meadows, then tackle tricky equations in stormy orchards with limited moves!
What Makes Us Unique:
"Math You'll Actually Enjoy": We transformed dry equations into block-counting challenges. Watch numbers bloom!
Farmyard Fun for Everyone:
Whether you're a number-crunching pro or a casual player craving wholesome challenges, nurture your logic skills one playful puzzle at a time.
Why Players Keep Coming Back:
# Soothing yet stimulating visual design (no flashy distractions!)
# Perfect balance between "Just one more level!" and "I feel smarter already."

bluejetty:00188089:ios.description:
Tired of expense reports? Finish your expenses in seconds with ABUKAI!
Step 1. Simply take a picture of each receipt while on the road or in the office.
Step 2. Hit “Process Expense Report” anytime you are ready.
You will receive your finished expense report with cost categorization, date, vendor and all the other information already filled in for you. 
Named one of the six Best Mobile Small Business Apps by Staples.
Named one of the Top 5 Apps for Investing and Finance by Nasdaq.
Named one of the Top 20 Cloud Services for Small Businesses by PC Magazine.
PC Magazine Editors Choice: "ABUKAI Expenses is a knock-your-socks off mobile app... ABUKAI is right there at the top of the list. I was blown away by the accuracy... It's an obvious Editors Choice for business users. ABUKAI Expenses is poised to revolutionize the way we process expense reports." 
AGuys: "An application and a service that I have been wishing for ever since I was able to spend money... You answered my prayer…Your app and service are amazing!"
ABUKAI's receipt scanner eliminates all the cumbersome work associated with creating expense reports and business expenses including typing data from receipts, categorizing expenses and looking up exchange rates. ABUKAI will "automagically” create your expense report and email it to you once you submit your receipts.
Downloading the ABUKAI Expenses mobile scanner application is completely free, and includes 12 expense reports/year (counted as sets of 10 receipts). Additional expense report submissions or customization require subscription to an ABUKAI Expenses account plan.
Do you require customizations or have a different expense report template?
With the standard version available for download, you will receive expense reports via email in Excel and PDF. ABUKAI can tailor reports to your company’s existing Excel format or directly post your expenses into your company's expense web portal, document management system or ERP system. For example, ABUKAI can directly post your expenses into tools such as Exact, FreshBooks, Intacct, MYOB, QuickBooks, Sage, or Xero Accounting. ABUKAI can also be customized to upload expenses into Oracle or SAP.
Please email us at support@abukai.com with your feedback.
Note: ABUKAI’s software and services target businesses and not individuals.

bluejetty:00158546:ios.description:
Getting ready for your driving license in Nepal? Likhit helps you pass the written test (likhit) required by the Department of Transport Management before you can appear for the trial.
The app gives you a full set of practice questions, sorted by topic so you can study one section at a time. All questions and exams follow Nepal's traffic and road regulations.
Multiple-choice questions organized by section
A practice exam that matches the real test for car and motorbike
A visual guide to Nepali road and traffic signs
A tool to find driving centers in your district or anywhere else in Nepal
Clear rules for the driving trial (car, bus, and motorcycle)
Everything else you need to know about Nepal's road rules and traffic laws
Why Likhit
Study the right questions, learn your traffic signs, locate a driving center near you, and walk into the exam prepared. We keep the content updated so you are always studying the current rules.
Best of luck with your likhit and your trial. You've got this.

bluejetty:00089518:ios.description:
Freddie is for the sapphic, trans & gender-diverse community to find friends, events, & lovers. qtpoc founded, self-funded, & independently run.
Key Features:
- Personals - Post an anonymous Personal where you can find dates, vent, post haikus, and connect with people. Ditch endless swiping and post a Personal instead.
- Post on the Feed - Share your queer thoughts via Posts and add images, videos, memes, or run a poll. You can also save Post drafts.
- People Search - Filter to find people who are interested in the same things, are looking for dates, or are self-proclaimed tops. It’s a queer search you didn’t know was possible.
- Events - Find queer events in NYC, LA, Chicago and the Bay. Or create your own events, wherever you are, for others to find.
- Spaces - Organize and communicate with your community with a group just for you. Each Space comes with its own feed, events, and group moderation.
- Custom Profile - Personalize your profile with audio, text, images, or music tiles. You can also set your Top 8 connections on Freddie - very much like Myspace.
See you on Freddie :)

• Download the app

bluejetty:00073612:ios.name: Topo Maps by Landscape
bluejetty:00073612:ios.summary: Summiting a peak is a extraordinary experience, Landscape helps you get there and ensures you never forget it. Whether you’re a seasoned mountaineer, an avid peak bagger, or simply someone who loves big hikes, Landscape is built for everyon
bluejetty:00073612:ios.description:
Summiting a peak is a extraordinary experience, Landscape helps you get there and ensures you never forget it. Whether you’re a seasoned mountaineer, an avid peak bagger, or simply someone who loves big hikes, Landscape is built for everyone who's passionate about reaching summits
3D Mountains
Experience your climb in stunning 3D and relive your greatest adventures. Switch to the AR view and share your experience in an immersive and captivating way. Export a 3D model of the mountain with your trail and share your experience with friends with rich previews in iMessage.
Offline Navigation
Download maps to take with you into the backcountry, so you can stay on course even when you’re offline. Landscape’s all-day GPS tracking keeps you on track, even when you’re off the grid. With unique mountaineering stats such as elevation climb rate and percent oxygen, plus essential information like current elevation, distance traveled, and gain, you can easily keep track of your progress.
Memories—Hike Logbook
Document your hiking journey with Landscape’s Memories feature. Keep a log of each hike, including a 3D map of your route, pictures, and stats from your day. Relive your adventure and share your experience with friends.
Automatic Peak List Tracking
Easily track your progress on any Peak List with Landscape. The app automatically detects which peaks you’ve summited from your hikes and updates your progress accordingly. No matter what hiking milestones you’re working toward, Landscape makes it effortless to track your achievements and plan your next adventure.
Lifetime Stats
Follow your lifetime and year-by-year stats and keep track of your achievements with Landscape. See your total distance and gain, as well as peaks and photos across all your Memories.
Apple Health
Landscape seamlessly integrates with Apple Health, allowing you to import hikes already saved in Apple Health as Landscape Memories. You can also save hike recordings from Landscape back to Apple Health and fill your activity rings.
iCloud Sync
Access your favorite hikes everywhere, with no account or signup required. With iCloud Sync, your favorite hikes are always at your fingertips on all of your devices.
GPX/KML Imports
Import your previous hikes and view your path on a 3D mountain, or plan for your next climb.
Download Landscape now to explore stunning 3D mountains, enjoy reliable offline navigation, and track your hikes effortlessly. Relive your adventures, share your achievements, and reach new heights. Get started today!

bluejetty:00079375:ios.name: Orange Travel: Prepaid eSIM
bluejetty:00079375:ios.summary: An eSIM is a virtual version of a SIM card, fully integrated by manufacturers into devices such as smartphones, tablets, or smartwatches. An eSIM works like a regular SIM card, providing calls, SMS, and Internet access. All you need is an e
bluejetty:00079375:ios.description:
An eSIM is a virtual version of a SIM card, fully integrated by manufacturers into devices such as smartphones, tablets, or smartwatches. An eSIM works like a regular SIM card, providing calls, SMS, and Internet access. All you need is an eSIM-compatible device. Check the list of supported phones on our website https://travel.orange.com/en/about-esim 
What is an Orange Travel eSIM?
Orange Travel eSIM lets travelers stay connected abroad without high roaming fees. Our prepaid, no-contract eSIMs let you enjoy Internet, calls, and SMS in over 200 destinations, with flexible plans tailored to the length of your stay (7, 14, 30, or 90 days) and your needs for data (1 to 500 GB), calls, and SMS. Top up anytime to keep your connection going.
Why choose an Orange Travel eSIM?
With Orange Travel eSIM, you benefit from the expertise of the Orange Group, one of the world’s leading telecommunications providers. Thanks to our global infrastructure and partnerships with local operators, you enjoy the best connectivity in over 200 destinations.
Orange Travel eSIM Benefits:
• Competitive prices & year-round promotions
• Data-only or Data + Calls & SMS plans, with unlimited data speed
• Reusable and top-upable
• Universal compatibility with all operators
• One-click activation via the app, no QR code needed
• Instant access to top local networks
• 24/7 Customer Support to answer all your questions
5 Reasons to Choose Orange Travel eSIM:
1. Speed & Security: Avoid unsafe public Wi-Fi and enjoy a reliable connection as soon as you arrive.
2. Flexibility: Manage multiple eSIM lines as needed while keeping your physical SIM if you wish.
3. Instant Activation: Get your eSIM is ready to use in just a few clicks, no delays or complicated setup.
4. Multi-Operator Access: Connect to multiple local networks for the best coverage and offers.
5. No Commitment: Skip long-term contracts or hidden fees—you stay in control of your choice and budget.
How to Buy and Activate an Orange Travel eSIM:
• Install the Orange Travel app on your phone.
• Select your destination and find the perfect eSIM.
• Create your account and pay securely.
• Activate your eSIM with one click in the app.
• Enjoy fast and reliable Internet as soon as you arrive.
24/7 Customer Support
Contact our support team via the in-app chat. Available 24/7, our team helps you find, activate, and use your travel eSIM with ease.
FAQ
Can I keep my current number?
Yes, your number stays the same if you use an eSIM alongside your existing SIM card.
Can I use my SIM card and eSIM at the same time?
Yes, you can use your SIM and eSIM simultaneously and choose which line to use for mobile data, calls, and SMS.
Can I renew or extend my eSIM plan?
Yes, you can renew or extend your eSIM plan directly from the app.
Enjoy your trip with Orange Travel!
• Learn more about us: https://travel.orange.com/en 
• Join the Orange Travel community on Instagram: @orangetravel.official

bluejetty:00124324:ios.description:
Muzz (formerly MuzMatch) is the world’s biggest Muslim marriage app. And the best part? We’re proudly Muslim-owned.
Muzz connects you with a community of 20 million Muslims looking for marriage. More than 1,000,000 Muslim marriages have already started on Muzz, so yeah, we know a thing or two about helping Muslims find their person.
Looking for marriage? You’re in the right place. Muzz was built with Muslims in mind from day one, with features designed to help you meet your person in a way that feels safe, intentional and halal. Because finding your spouse is hard enough without having to explain what a Wali is.
And when you just want to connect with the wider Muslim community, there’s Jamaa — our dedicated social app built to amplify Muslim voices, not censor them. Share what’s on your mind, find your people and join the conversation.
SAFETY FEATURES
Verified Users: Every profile is verified with a selfie, and members can add optional ID Verification for an extra layer of trust and a blue verification badge.
Safety First: We have a dedicated team that is here to help you with your Muslim marriage experience and provide assistance.
Stay Private: You have complete control of who can see your profile and keep your photos private until you're ready to share them.
Screenshot Protection: Your photos stay yours. We block screenshots so no one can save or share your profile without your permission.
Chaperone: Need that extra peace of mind? Include a chaperone (or Wali) in your conversations.
WHY MUZZ?
Targeted Filters: Find your perfect match by Location, Interests, Profession, Ethnicity, Language, Education, how practicing you are and much more. Explore other cultures, chat with Arabs, South Asian, European Muslims and more.
Video & Voice: Get to know your matches beyond chat with video and voice calling, voice notes and profile videos.
Break The Ice: Let us help you start the conversation. Add three icebreaker questions to your profile, and we'll reveal your match's answer once you've both connected.
Let Your Personality Shine: Sometimes simply saying Salams or having a brief bio might not fully capture your story. Are you a cat person who loves to visit museums? We've added Personality and Interest options to make your profile stand out.
Stay Intentional: With chat limits, you can focus on meaningful conversations instead of endless small talk, quality over quantity.
Connect Nationwide: Moved to the city but still looking for a Muslim partner back in your hometown? Use Travel Mode to find Muslims in places such as; California, Texas, Michigan and New York.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Simply sign up and create a profile
2. Use good photos and write a bio letting other single Muslims know what you're looking for
3. We'll show you compatible single Muslims near you who fit your filters and preferences
4. Like them if you're interested, Pass on them if you're not
5. You control who can speak to you. Once you like each other you can start chatting for free
6. Take things to the next level with a voice or video call
7. Complete the other half of your deen and get married!
Use Muzz Gold to accelerate your search. This is available as a weekly, monthly, quarterly, biannual or annual subscription. If you choose to purchase Muzz Gold, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of current subscriptions is allowed during the active subscription period. If you decide not to purchase Muzz Gold, you can simply continue using Muzz for free.
Privacy https://muzz.com/privacy
Terms https://muzz.com/terms
EULA https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

listings.description:
Eve works with all Matter- and HomeKit-enabled devices. See your home at a glance. Customize your ecosystem down to the finest detail. Activate scenes in a snap. And easily create automations using timers and rules. With Eve, you’re at the forefront of connected home control – and guided – every step of the way.

— AT A GLANCE —
Get a quick overview of everything that's happening in your connected home. Quickly access your favorite scenes to instantly control multiple accessories as one. And dive into room or type details with a simple tap.

— CONVENIENT CUSTOMIZATION —
Personalize your home according to your exact preferences. Choose among the many pre-defined rooms or add your own. And organize all your devices in a way that feels natural.

— POWERFUL AUTOMATIONS —
Easily create advanced scenes to control multiple devices with a single command. And set timers to synchronize your home with your daily routine. Better yet, add powerful rules to set scenes based on accessory values or your location, and have your home work for you – automatically.

— ABOUT EVE —
The Eve family of Matter- and HomeKit-enabled devices puts your home at your fingertips. Control your lights, appliances, radiators and other connected comforts – with your iPhone or just your voice. Easily create automations for carefree convenience around the clock. And gather data on temperature, air quality, humidity, energy consumption and more.

Meet the whole Eve family at evehome.com

- 1 Trinca com 3 cartas do mesmo valor (naipes diferentes) ou 4 cartas, contanto que a carta adicional tenha o mesmo naipe de alguma outra carta da trinca.

The app is simple, but has some important features:
- Frame photos and videos in square, 4:5 and many other ratios, so there will be no crop.
- Image quality - keeps image resolution by adding borders around it.
- Preserve HDR highlights when adding borders to supported photos and videos, or choose SDR for a more consistent appearance across devices.

- Native photo picker and share menu to send photos directly to Instagram and other apps.
- Choose a border color to match your image.
- Soft blurred border: fill the border around your photo or video with a soft blur instead of a solid color.
- Preserves photo location and camera details.
- Simplified workflow: share images directly from any app to Simple Border using the share button.
- Use Siri to frame and share your latest photo, or use Shortcuts, the Action Button, and automations to process selected photos with your last border style.

- Easily scan any number of pages in one document

- Upload scanning to popular cloud services

bluejetty:00041321:ios.description:
Joji, a strawberry forest spirit, shows up and needs your help to restore their old shop.
Can you show these adorable spirits and animals why boba is so special?  
You can create all kinds of drinks with ingredients like blueberry popping boba, custard pudding, taro tea, thai tea, brown sugar milk tea, lychee jelly, and red bean!

Mix and match furniture and windows. We’ve got mushroom style counters and tables, frog chairs and windows, and cottagecore elements to make your shop look aesthetic and magical!  
Brew potions and experiments in the magic den to unlock special types of boba like cow boba, rainbow sprinkles, and gummy bears!
Serve delicious, aesthetic snacks inspired by popular foods from Japan, Philippines, Indonesia, and China to earn extra star fragments for your cafe.
Come help Joji restore their honor and earn them a “Royal Favorite Thing” award from the monarchs of this land!
No wifi is needed to play this game. Available offline!

- - - - - - - - - -
"The only D
bluejetty:00027123:ios.description:
1Writer combines all the basic text editing features you would expect with all the advanced features you will ever need. Use 1Writer to write, research, revise, and share your ideas with maximum efficiency.
- - - - - - - - - -
"The only Dropbox- and Markdown-enabled text editor for iPhone that’s clicked with me has been 1Writer. It’s simple, looks great, and gets the job done." - TheSweetSetup.com
"Really great app, really recommend it." - Federico Viticci, MacStories.net
"The app interface is beautiful and distraction-free, with loads of other awesome features lurking beneath its simple exterior. It's now my go-to iPhone text editor." - Chris Gonzales, ToolsandToys.net
"For users that want a great visual experience paired with great support for custom actions and third party apps, 1Writer is an excellent choice." - iMore.com
"1Writer is the most powerful text editor available for iPhone." - Phillip Gruneich
- - - - - - - - - -
CREATE
- Write :: generate and edit plain text or Markdown files.
- Preview :: see the formatted results with Markdown syntax highlighting while you write and a full, rich-text preview when you're done.
- Extended keyboard :: a convenient row of buttons for navigation, formatting, special characters (customizable--pick the characters you use the most).
- Insert photo :: pick a photo or take a new one, and 1Writer will upload it to Dropbox and generate the Markdown-syntax to add it to your document--all in a single action!
- Snippets :: TextExpander Touch support.
- Custom URL actions :: insert a document template, encode a selection and replace the original text, look up synonyms and much more.
- JavaScript :: create even more powerful custom actions using JavaScript—text manipulation, perform a find & replace, interact with the clipboard—the possibilities are endless.
IMPORT
- Sync with iCloud, Dropbox and WebDAV.
- Share extension :: send text to 1Writer from other apps. In Safari, the extension uses the current URL, page title and selected text to create a new document.
- Create, append, prepend, or replace text directly from other apps using the 1Writer URL scheme.
EXPORT
- CloudApp and Dropbox :: generate a link to share your document in plain text or PDF.
- Evernote :: pick your notebook, add tags and turn a text selection or the entire document into a new, rich-text note.
- Copy HTML :: put the formatted text for your document directly on the clipboard.
- Custom actions :: open a web search, tweet a selection, save a series of items in a list and much more.
PERSONALIZE
- Support Dark Mode on iOS 13.
- 2 dark themes for more comfortable reading and writing at night.
- Choose from 20 different fonts.
- Bookmark and sync the Dropbox/WebDAV folders you want to have quick access to the sub-folders and documents you need.
- Use a passcode or Touch ID/Face ID to protect the app from unauthorized users.
RESEARCH
- In-app web browser :: research, look up information without having to leave the app.
- Bookmarks :: create and access your favorite websites.
- Save the current text selection to the clipboard in Markdown syntax.
- 1Password support :: login to all your accounts using the 1Password extension.
EVEN MORE GREAT FEATURES
- Drag and drop.
- Open in Place.
- Multiple windows on iOS 13.
- MultiMarkdown.
- Search documents from Spotlight.
- Find & replace within document.
- Photo and PDF preview.
- Today widget :: access your recent documents from the Notification Center or create a new document in one tap.
- Checklist support :: create a list of things to do or topics to research, and easily check them off.
- Full-text search and hashtag support :: search within a folder to find the document you need, and view related documents that have the same tag.

bluejetty:00187546:ios.name: JazzCash- Your Mobile Account
bluejetty:00187546:ios.summary: JazzCash is Pakistan’s largest mobile wallet trusted by millions of Pakistanis. Install the new JazzCash app and experience seamless payments, transfer money to anyone anywhere, pay utility bills, recharge your mobile balance, subscribe to
bluejetty:00187546:ios.description:
JazzCash is Pakistan’s largest mobile wallet trusted by millions of Pakistanis. Install the new JazzCash app and experience seamless payments, transfer money to anyone anywhere, pay utility bills, recharge your mobile balance, subscribe to mobile packages and much more. 
How does JazzCash work?
• Open your secure mobile account using any network’s mobile number and a valid CNIC. Using our nifty built-in scanner scan your CNIC, verify your information and we will take care of the rest
• Add money to your JazzCash account conveniently by linking any debit card to your account or by making a cash deposit at your nearest JazzCash agent
• Send money to anyone in Pakistan with ease
• Choose between a physical or a virtual Mastercard to make in-store and online payments even more seamless
• Whether it is a utility bill that needs paying or a friend you have to send money to, do it all from the convenience of your mobile phone in just a few taps
The all-new JazzCash App
We are always looking for ways to enhance the JazzCash experience for our users. We have not only revamped the whole app interface but have also have added new exciting features for you to experience seamlessly.
Test-Drive the App with Guest mode
Experience the app without any hassle. Now you can explore JazzCash app and available offerings without even registering an account.
My JazzCash customization
The new JazzCash App has been designed for YOU. Customize the app homescreen with your frequently used transactions for quick access and convenience. 
Universal App Search
Can't find something? Payment company? An offer? A bundle? No problem! Just use the search bar to get to your desired place in the app in no time.
Agent & Business Locator
Locate thousands of JazzCash agents and businesses near your location within the app with a single tap of a button.
Your Handy Inbox
Can't remember an offer that was sent as a notification? Don't worry, the notifications are now stored in the app for you to come back to any time you want in the all-new “inbox”.
Help & Support
Stuck with something? Cannot understand a process? Our new and improved help and support is here for you.
Add Cards
Add your debit cards to the app securely and deposit money to your JazzCash account with ease.
Pay Bills
No need to stand in lines anymore for any kind of bills. We accept all kinds of bill payments.
Send Money
Send money to anyone, anywhere in Pakistan using JazzCash App. You can transfer money to other JazzCash account, bank accounts, CNIC numbers and to other mobile wallets in Pakistan.
Payoneer
Connect your Payoneer account with JazzCash to instantly receive your money. 
Buy Tickets
Got an event or a destination to get to? Book and buy your tickets using the JazzCash App.
Earn Rewards
Use the app to become part of exciting campaigns and earn cash rewards.
Mobile Load & Bundles
Buy mobile load and bundles for yourself or friends and family from the comfort of your couch using the JazzCash App.
Invite and Earn
Invite your friends to the JazzCash App and earn amazing cashback rewards from us. 
QR Payments
Go cashless. Use your JazzCash App to scan QR at available merchants and make payments with ease.
ReadyCash
Need a quick loan for your urgent financial needs? We got you covered with ReadyCash. 
Insurance 
Explore our range of Insurance plans and subscribe for yourself and your loved ones in just a few taps.
Wearable Convenience
The JC app is now available on watchOS! You can send and receive money, top up your mobile, reactivate your debit card, and make contactless payments through JC using your smartwatch.
This all and much more awaits you!
Share your feedback and suggestions with us at jazzcashappfeedback@jazz.com.pk

When Penny the Penguin returns to Antarctica, and she is not satisfied with the food. She decides to open the best animal restaurant and to serve up a feast! Help Penny run her diner and serve some very hungry penguins. Download NOW to get the WHOLE GAME for FREE!
Run from table to table to make sure that customers will be served on time. Earn money and upgrade this animal restaurant to the next level - Become the diner legend!

- Accommodate your customers on available tables
- Take orders

At the start, you are managing a restaurant in one area of the Antarctic, but your goal is to expand the chain to the whole area - Become the diner legend of the Antarctic!

bluejetty:00128043:ios.summary:

Time Magazine says:
"Baby Feed Timer, an elegant app that makes tracking breastfeeding a cinch, with pe
bluejetty:00128043:ios.description:
“Simple, quick and easy to use – a must for night feeds!”
"All the answers to your pediatrician's questions in the palm of your hand!"
Time Magazine says:
"Baby Feed Timer, an elegant app that makes tracking breastfeeding a cinch, with perks.
The feed timer gives you 'left' and 'right' buttons (large buttons, thank goodness, so they’re easy to hit if you’re simultaneously cycling the baby through different feed positions). The best part? The 'analysis' screen."
Designed by and for nursing and breastfeeding mothers who want to track when and for how long their baby feeds, including a useful reminder for when a feed is due. It even tells you which breast to start on!
Baby Feed Timer does it all for you!
Tracks breastfeeds, bottle feeds, breast pumps, diapers, sleep, medication, temperature, solid food, baby's weight and baby's length.
You can even synchronize the data across different phones (both iPhones and other phones) and view your data online at my.babyfeedtimer.app, making it easy to share baby's day with your partner or caregiver.
Quickly log data about baby from your Apple Watch. You don't even need to get your phone out of your pocket!
Data is analyzed ready for you and your pediatrician and shows daily, weekly and monthly averages.
See baby's day at a glance and spot trends quickly with easy to read charts.
HIGHLIGHTS:
√ Use the App for more than one baby. Whether it’s a sibling later on or twins or more with full support for multiple timers!
√ Easy to use one button start/stop timer, especially useful during the night feeds
√ Log breastfeeds, bottle feeds, breast pumps, diapers, sleep, solid food, baby's weight, baby's length, medication, make notes and set reminders
√ Synchronize data between different phones (iPhones and other phones). You can also view baby's data on my.babyfeedtimer.app
√ Apple Watch App. Quickly log breastfeeds, bottles, sleep, diapers, and breast pumps from your Apple Watch. Apple Watch also tells you when the next feed is due. It can even be used when your iPhone is switched off or not nearby!
√ Night mode. The App detects light levels and automatically selects a night or daytime theme
√ Focus on what's important to you by selecting which activities you would like to be displayed. You can even customize it further to show them in the order of your choice
√ See baby's weight and length plotted against data from the World Health Organization to see what percentile your baby is in
√ Pause button. Ability to pause the timer during a feed
√ At a glance view of how long since baby last fed, next feed time and which breast to use next
√ Notifications to alert you when next feed is due, showing which breast to use
√ View when the next feed is due from your lock screen
√ Analysis of the data including average time between feeds and feed times for the day, week and month
√ Easy to read charts displaying analyzed data, as well as a timeline view so you can see emerging trends, such as baby feeding or sleeping at the same time every day. This also helps to show days when baby is acting differently such as more dirty diapers than usual
√ View how long you have nursed your baby for that day. Particularly useful for mothers who are monitoring if baby is feeding enough
√ Manually add feeds if you miss one as well as edit feeds
√ Add notes to existing logged feeds such as if baby was sick or fussy during a feed
√ You can choose if the next feed is calculated from a set interval or using current feeding trends
√ You can swap breasts during a single feed
√ The option to email your data to your computer
Baby Feed Timer offers a completely free 7 day trial, this is not a subscription, you will not be automatically billed. At the end of the 7 day free trial Baby Feed Timer will cease to function and you will be offered the option to purchase the full version via a one-time InApp purchase.

bluejetty:00123127:ios.description:
Get on the safe side: With the S-pushTAN app, you can get the practical and secure approval procedure of your Sparkasse on your iPhone or iPad. When banking online, use pushTAN, an advanced, mobile security procedure.
IT'S THAT EASY
• When banking online with iPhone, iPad or computer, place your payment orders and send them.
• The S-pushTAN app always shows the details of the order. Just check the order data and release the order by swiping.
• Usable for all orders with TAN release. Whether transfers, submitting or changing standing orders, securitie or service orders and much more.
LET'S GO AFTER ACTIVATION BY YOUR SPARKASSE
You can start with the S-pushTAN app if you are registered for the pushTAN procedure and have got your personal registration letter.
1 - Apply for the pushTAN procedure or switch from your previously used procedure at the online branch of your Sparkasse.
2 - Download the S-pushTAN app to your iPhone or iPad for free.
3 - As soon as you have received the registration letter from your Sparkasse, start setting up the S-pushTAN app. 
SAFETY
• The S-pushTAN app communicates exclusively encrypted via tested interfaces and ensures secure data transfer according to German online banking requirements.
• Access to S-pushTAN is protected by a password you have chosen and optionally by Touch ID or Face ID.
• The app automatically locks after a short period of time, which means that your data is secured as much as possible even if the iPhone or iPad gets lost.
• The German TÜV confirms these highest safety standards.
WORTH TO KNOW
• In order to be able to use pushTAN, you need an activation by your Sparkasse and a registration letter for the first setup.
• In order to use the current version of the app, you need iOS from version 15.7 on your iPhone or iPad.
• If your iPhone or iPad is jailbroken, S-pushTAN is not executable on it. The important high security standards for the mobile banking we offer cannot be guaranteed on manipulated devices.
• Please do not deny S-pushTAN any of the requested permissions when setting it up, as these are necessary for the smooth functioning of the app.
• You get the app for free, but its use can cause costs. Please note the given information of your Sparkasse.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
We take the protection of your data very seriously. It is regulated in the privacy policy. By downloading and/or using the S-pushTAN app, you fully acknowledge the terms of the End User License Agreement of Star Finanz GmbH.
• Data protection: https://cdn.starfinanz.de/s-pushtan-datenschutz
• Terms of use: https://cdn.starfinanz.de/s-pushtan-lizenzbestimmung

bluejetty:00150248:ios.description:
New Jersey DMV Permit Test Prep:
Prepare for your New Jersey MVC Driver's Permit Test with confidence! Master the New Jersey DMV Practice Test and prepare for the New Jersey driver's license test, learner's permit test, and written knowledge exam. Whether you're applying for your learner's permit, Motorcycle License, or a Commercial Driver's License (CDL), our New Jersey DMV Practice Test Prep app provides everything you need to study, practice, and pass your written exam. 
Study using realistic practice questions based on the official New Jersey Driver Manual, take full-length mock tests, review detailed explanations and track your progress with learning tools designed for the New Jersey driver's license knowledge test.  
Prepare for Every License Category
- Car Driver's License
- Motorcycle License
- Commercial Driver's License (CDL)
- CDL Endorsements: Air Brakes & Hazardous Materials (HazMat) 
Comprehensive Knowledge Covers:
Master Traffic laws, Road signs, signals, safe driving practices, vehicle inspection, basic vehicle control, and driving conditions.
Key Features:
- Unlimited NJ DMV Practice Tests: Practice as many times as you like to build confidence before your written test.
- Quiz Mode: Test your knowledge with interactive quizzes and retry questions until you answer correctly.
- Study Mode: Study all questions with the correct answers highlighted for quick review and easy learning.
- Exam Simulation Mock Test: Simulate the real New Jersey driver license exam and measure your readiness.
- 1000+ Practice Questions: Prepare with a large collection of questions covering all major DMV manual topics.
- Flashcards
- Detailed Explanations: Understand why each answer is correct and learn from every question.
- Bookmark Questions: Save difficult questions and review them later.
- Weak Question Review: Automatically identify the questions you miss often and focus your study.
- Progress Tracker: Monitor completed tests and overall improvement.
Flexible Test Experience
- Resume or restart interrupted tests anytime
- Get on-the-spot scoring with detailed answer breakdowns.
- Study comfortably day or night with Auto, Light or Dark appearance 
Why Choose New Jersey DMV Permit Test Prep?
- Practice with realistic, state-specific DMV-style questions
- Study at your own pace
- Improve learning with Quiz & Study Modes
- Track your progress and identify weak areas
- Build confidence before your New Jersey permit test 
Whether you're getting your first driver's permit, applying for a motorcycle license, or preparing for a CDL exam, New Jersey DMV Permit Test Prep helps you study smarter and get ready for your test.
Content Source
The practice questions and study materials provided in this application are independently developed using data and information from the official New Jersey Driver Manual. The content is organized and presented as a study aid to help users prepare for the New Jersey driver's license written test for Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Vehicle license categories.
Disclaimer: 
App doesn't represent a government entity. This app is an independent study tool developed for self-study and exam preparation. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by any government agency, government organization, department, authority, or DMV. It is also not affiliated with or endorsed by any official certification, name, test, testing program, or trademark. Users should refer to the official New Jersey Driver Manual or NJMVC Manual for the most up-to-date, authoritative, and accurate information regarding driver's licenses or learner's permits, knowledge tests, road signs, questions, and traffic rules.

Play Tambola i
bluejetty:00066354:ios.description:
Octro Tambola Housie Game is an online Indian Bingo (also called Bingo 90 or Tombola) which you can play with your friends and millions of real players around the World for FREE. The Game is fun to play & very easy to learn.
Play Tambola in Premium Lobby
New languages & themes are available now, Now select Marathi, Gujarati, or Telugu as your preferred language to play tambola with state-based background theme.
Tambola, Housie Game by Octro is the most played Tambola Game and is inarguably the best Indian Bingo Game. It is a fun game to play with family and friends anytime, anywhere for free.
Tambola, Indian Bingo, is a number calling game where the random numbers from 1 to 90 are called by the in-app caller/dealer and the players need to strike the called numbers off their tickets.
Each Tambola ticket or Housie Card has 3 horizontal rows/lines & 9 vertical columns, with a total of 27 boxes. Each line has 5 numbers and 4 blank boxes. Thus, each tambola ticket has 15 numbers. The first column has unique numbers from 1 to 9, the second column from 10 to 19, third from 20 to 29, and so on, with the last column having numbers from 80 to 90.
Octro Tambola Housie Game can be played with one, two, or three tambola tickets.
The Winning Combinations
Early five: The ticket first to strike off any 5 called numbers.
Four corners: The ticket first to strike off all the four corners called numbers. The four corners are 1st and last numbers of top and bottom rows.
Top line: The ticket first to strike off the 5 numbers of the top horizontal line as called numbers.
Middle line: The ticket first to strike off the 5 numbers of the middle horizontal line as called numbers.
Bottom line: The ticket first to strike off the 5 numbers of the bottom horizontal line as called numbers.
Full house: The ticket first to have all the 15 numbers as called numbers.
The first person to strike off any winning combination wins.
Octro Tambola is played with virtual money. A new player is a Level 1 player & gets 10,000 chips and 5,000 gems. For a level 1 player, each ticket costs 100 chips. The winning amount for each winning combination is based on the number of tickets sold.
Claiming the Winning Combination
As soon as a player has marked off the numbers of a winning combination on the ticket, he/she has to press the Claim button before the next number is called. On the new screen that appears, select the winning combination or combinations that need to be claimed. If the winning combination claimed is correct, you will get the winning amount. If it’s incorrect, the tambola ticket will be declared Bogey.
Multiple Claims
Unlike any other Tambola Housie Game, we give everyone a chance to win. In games with a large number of players, there can be multiple claims made on a single Winning Combination. For example, if someone claims a top line, you can also make a top line claim.
Types Of Tables
Octro Tambola has different types of tables that you can join depending upon your mood.
Public Table
This is the default game mode. A player here is matched with random players who are also playing on Public Tables. To join a public table, simply click on the “Play” button in the main menu and select the number of tickets you want to play with.
Tambola Party
Players can create their own private party and invite friends to join. Launch Tambola and select Party. Create and Join.
Event
Be on the lookout for Tambola events. These are special game modes that last for a limited time and usually offer huge rewards.
Sponsored Events
These events are free to enter and reward the winners with real gifts like a phone, a bike etc. Be on a lookout for these Tambola events.
Special Voice Chat Feature
Now players on the party table can enjoy the voice chat feature and talk to the other players and have fun.
What are you waiting for? Download Octro Tambola, World’s most favorite Housie game, NOW!

bluejetty:00021418:ios.summary: MIDI Designer Pro X (MDPx) is the culmination of over a decade of improvement. We launched MIDI Designer Pro in 2012 and relaunched it in 2016 as MIDI Designer Pro 2. MDP2 was the first and only professional-grade MIDI controller built nati
bluejetty:00021418:ios.description:
MIDI Designer Pro X (MDPx) is the culmination of over a decade of improvement. We launched MIDI Designer Pro in 2012 and relaunched it in 2016 as MIDI Designer Pro 2. MDP2 was the first and only professional-grade MIDI controller built natively for iOS, earning critical acclaim. Since launch, over 80 updates have greatly expanded its capabilities. Our user-created library now covers 375+ MIDI targets across music hardware and software. In 2024, MDPx took a significant leap forward with the expressive "Spaceship" theme on iPad and Mac and major iPhone usability advances. It now adds AUv3 support in hosts such as AUM, Cubasis, and Logic. A new subscription model — Premium — allows even more users to use the App in their music-making and discover the App Store's best MIDI controller for themselves.
CAPABILITIES
• Control all MIDI-enabled hardware and software: keyboards, synths, effects, pedals, DAWs, plug-ins, DJ, VJ & lighting rigs, other iOS apps, robots, cruise ships, rail guns, particle accelerators
• AUv3 MIDI Processor Extension: Host MDPx inside AUM, Cubasis, Logic, and other AUv3 hosts.
• Solid MIDI Communications Infrastructure: Sets the industry standard for reliable and robust MIDI interactions over Network, Bluetooth and USB.
• Active Community of Authors: A vibrant ecosystem supporting legacy and current music synthesizers, sound engines, DAWs, and all MIDI-controlled devices.
• Extensive User Layout Library: More than 350 layouts for over 80 manufacturers, contributed by the Community.
• Comprehensive Support: Whether you're just starting or tackling complex MIDI implementations, with the Community we are here to assist.
• MIDI Designer's 'Superpowers': A suite of powerful features exclusive to MIDI Designer that we have developed over the last 10+ years, including:
 • Ableton Link and Link Control Loopers
 • Supercontrols and subcontrols as the basis for many features (with no scripting!):
 • Snap sub to value over time
 • Sequential subs
 • Subcontrol chaining
 • Button groups (radio buttons) with Bounceback™
 • Steppers
 • Live Transpose
 • Group Presets
 • Named Ticks
 • Accelerometer
 • Simplified Sysex Messages with variables and bit changers
 • Snap to Value over Time
 • Global Presets
 • Pedalboards
 • Popup Panels (Show/Hide)
 • Two-up Page Layout for iPad/Mac
 • Streambyter Plugin by Audeonic for advanced MIDI transformation
MDPx is easy to use, infinitely flexible and customizable, and battle-tested in performance. It's the only professional-grade MIDI controller built from the ground up for iOS to control ANYTHING via MIDI.

bluejetty:00174476:ios.description:
RevoSpin 360 - Elevate Your Event Experience!
Welcome to RevoSpin 360, your ultimate companion for capturing and sharing unforgettable moments at every event! Our app seamlessly integrates with your 360 photo booth or video booth, transforming any gathering into a vibrant and interactive celebration. Whether you're rocking the RevoSpin 360 platform or any other rotating photo booth, RevoSpin 360 is designed to enhance your experience and keep the fun spinning.
Capture Every Angle with Stunning 360 Videos
- High Frame Rate Recording: Record slow-motion 360 videos at 120fps or 240fps, ensuring every detail is captured with utmost precision.
- Video Quality Choices: Optimize your storage without compromising quality. Choose the video resolution that best suits your needs.
- Connect to GoPro: Elevate your video quality by connecting to GoPro 9 and above, and capture moments like never before.
- Share Instantly: Once the recording is done, share the fun via QR Code, SMS, or Email right after each session.
- Organize with Ease: Create events within the app to keep all your videos neatly organized.
- Customize Your Settings: Tailor the video settings to your preference, from aspect ratio to recording time.
- Ultra Wide Angle Lens: Utilize the ultra wide angle lens for full-body footage (available only on compatible phone models).
- Personalize Your Videos: Add your favorite music and custom overlays for a unique touch.
- Animate Your Experience: Bring your videos to life with animated effects.
- Access Anywhere: View and share your gallery online at events.revospin.com.
- Replay and Reshare: Revisit and reshare your favorite moments with the in-app gallery.
- Multi-Device Recording: Use multiple devices to capture footage on various platforms at a single event.
- Offline Recording: Never miss a moment, record offline and upload once a stable internet connection is available.
- Upload Recovery: Easily resume the upload queue for any videos that didn’t make it through.
- Secure Your Settings: Use Face ID to keep your settings secure from guest interference.
- Timeline Feature: Navigate through your event's moments with ease, thanks to the timeline feature.
- New Filters: Add a creative touch to your videos with a range of new and exciting filters.
- Revamped Video Encoding: Experience faster and more efficient video processing with our complete rewrite of the video encoding system.
Optimal Performance Recommendations
- Device: iPhone 11 or better
- Operating System: iOS 15+
In-App Purchases - Enhance Your Experience!
PRO Subscription:
- Add Intro/Outro Clips: Customize your videos with intro and outro clips.
- Custom Branding: Personalize your web gallery with your own branding.
- Access to Templates: Use photo booth templates from the web app for a unique look.
- Remove Ads/Watermark: Enjoy an uninterrupted and clean experience.
PRO+ Subscription:
- Everything from PRO, plus:
- Video Filter Effects: Add stunning filters to your videos.
- Data Collection: Gather insights with email and phone downloads, and track video total downloads.
Supporting Your Experience
EULA: https://events.revospin.com/eula
Privacy Policy: https://events.revospin.com/privacy
RevoSpin 360 is here to revolutionize your event experience. Capture, share, and relive the best moments with ease and flair! Let’s make every event unforgettable – download RevoSpin 360 now and take your celebrations to the next level!

bluejetty:00127009:ios.description:
An app with one goal. To make being part of a team easy.
 "Using Teamo is an absolute dream", Head Coach, Dubai Sharks RFC
Teamo’s goal is to make the lives of volunteers who run their teams and clubs easier. Teamo allows you to spend less time on logistics and administration and more time focusing on your team.
Teamo is suitable for everyone from 5-a-side social teams to large clubs with 2000+ members. Get started with Teamo today for FREE in minutes, and access the app’s full functionality anytime, anywhere. 
WHY TEAMO?
ALL-IN-ONE COMMUNICATION
All team information in one place to keep everyone connected - no more multiple channels of communication. Send messages to individuals, groups or the whole team in the app or use our unique email lists, meaning you never have to build a mailing list again.
SCHEDULE THE SEASON
Upload all future fixtures to plan ahead for the season. Automatic reminders are sent to parents and players, so you know who is available when to select your team.
SAFEGUARDING FOR JUNIORS
Guardians are included in all communications between an adult and a minor, and have full access to their U18s schedule. With emergency contact details in your pocket, parents have peace of mind that travelling managers can access medical and emergency contact details pitch side.
TRACK ATTENDANCE
Mark off who is attending training sessions in a few taps, with an overall attendance overview to aid selection.
PROFESSIONALLY BRANDED APP
Add your own customisation to the app to make it really feel your own.
NEVER MISS A PAYMENT
Collect and track team payments (subs, tickets, match fees) with easy in-app one tap card payments.
MANAGE MULTIPLE TEAMS
Coach or play for several teams? With teamo, is it easy for coaches, players and parents to be part of more than one team with all information in one place!
MULTI-PLATFORM ACCESS
Manage your team on the go or at home across all platforms - mobile, tablet and web.
PLAYSAFE
QR and in app check-in for Track and Trace, helping keep your club safe.
FITLEAGUE
Keep players engaged and motivated during pre-season, the winter break or lockdown. Start a FitLeague and sync player's activity data to build a team leaderboard. 
FitLeague is optional if you choose to use it, users will be asked to allow integration with the Health app.
PRIVACY: All data is stored securely with privacy settings so only relevant stakeholders can access the information they require.
---
FEEDBACK/QUESTIONS? Please send all feedback to the support email address or use the feedback facility in the app.

bluejetty:00132385:ios.summary: The NBC LA app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, wildfire and earthquake updates, traffic tracking, car chase reports and 24/7 news st
bluejetty:00132385:ios.description:
The NBC LA app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, wildfire and earthquake updates, traffic tracking, car chase reports and 24/7 news streaming tailored for Greater Los Angeles and Southern California.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC4 Los Angeles in one app. Follow stories across Los Angeles and Southern California, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, wildfires, earthquakes, traffic, car chases, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC LA app?
If you live or work in Los Angeles or Southern California, the NBC LA app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC LA app?
Follow Los Angeles local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC4 journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in Los Angeles, statewide California contests and local races
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC4 anchors
Stay ahead of the weather, wildfires and earthquakes with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, air quality and UV index
* Access First Alert Weather live Doppler radar to track Santa Ana wind conditions, wildfire movement, earthquake advisories and severe weather
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live Channel 4 newscasts, car chase coverage and special events on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from NBC4 Investigates and consumer guidance from NBC4 Responds
Personalize your NBC LA experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC LA app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters across Los Angeles, Orange County, Riverside County, San Bernardino County, Ventura County and Southern California who need real-time weather tracking, traffic updates and local news coverage.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election, wildfire and earthquake alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, wildfire advisories, earthquake updates, breaking news or election notices you choose.
Can I watch NBC Los Angeles live in the app?
Yes. You can stream NBC Los Angeles News 24/7, live Channel 4 newscasts, press conferences, car chase coverage and special breaking events from anywhere.
NBC LA provides local news, First Alert Weather forecasts, live radar, wildfire tracking, traffic updates and 24/7 streaming for Greater Los Angeles and Southern California.

bluejetty:00078548:ios.description:
Dino Jam is a fun and addictive 3D puzzle game. Tap to move dino but be careful, don’t crash. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle challenge on amazing wild theme.
An attractive parking jam game and a unique puzzle game that allows us to explore the amazing story of a lovely young girl. 
She returns right away to take over the family business after noticing that her father has gone missing. On the island she arrives at, while quietly investigating the reasons behind her father's disappearance, she meets several difficulties and barriers, and the young girl needs the player's help to escape.
Playing the parking game and traffic puzzle "Dino Jam" helps the girl to escape dangerous situations by resolving puzzles and passing challenges to complete missions, blending elements of traffic jam and car parking games. In the game, you will need to use logic, think critically, and employ timing precision.
HOW TO PLAY DINO JAM
- The basic goal of Dino Jam is to find and free every boat that has become stuck on the island, combining the challenge of a block puzzle game with parking elements.
- Stones, beacons, rope floats, wooden crates, and other obstacles like these will be present as you move the boats, requiring a skillful and exact strategy, similar to unblock and block puzzle games.
- The dino can move forward and backward, providing a traffic escape dynamic.
- Match identical dino to form pairs, introducing a matching puzzle game aspect to the challenge.
Interested? Here are some more features of our game:
- Help the lovely young girl at each level by completing the task of moving the dino out of the traffic jam, offering a unique traffic escape experience.
- The unexpected and interesting situations in this game will always keep you engaged, offering a match game and casual gaming experience.
- Explore the mysterious story hidden within areas like restaurants, cruise ships, fishing gear shops, beachfront houses, and more, providing a puzzle board game with diverse scenarios.
- Infinite gameplay makes this game highly replayable, suitable for those who enjoy logic skills and critical thinking challenges.
- RELAX and enjoy this casual puzzle game about the island, offering a blend of parking game and logic puzzle.
And that is not all! Dino Jam is a puzzle game full of unexpected twists and captivating adventures!
What are you waiting for? Challenge your brain with this difficult parking game and traffic puzzle right now!
DOWNLOAD AND PLAY NOW - Download this fascinating and addictive puzzle game, release the stranded boats, and rescue the girl from the tricky traps today."

bluejetty:00078004:ios.description:
"Puzzles for Seniors" is a charming and engaging classic jigsaw puzzle game designed specifically for seniors. With its vibrant and amazing pictures, this game is perfect for those who cherish the nostalgia of the 1960s and 1970s. Its wide range of categories, including Christmas, Travel, Cruising, Landscapes, Fashion, Flowers, and many more, offers endless fun and relaxation.
Key Features:
- Large Pieces: Ideal for seniors, play with large puzzle pieces for an easy and enjoyable experience.
- Vintage Collection: Dive into the past with pictures of classic cars, typewriters, sewing machines, old watches and retro home design, bringing back the spirit of the 1960s-1970s.
- Vibrant Categories: Explore various categories like Christmas, Travel (including Cruising), Landscapes, Flowers, Cats, Dogs, Birds, Fashion, Food, and more.
- New Pictures Daily: Discover incredible new pictures every day, adding freshness and variety to your puzzle-solving experience.
- Adjustable Difficulty: Choose from easy (16 pieces) to hard (up to 400 pieces) to suit your comfort level.
- Auto-Save Progress: Your game progress is automatically saved, allowing you to continue anytime.
- Earn Coins: Solve puzzles to earn coins, unlocking new and colorful pictures.
- Christmas Music: Enjoy festive Christmas jingles while solving puzzles from the Christmas category.
Advantages for Seniors:
- Stress Relief: Find relaxation and peace in solving these beautiful puzzles.
- Improve Memory: Challenge and enhance your memory with each puzzle.
- Increase Focus: Sharpen your focus and concentration skills.
- Sleep Better: Engaging in a calming activity like puzzle-solving can contribute to better sleep.
- Fun and Relaxation: Enjoy hours of fun and entertainment, tailored for senior players.
In our game, seniors can indulge in the joy of classic, retro, and vintage-themed puzzles while reaping the benefits for their mind and brain health. Whether it's Christmas nostalgia or the thrill of solving a classic vintage puzzle, this game is perfect for those seeking a fun, relaxing, and mentally stimulating experience. Immerse yourself in a world of jigsaw puzzles designed just for you!

bluejetty:00069881:ios.description:
THE MOST SIMPLE AND COMPLETE BICYCLE REPAIR AND MAINTENANCE GUIDE ON THE APP STORE
REPAIRS
• 58 highly detailed photo repair guides, with over 300 studio quality photos (with parts highlighted).
• 95 bicycle tips and tricks, including common aches and pains while on the bike (there are simple things to do to get rid of that knee pain). 
WEATHER
• From the main screen, you have access to your current local weather and today's forecast. It also suggests what to wear based on the temperature.
QUICK REFERENCE
• For things we often do but can’t remember, like, what's the side to turn the wrench to remove the pedals? Or should I tighten the H or the L screw?
WHAT SHOULD I WEAR
• You don't remember what you should wear when it's 8°C (46°F)? Don't worry, check our suggestions list, or even better, check your own outfits list. 
• Keep track of the clothes you wear at a certain weather condition and rate them. Next time, you'll know what to wear or not
OTHER FEATURES
• Save money the first time you use Bike Repair App by doing the repairs yourself.
• Fixing your shifting problem, derailleur noises, brakes rubbing on the wheel, flat tire, broken chain, pedal removal, hydraulic brakes, etc has never been easier. 
• Bike Repair demystifies every basic repair and maintenance routine, plus some intermediate to advanced ones. 
• Written in plain English, the easy-to-understand instruction guides are perfect for casual and serious riders alike. 
• Most of the repairs don't require any special tools. 
• The full list of all guides and problems covered is available at www.bikerepairapp.com
