bluejetty:00126261:ios.description:
KDAN PDF, formerly KDAN PDF Reader, is a mobile PDF editor and reader for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Edit text directly on your device. Then scan, organize, convert, sign, and share your PDFs in one simple and powerful app.
Trusted by millions, KDAN PDF connects your workflow across iPhone, iPad, and Mac, making it easy to review, annotate, and finalize documents anywhere.
Who Recommends Us?
- Featured as “10 Essentials” in Utility on iTunes 
- Featured in “10 Best PDF Reader Apps For iPhone & iPad 2019” by FOSSBYTES 
- Featured as “Best Utility App” in App Store Rewind 
KEY FEATURES
PDF EDITOR
• Edit and correct any typos directly on PDFs
• Merge multiple files into one PDF
• Split a large PDF into several small PDFs
• Rotate, delete, add, and rearrange pages
• Extract pages or images from PDFs
• Change PDF background color
PDF CONVERTER
• Online & Offline PDF converter
• Convert PDF to Word, Excel, PPT & image conversions (docx, xlsx, pptx, jpg, png, gif & bmp).
• Save webpages and images as PDFs
OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
• Recognize and extract text from scans
• Export OCR results as text or searchable PDFs
• Support 50+ languages
SIGN, FORM FILLING, SHARE 
• Fill out & edit PDF forms
• Sign on PDFs
• Customize and manage signatures
SHARE FILES
• Get files from KDAN Cloud, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Evernote, FTP, or WebDAV client
• Compress PDFs
• Share flatten PDFs
• Send faxes directly from within the app
PDF SECURITY
• Add passwords to lock PDFs
• Remove passwords & restrictions from PDFs
• Add & remove PDF watermarks
• Validate certificates & signatures in PDF documents
VIEW FILES
• Supports all mainstream file formats, including Vitrium* PDF format (Like University of Phoenix Ebooks)
• Text Reflow & Auto Flow
• Present a PDF as a slideshow
• View multiple PDFs as tabs
• Dark mode supported (only for iOS13 & macOS Mojave and later)
• Convert text to spoken audio (text-to-speech)
ANNOTATE & REVIEW PDF
• Annotate PDFs with highlights, underlines, strikeout text, shapes, sticky notes & text boxes
• Add pre-designed stamps, including Approved, Sign Here, Confidential, and more
• Add custom stamps with time and date information
• Insert hyperlinks to external websites, target pages, and email address
• Attach audio notes & insert images to PDFs
• Turn handwriting into text with Scribble (Available for iPad) 
• Add handwritten notes to PDFs
MANAGE ANNOTATIONS
• Save annotations in XFDF format
• Remove all annotations in one tap
- Recommended by Techradar, Techworm & Softsonic
UPGRADE OPTIONS
DOCUMENT 365

• Annual plan: billed at USD 59.99/year after the 7-day free trial ends
• Quarterly plan: billed at USD 19.99/quarter after 3-day free trial ends
• Monthly plan: billed at USD 9.99/month after 3-day free trial ends
Subscriptions will be charged to your Apple account upon purchase and will auto-renew 24 hours before the current period ends at the same price and duration. Cancellation during the active period is not allowed. Manage your trial and subscription in your Apple account.

bluejetty:00119825:ios.description:
Tune your guitar, bass or other instruments with n-Track Tuner. 
Use this tuner in an easy, intuitive and free way with the integrated microphone of your smartphone.
Downloaded over 5 million times!
Just put your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad next to your instrument and play each string.
High precision and sensitivity thanks to the advanced audio recognition algorithm also used for n-Track Studio 8.
n-Track Tuner works great as a guitar tuner, violin, viola, violoncello, bass, piano and wind instruments tuner.
NEW: 6 different views:
•||| Spectrum Analyzer |||•
The spectrum analyzer provides a visual feedback of the notes played by the instrument and shows a small arrow to highlight the harmonic whose pitch the tuner is tracking. 
•||| Instruments |||•
Use the manual mode to select and tune each string according to the selected instrument tuning (guitar, bass, violin, viola, cello, double bass, banjo, ukulele, mandolin, harp, and piano) 
Get the pro version to unlock all instruments views.
•||| Tune Fork |||•
For those who prefer to manually tune their instrument the 'Diapason' view lets you play a reference tone, 'A' (440 hz) or any other note that you can select dragging the frequency slider.
•||| Needle |||•
A handy old style tuner to accurately detect the frequencies of your instrument.
•||| Sonogram |||• (PRO feature)
The "Sonogram" tab shows how the frequency spectrum evolves with time, and shows how the note that the tuner is following evolves by tracing a green line.
•||| 3D view |||• (PRO feature)
3D view lets you follow how the audio spectrum changes over time. 
ADVANCED FEATURES 
• adjust tuning sensitivity and precision up to 0.1 cents
• western and latin note namings, alternate temperaments
• calibrate the tuner for non-standard tunings: tune the reference note, tap on the display and select 'Calibrate' to set the note as the new reference
• adjust the spectrum analyzer visualization options, select thicker spectrum lines, smooth out or highlights peaks, increase or decrease spectrum accuracy, zoom into a specific area of the spectrum
Contact us: http://ntrack.com/support

• Vista Panels with a LTEM-PA/PIA and LTEM-PV/PIV Communicator attached

 o Vista 15P/Sia
 o Vista 20P/Sia

 o Vista 21ip

Ever wonder about the name of that captivating plant you spotted on your walk?
Want to educate your children with fascinating plant knowledge?
Need expert advice on nurturing your plants?
Simply snap a photo, and PlantON will identify the plant and provide all the answers you need!

Precision Plant Identifier
PlantON recognizes over 17,000 plant species with 98% accuracy. Just take a photo, and our state-of-the-art identification system will reveal the plant’s identity instantly.
Plant Disease Diagnosis & Treatment
Take a picture of a sick plant or upload an existing photo, and PlantON will automatically diagnose the issue and suggest treatments. Your digital plant doctor is here!
Personalized Plant Care Tips & Reminders
Receive clear, step-by-step instructions to care for your plants. Get notifications for watering, fertilizing, misting, cleaning, and repotting. PlantON can even measure the amount of sunlight your plant is receiving with its light meter.
Safety Alerts for Toxic Plants
Detect toxic plants around you and receive warnings to protect your pets, children, and family.
Track & Manage Your Plant Collection
Keep a detailed record of all the plants you identify and build your own plant wishlist. Turn PlantON into your personal digital garden!

bluejetty:00171634:ios.description:
EAT & DRINK LIKE A LOCAL, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD! 
Raisin is your guide to discovering artisanal, seasonal, local, and often organic cuisine, prepared by handpicked chefs at restaurants that serve at least 30% natural wine.
Whether you are looking for a hidden wine bar in Tokyo, a farm-to-table restaurant in Paris, or a natural wine fair in New York, Raisin helps you discover places where taste, craftsmanship, and authenticity still matter. Natural wine is at the heart of everything we do. Made from organic grapes, with minimal intervention and sometimes just a little sulfur, natural wine is one of the best indicators of honesty and quality.
More than a wine app, Raisin is a cultural and gastronomic guide built around the people who grow, cook, ferment, and share things with care.
WHY IS RAISIN DIFFERENT?
Traditional gastronomic guides and rating systems based on stars, scores, and rankings aren’t enough to identify the best bars, wine cellars, restaurants, and accommodations. At Raisin, every recommendation is manually verified by our team following a rigorous selection process. To be listed, an establishment must offer at least 30% natural wines. This is our key criterion for identifying places that support independent winemakers, seasonal cuisine, local sourcing, and a genuine commitment to craft. On Raisin, you follow taste, not ratings.
KEY FEATURES
• Discover restaurants, wine shops, natural wine bars, winemakers, events, and unique stays worldwide
• Find farm-to-table, seasonal, local, and often organic food wherever you go
• Avoid tourist traps and discover places loved by locals, chefs, winemakers, and natural wine lovers
• Scan any wine label to learn more about the wine, the producer, grape varieties, and where to find it
• Save and share your favorite wines, places, tasting notes, and discoveries
• Explore passionate natural winemakers and their wines
• Connect with the community through likes, comments, and “drank it too.”
• Submit new places directly in the app
• Book a table directly from Raisin when available
KEY FIGURES
• Over 710,000 downloads worldwide
• More than 8,500 recommended venues
• Over 49,000 natural wines indexed
• More than 3,500 natural winemakers
• Over 350,000 monthly sessions
• Available in English, French, Japanese, Italian, and Spanish.
WHAT OUR USERS ARE SAYING:
• “We're passionate about natural wines, and love that your app is bringing more attention to them, and where you can find them!“ - Erin C. - Oakland
• “Your app is extraordinary! So practical, lovely, and so well designed! You should be proud!!” - François H. - France
• “We only eat in restaurants registered in Raisin, we were never disappointed, we recommend it to everybody!” - Valérie C. - France
• “Huge thanks for such an amazing app!” - J D R. - London.
• “We love Raisin, please download this great app to find natural wines in NYC!” @winetherapyny
Stay savvy: eat well, drink well.
Thank you for downloading our application.
The Raisin Team

- History page showing the previously visited chapters.
- A daily devotion and videos library page.

bluejetty:00046931:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00046931:ios.description:
Gerencie sua experiência nos resorts All Inclusive mais premiados do Brasil aqui no aplicativo Amarante!
Se você tem viagem marcada ou já está em algum dos nossos resorts All Inclusive, é só baixar o app e acompanhar de perto toda a programação disponível para sua estadia 
Nosso app é seu parceiro de viagem, facilitando o seu acesso às informações do resort que você tem reserva ativa, seja o Salinas Maragogi, o Salinas Maceió ou o Japaratinga Lounge Resort 
Aqui você encontra as informações sobre suas reservas, nossos restaurantes e pontos de consumo, os detalhes da programação diária de lazer e entretenimento para todas as idades, os horários de funcionamento das instalações dos resorts, além de realizar solicitações de serviços. 
Gerencie sua hospedagem: verifique o status da reserva, faça o check-in online, atualize suas informações cadastrais e confira sua pontuação no Tô de Volta, o programa de fidelidade da Amarante.
Mapa do Resort: explore o mapa e encontre as localizações dos pontos de consumo, onde acontecem as programações diárias e muito mais.
Horários de funcionamento: encontre os horários de funcionamento das instalações dos resorts All Inclusive da Amarante, como as piscinas, os pontos de consumo, a recepção, a assistência médica, a academia e outros.
Comer e Beber: conheça todos os pontos de consumo do resort em que estiver, faça seu agendamento nos restaurantes temáticos e veja o cardápio de cada restaurante.
Programação: encontre toda a programação do Resort que estiver visitando, listadas por categorias e para qual público é voltado, verificando qual das atrações para todas as idades se encaixam melhor no seu estilo.
Comodidades: solicite serviços durante sua hospedagem de forma rápida pela Mari, nossa assistente virtual, solicite ferro de passar, arrumação de quarto, reposição de bebidas no quarto, babysitter, e muito mais.
Incrível, hein? E ainda tem mais.
A Amarante é a administradora dos resorts mais premiados do Brasil! Todos localizados na Costa dos Corais, um destino paradisíaco no litoral de Alagoas. Os resorts All Inclusive têm características especiais que os diferenciam e marcam a vida das pessoas. 
O Japaratinga Lounge Resort é o primeiro All Inclusive Premium do Brasil, que proporciona uma gastronomia exclusiva, com cardápio de comidas e drinks assinados por chefs renomados, disponíveis em 9 pontos de consumo, durante toda a estadia. É o resort All Inclusive para casais, perfeito para curtir a energia paradisíaca da praia de Japaratinga com o love. E ainda dá para trazer seu doguinho para aproveitar tudo isso… somos Dog Friendly!
O Salinas Maragogi é o resort All Inclusive de praia ideal para trazer toda a família! Com todas as comidas e bebidas liberadas 24h por dia, em mais de 10 pontos de consumo, sua única preocupação será por qual das delícias começar. Incrível, né? O resort tem uma estrutura completa, para você aproveitar no mar, no Rio Maragogi ou em uma das piscinas do nosso complexo. Ah! A diversão é garantida para todas as idades, com atrações especiais que rolam o dia inteiro: shows ao vivo, apresentações teatrais, gincanas, esportes, espaço pras crianças no Clubinho do Siri, salão de jogos, arvorismo e muito mais!
O Salinas Maceió é o resort All Inclusive para família que você não vai querer deixar de visitar! Aqui você também tem acesso liberado a comidas e bebidas 24h por dia, disponíveis em diversos pontos de consumo, para só se preocupar em aproveitar! O resort oferece uma estrutura completa e bem integrada, perfeita para desfrutar o mar ou as piscinas. Além de tudo isso, a diversão também fica por conta das programações de lazer, shows ao vivo, gincanas, esportes e o Clubinho do Siri, um espaço especial cheio de brincadeiras para as crianças.
Baixe o app e aproveite muito sua viagem!

bluejetty:00174501:android.summary: In makeup and makeover game, the customers coming to your salon are in desperate need of a makeover. Your mission is to help them solve the problems of acne, uneven skin tone as well as dullness on their face using your makeup and makeover
bluejetty:00174501:android.description:
In makeup and makeover game, the customers coming to your salon are in desperate need of a makeover. Your mission is to help them solve the problems of acne, uneven skin tone as well as dullness on their face using your makeup and makeover skills.
There are many injured patients suffering from foot & other problems like painful infections, fractures, wounds, germs and chapped lips. Don't be scared and give them treatment. Choose from different kinds of fashion items, gorgeous style, eye-catching makeup and luxurious design to give people the makeover they desire!
Master your makeover skills to reveal the hidden beauty with this makeup and makeover ASMR game.
💄 How to play:
- Choose the beauty tools to makeover your customers and help them solve the problem with their skin, hand, lips and foot.
- Apply makeup to the customers with the best cosmetics you think.
- Choose and match the most beautiful jewellery to give the customer a perfect look.
- Enjoy the skincare and makeup ASMR satisfy sounds.
💄 Makeup & Makeover ASMR Game Features:
- Relaxing and satisfying ASMR sound effects.
- Makeover, makeup, hand and foot ASMR for helpless clients.
- Variety of models with different skin tones and facial features.
- Addictive and soothing gameplay.

bluejetty:00132370:ios.summary:

Note: It is N
bluejetty:00132370:ios.description:
Retro Game Collector is the must-have reference app for every game collecting enthusiast. This app serves as a reference for every retro game ever released. Keep track of your own game collection and even keep a wanted list. 
Note: It is NOT intended nor possible to play games with this app.
We offer one free-to-choose library: 2600, 3DO, 3DS, 5200, 7800, Astrocade, Atari 8-bit, CD-i, Colecovision, Commodore 64, DS, Dreamcast, Dreamcast Japan, Fairchild Channel F, Famicom, Famicom Disk System, Game & Watch, Game Gear, Game.com, GameCube, Gameboy / Gameboy Color, Gameboy Advance, Genesis / MegaDrive, Intellivision, Jaguar, Lynx, Master System, MegaDrive Japan, Microvision, N-Gage, N64, N64 Japan, NES, Neo Geo AES, Neo Geo AES Japan, Neo Geo CD, Neo Geo MVS, Neo Geo Pocket / Color, Nintendo Power Magazine, Odyssey 2 / Videopac, PC-Engine, PS1, PS1 Japan, PS2, PS2 Japan, PS3, PS3 Japan, PS4, PS5, PSP, Pico, Pico Japan, SCD, SG-1000, SNES, Saturn, Saturn Japan, Super Famicom, Switch, Switch 2, TG16, TI99/4A, Tiger LCD, Vectrex, Vita, Wii, WiiU, WonderSwan, WonderSwan Color, Xbox, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Xbox Series X.
We also include the following ones free of charge: Amiibo, Amiibo Cards, 32X and Virtual Boy, the other libraries are available as an in-app purchase or subscription.
If you need others, request them!
Cataloging and Tracking:
 Keep track of your game collection.
 Maintain a wanted list for games you're seeking.
 Add custom games, including reproduction games.
 Track duplicates and quantities for each game. View your most valuable and rare games in the Trophy Room
Library Support:
 Offers a wide range of retro game libraries for various consoles, including both popular and niche ones.
 Complete database of games from US/EU/AU regions.
Reference and Information:
 Provides comprehensive information on each game, including rarity, value, and region/versions.
 Shows box art for every game.
 Displays the latest retro gaming articles and videos.
Budget Tracking and Analysis:
 Tracks purchases and sales to manage your budget.
 Generates an overview of your collection, including growth and value insights.
 Analyzes your collection through tools provided.
Multi-Device Syncing and Sharing:
 Syncs your collection across multiple devices.
 Share your collection with friends or potential buyers via My.PureGaming.org.
 Export your collection in a spreadsheet
Personalization and Organization:
 Offers customizable features such as notes for each game, cover mode browsing, and using your own box art.
 Allows filtering and sorting of games by rarity, publisher, etc.
 Create lists of games for easy organization.
Media Integration:
 View eBay results for each game
 Lookup YouTube videos for each game
Additional Features:
 Exclude unwanted games.
 Displays a graph showing the evolution of your collection over time.
 Supports multi-currency transactions.
 Apple Watch support
 Works on both iOS and iPadOS
We offer both yearly and monthly subscription options that give you full access to the app.
Link to our Terms of Use: https://www.captaintouch.com/captouch/termsofuse.html
Link to our Privacy Policy: https://www.captaintouch.com/captouch/privacypolicy.html
When you tap on links to various merchants on our app and make a purchase, this can result in us earning a commission. Affiliate programs and affiliations include, but are not limited to, the eBay Partner Network.

bluejetty:00175283:ios.description:
6M+ downloads worldwide. The most popular Earthquake app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Updated for iOS 27 with Liquid Glass
Get the latest global earthquake data from multiple sources and receive push notification alerts. No ads.
Main features:
• Rich push notifications as soon as the data becomes available from official sources (you can configure up to four alerts based on location and/or magnitude threshold), or opt-in for preliminary notifications based on user reports (faster)
• Multiple sources, including U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC), Geoscience Australia, GNS Science (GeoNet), Instituto Geográfico Nacional, Servicio Sismológico Nacional, British Geological Survey, GFZ GEOFON, Natural Resources Canada, NOAA
• Map with different-sized, color-coded circles to represent event magnitude and age
• Dedicated Stats tab with customizable charts: select insights, tweak their display, and pin them to your dashboard for quick access.
• Filter events by region (country, continent) or magnitude
• Earthquake catalog covering all regions worldwide, dating back to 1970: search by date, region/country, city or reporting agency
• Report felt earthquakes to help the community confirm seismic events in your area
• The app analyses user reports to calculate an estimated earthquake location once the event has occurred, pending official confirmation
• Timeline view (today, yesterday, previous days)
• Detail view for each event, accessible from the map and timeline
• Tsunami bulletins powered by NOAA and BMKG data
• Map layers: tectonic plate boundaries, orogens, volcanoes, nuclear power plants, population density
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, so the latest seismic data is always at your fingertips
• Population and built-up area estimates around each epicenter
• Export earthquake data to mapping apps
• Social sharing: share event map and data
• Critical Alerts support
* Haptic feedback, Dynamic Type and improved VoiceOver support 
• Siri Shortcuts support: "Siri, what are the latest earthquakes in the United States?"

35,000 drivers, fleet managers and business owners trust Loggy with over $200M in vehicles, machinery and equipment. 1,000+ new assets added every month.
Loggy is the free, ad-free vehicle maintenance tracker and digital logbook for everything you own. Whether you have a car, motorcycle, truck, boat, bicycle, heavy vehicle, plane or any custom vehicle — Loggy keeps your complete service story in one place.
----------
NO FAKE PAYWALLS. UNLIMITED. FREE.
Most apps lock your vehicles behind a paywall after the first one or two. Loggy doesn't.
- UNLIMITED vehicles — personal or commercial, no cap ever
- UNLIMITED attachments — photos, videos, voice notes and PDFs, no cap ever
- Full cloud access across all your devices — free, forever
- Zero ads — yes, we hate annoying ads too
Your data should never be held hostage behind a paywall.
----------
YOUR DATA. ALWAYS WITH YOU.
Every record is automatically backed up to the cloud the moment you create it. Switch phones, reinstall the app, change devices — your complete maintenance history is never lost.
----------
FREE FEATURES
• Unlimited vehicles — cars, motorcycles, trucks, boats, bicycles, planes, custom vehicles and more
• Fuel tracking — log every fill-up and monitor fuel consumption over time
• Expense tracking — record and monitor all costs per vehicle or asset
• Attach images, receipts, documents, videos and voice notes to every log entry
• Digitise old paper logbooks — photograph your old service records and store them digitally
• Export a detailed or summarised PDF of your vehicle's full maintenance history
• Track changes, upgrades, faults and repairs throughout a vehicle's history
• Active faults tracker — log outstanding issues so nothing gets forgotten
• Service reminders — customise by date or odometer for oil changes, registration, and upcoming services
• To-Do list — capture everything that needs doing to your vehicle in one place
• Sold your vehicle? Transfer it to the new owner using their email address
• Cloud sync — automatic backup across all your devices, always
----------
LOGGY PRO
• User management — give different users access to specific vehicles. Perfect for drivers logging faults, office managers, fleet planners and allocators keeping track of vehicle reports
• Folders & grouping — organise your vehicles, tools and machinery into custom folders for easy management
• Income tracking — log income against your assets. Perfect for rideshare drivers, couriers, taxis and transport workers
• Detailed reports — generate full income, expense and maintenance reports across your entire fleet
• Priority support
----------
PERFECT FOR
Personal car, motorbike & caravan owners
High-end road and mountain bicycle maintenance
Project cars, track cars, racing & off-road vehicles
Taxis, buses, campervans & caravans
Boats, jet skis, planes & helicopters
Forklifts, cranes, excavators & cement mixers
Tractors, harvesters & farm machinery
Drones, buggies, go-karts & snowmobiles
Fleet managers & local government councils
Fire departments & emergency services
Construction & earthmoving companies
Mechanics logging client service histories
----------
WHAT REAL USERS SAY
"Made selling my car so much easier. Definitely a 10/10." — Wrxwednesday
"I keep track of all my work cars with this, and it's free." — Monz333
"Feels so good to have complete control over what's happening with my car without needing a mechanic." — Loggy user
"This free app is phenomenal for helping keep track of our apparatus maintenance." — Fleet manager
"This has saved me so much grief. So simple and quick." — om12886
----------
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add any vehicle or asset
2. Log a service, upgrade, fault or repair — attach photos, receipts or voice notes
3. Set a reminder by date or odometer and never miss a service again
AI-powered logging is coming soon — seamless, fast, effortless record keeping.
Loggy — Your vehicle's service story, in one place.
Download free. No credit card. No fake paywalls.

bluejetty:00070498:ios.description:
Have you ever experienced being alone at home? It's quite scary!
Welcome to Alex's story. That he is home alone because his family accidentally leaves him on their vacation out of town.
Being alone at home is Alex's dream, but now he gets scared by strange voices. He got frightened by his next-door neighbor, the strange man who is rumored by the local kids to be a serial killer.
He took a brave step and checked from the mail slot and saw the pair of sneaky burglars trying to get in. Alex overhears their robbery plans to get out with pockets full of loot and decides to trick them.
Now Alex has to stop the robbers to get in. Let's get ready for the action!
Help him to set pranks by choosing the right option. Just don’t clash with robbers, it is not like other bank robbery or thief games. In this, you just have to put yourself in fun and amazing pranks with thieves & burglars.
Do you have what it takes to be brave? Just ruin their plan through your pranks. Make the right choices and run away before you are detected.
Features:
- Entertaining gameplay!
- Endless variety of fun options to make.
- Detailed home building.
- Sneaking adventure puzzle.
- Easy and smooth controls!
- Engaging gameplay with a wide variety of mechanics!
Remember! The better the choices you make, the funnier pranks you made!

bluejetty:00135577:ios.name: Animal Flow OnDemand
bluejetty:00135577:ios.summary: Animal Flow On Demand brings you everything you need to learn this challenging and fun bodyweight workout anywhere you want. Work out at home, in the park, at the gym - with no equipment necessary, all you need is your body and some space!
bluejetty:00135577:ios.description:
Animal Flow On Demand brings you everything you need to learn this challenging and fun bodyweight workout anywhere you want. Work out at home, in the park, at the gym - with no equipment necessary, all you need is your body and some space!
Start your fitness journey with a 14-day free trail.
Animal Flow is a ground-based fitness program that combines inspirations from gymnastics, hand balancing, yoga-style movements, and breakdancing, along with animal locomotion forms. The program is extremely versatile, and individuals of all fitness levels can tailor the components to their own skill level and goals.
Use the program’s multiple components to improve strength power, flexibility, mobility, and coordination. You can use Animal Flow as a stand-alone workout or integrate it with your existing training plans.
WHAT’S INCLUDED?
Animal Flow On Demand includes three sections to help you get the most out of the program:
Section 1: The Tutorials section includes individual videos where Animal Flow creator Mike Fitch provides detailed instructions on how to correctly perform each of the program’s movements. You’ll find all of the movements from both Level 1 and Level 2 of the program here.
Section 2: The Classes section includes group classes that you can follow along. You’ll find different styles, lengths, and intensities of classes, including some focused on mobility, some focused on building your flow skills, and some focused on just providing you with a really killer high intensity workout.
Section 3: The Flows section is where we say the real magic happens. This is where you link together the many different individual movements into seamless flows. Our pre-designed flows range from easy to difficult and are just a few minutes long.
We’ll release a new Flow every Monday morning, so you’ll always have something new to try.
WHO SHOULD TRY IT?
Animal Flow is designed to provide benefits for individuals of all ages and skill levels. Some of the flows and classes are targeted to the beginner-level, utilizing only low-impact, easier-to-learn movements. Other more advanced flows and classes incorporate much more dynamic power and stability challenges. You choose what works best for your current abilities and progress at your own pace.
Animal Flow can help you improve your mobility and flexibility and grow your strength and power Whether you are an athlete, or someone just starting to work out, or somewhere in between, you’ll benefit from incorporating some Animal Flow into your fitness routines.
LIMITATIONS
Animal Flow is a bodyweight fitness program which requires spending a lot of time with your hands and feet on the ground. If you have any medical or physical conditions which limit your ability to support your bodyweight in this position, you should consult with your physician.

bluejetty:00091382:ios.description:
Turn Your Phone into a Powerful Scanner! 
Pocket Scanner transforms paper documents into high-quality digital files in seconds. Convert scans to PDF, JPG, Word, TXT, and more. Print directly or share via email, messaging apps, or cloud platforms with one tap. 
Key Features 
1. Crisp Scanning & Smart Editing 
 - HD scans with auto-edge cropping and customizable filters. 
2. OCR Text Recognition 
 - Accurate text extraction with intelligent OCR technology.
3. Smart PDF Tools 
 - Generate PDFs instantly. Add signatures, watermarks, or password protection. 
4. Multi-Format Conversion 
 - Export to Word, PDF, TXT, JPG, etc. 
5. Wireless Printing 
 - Print documents directly from your phone to compatible printers. 
6. ID & Card Scanning 
 - Scan IDs, licenses, or cards with 1:1 precision. Auto-align to A4/Letter size. 
7. High-level Security 
 - Secure file encryption & password-protected sharing. 
8. Bulk Processing 
 - Handle large files and image batches effortlessly. 
9. Smart Organization 
 - Categorize documents with custom folders and tags. 
Use Cases 
1. Document Scanning & Management 
- Scan Anything, Anytime Contracts, notes, books, receipts, posters—scan multi-page docs in seconds. 
- Auto-Crop & Enhance Remove clutter and optimize scans with brightness/color adjustments. 
- Professional PDFs Create print-ready PDFs in A4, Letter, or custom sizes. 
- Cloud Sync & Share Save to Photos, email PDFs, or share via AirDrop. 
2. Text Extraction & Editing 
- Scan-to-Text Convert printed/handwritten text to editable content (supports 15+ languages). 
- Boost Productivity Copy text from IDs, invoices, or business cards into apps instantly. 
3. ID & Document Scanning 
- Digitize Critical Info Scan IDs, passports, or insurance cards. Print duplicates at 1:1 scale. 
4. Study & Education 
- Paperless Learning Scan textbooks, notes, or exams to create digital study guides. 
- Smart Flashcards Turn scanned quizzes into shareable digital flashcards. 
5. Business & Productivity 
- On-the-Go Office Scan contracts, whiteboards, or receipts during meetings or travel. 
- Team Collaboration Share annotated PDFs via Slack, Teams, or email in one click. 
6. Everyday Convenience 
- Preserve Memories Digitize photos, recipes, or travel souvenirs. 
- Travel Ready Store scanned itineraries, tickets, and maps offline. 
Why Professionals & Students Love It 
- Time-Saving – Ditch manual typing with instant OCR. 
- Pro-Quality Scans – Crisp results rivaling desktop scanners. 
- High-level Privacy – Your docs stay 100% secure. 
- Apple Ecosystem Ready – Works seamlessly with AirPrint, Files app, and iCloud. 
Download Now – Join 5M+ users who trust Pocket Scanner for work, school, and life!

-Subscriptions to our scanner app auto-renew 24 hours before the expiration date. You can manage your subscriptions in account Settings on the App Store.

bluejetty:00062210:ios.summary:

================================ 
Build a doghouse, sort
bluejetty:00062210:ios.description:
A must-have for TODDLERS and PRESCHOOLERS! Learn and play with cute animated farm animals in 14 fun-packed EDUCATIONAL GAMES. Your children are sure to love this fun farm adventure.
================================ 
Build a doghouse, sort food, hatch eggs, feed a horse, shear a sheep, wash a pig, create your own sticker farm, and much more. My Felt Farm is a wonderful mixture of education and fun. A great way to spark children’s love of learning and foster their curiosity about the natural world! 
================================
** Play 14 fun educational games (for children of AGE 2+) 
** Learn to recognize ANIMAL NAMES and ANIMAL SOUNDS
** Complete a variety of educational activities
** Take care of animals
** Earn tons of adorable farm-themed stickers
** Build your own farm using 6 lovely sceneries
FEATURED EDUCATIONAL CONTENT:
===Matching:
match puzzle pieces to make a toy; match ingredients to a recipe; match colors
===Counting:
count hay bales to load a trailer; count the days till the eggs hatch; count ingredients for a milkshake
===Tracing:
trace a shape to cut out doors to a doghouse; trace a path to help a lost chick find its way back to its mother hen
===Memory practice: 
memorize and recall hiding places of peek-a-boo animals 
===Sorting:
sort fruits to feed a goat
===Coloring:
color the feathers on a turkey; paint a doghouse
===Measuring:
measure planks to build a doghouse
FEATURED ANIMALS:
- Cat: The cat’s toys broke into pieces. Can you put them together?
- Dog: The dog feels cold at night. Build a doghouse for it.
- Hen: Help the hen take care of its eggs and newly hatched chicks.
- Cow: Feed the cow and make a milkshake out of its milk.
- Horse: Load hay onto a trail and feed the horse with it.
- Pig: The pig loves to wallow in mud. Can you wash the pig?
- Goat: The goat is a very picky eater. It loves its food to be sorted. Can you sort it?
- Duck: The duck adores swimming. But its pond dried out. Can you refill it with water?
- Turkey: The turkey wants to be colorful. Can you color its feathers?
- Sheep: It’s time to shear the sheep. Grab the shearing machine and give the sheep a new cut.
- Donkey: This donkey loves grooming. Brush its hair or decorate it with little bows and flowers.
We hope our app will enable you to spend quality time with your children. Have fun playing!

bluejetty:00122615:ios.description:
Coin Wallet — one secure crypto wallet for all your cryptocurrency. Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Solana, Litecoin, Monero and 2,000+ more. Buy, send, swap and manage your assets with full privacy and zero registration required.
Multi-Currency Wallet
Manage all your crypto in one place across 22 major blockchain networks:
Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, GRAM, TRON, Cardano, XRP, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Optimism, Base, Sui, Sonic, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Monero, Stellar, Bitcoin Cash, Ethereum Classic, Dash, Kaspa.
Also supports 2,000+ tokens including USDT, USDC, SHIB, PEPE, DAI, LINK, UNI, MATIC and more — ERC20, BEP20, SPL, TRC20, ARC20, Jettons and other standards.
Self-Custodial Wallet
Your private keys are stored only on your device and never shared with anyone. Also known as a non-custodial wallet.
Trusted Since 2015
Coin Wallet has been on the market since 2015, serving millions of users worldwide. Fully open-source and transparent.
Buy Crypto Instantly
Buy Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and hundreds of other cryptocurrencies directly in the app. Pay with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, SEPA Instant, Revolut Pay, Open Banking, PIX, SPEI, bank transfer and more — fast, simple and secure. No KYC options available.
Send, Receive & Swap
Send and receive any supported cryptocurrency instantly. Swap between hundreds of assets directly in the app — Bitcoin to USDT, Litecoin to Monero and more, privately and instantly. No KYC options available.
Staking
Put your crypto to work and earn rewards — directly in the app, with full control over your assets.
Security & Privacy
Your private keys are stored only on your device — no server, no third party ever has access. AES-256 encryption, BIP39 passphrase, PIN or biometric login, and hardware 2FA via YubiKey keep your funds safe. Full Tor and VPN support for complete anonymity. No registration, no logging, no trackers.
Web3 & DApps
Connect to thousands of decentralized apps and DeFi protocols via built-in browser and WalletConnect.
Multi-Language Support
Coin Wallet is available in 30 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Ukrainian, Persian, Thai, Polish, Dutch, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Swedish, Norwegian, Croatian, Serbian, Bosnian, Filipino, Hebrew, Khmer, Italian.
24/7 Support
Our dedicated support team is ready to assist you with any question. Extensive help articles and guides available at support.coin.space.
Most Popular Crypto Wallets
Bitcoin Wallet, Ethereum Wallet, Solana Wallet, XRP Wallet, Toncoin Wallet, Monero Wallet, Litecoin Wallet, Dogecoin Wallet, USDT Wallet, USDC Wallet and many more.
Download Coin Wallet today and take full control of your crypto.

bluejetty:00084815:ios.description:
SevenSix Tennis – Your Personal AI Tennis Coach 
Improve your tennis technique with the world's most advanced AI tennis coaching platform.
SevenSix combines computer vision, biomechanics, and artificial intelligence to analyze your strokes and deliver personalized coaching tailored to your unique technique, playing level, and performance data.
Simply record your stroke with your iPhone to get instant feedback on your movement, timing, impact point, and swing mechanics. Compare your technique to professional players and pinpoint exactly what you need to improve.
Available in the following languages
• English
• Spanish (Español)
• French (Français)
• German (Deutsch)
• Portuguese, Brazil (Português)
• Hindi (हिन्दी)
• Chinese, Simplified (简体中文)
Advanced Swing Analysis
Our proprietary AI engine analyzes:
* Swing path and 
* Biomechanics & Kinetic chain analysis
* Timing
* Ball impact point
* Movement efficiency
* Stroke consistency
Receive detailed visualizations, performance scores, progress tracking, and actionable recommendations to accelerate improvement.
Why SevenSix?
Most AI tools provide generic advice.
SevenSix is different because our AI understands your actual tennis technique.
Using proprietary biomechanics and stroke analysis technology, SevenSix delivers personalized feedback based on your unique movement patterns and recorded performance data. The result is coaching that is more relevant, actionable, and effective.
Premium Features
* Advanced stroke analysis
* Detailed performance graphs
* All stroke types
* Progress tracking
* Unlimited Cloud video storage
* Achievement badges and ratings
* Access to future premium features
Easy Setup
No sensors. No wearables. No expensive equipment.
Simply place your iPhone on a tripod or ask a friend to record your stroke, then let SevenSix do the rest.
Subscription
Start with a free trial to experience the power of AI-driven tennis coaching.
Subscriptions are available monthly or annually and automatically renew unless canceled in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00159292:ios.description:
VINCI Leather shoe stores are specialized shops that offer high-quality and stylish shoes made of leather. These stores aim to provide you with both style and durability for your feet by using premium leather materials. Here are some key features that define leather shoe stores:
Quality and Durability: Leather shoe stores present shoes crafted from top-quality leather materials. Leather, being a natural material, is long-lasting and resilient. Therefore, when you purchase a pair of leather shoes, you can expect to use them for many years. The natural flexibility of leather allows it to conform perfectly to the shape of your feet.
Elegance and Style: Leather shoes combine elegance and sophistication. You can find a wide range of leather shoe styles and designs, ranging from classic and understated models to modern and trendy options. Leather provides a natural and luxurious appearance, allowing your leather shoes to complement any outfit and add a touch of sophistication to your personal style.
Comfort: Leather shoes offer a high level of comfort. The breathability of leather materials ensures that your feet can breathe, while their natural flexibility provides a comfortable fit. Many leather shoes also feature cushioned insoles that provide support and padding. These features ensure that your feet remain comfortable even during extended periods of wear.
Variety: Leather shoe stores offer a diverse selection to cater to everyone's tastes and needs. You can find leather shoes for both women and men in various styles. Whether you're looking for sports shoes, heels, boots, sandals, or more, there is a wide range of models available. Additionally, there are specialized leather shoe collections for children as well. This ensures that you can find the right shoe option for different activities or seasons.
Expertise and Customer Service: Leather shoe stores are typically staffed by knowledgeable personnel who aim to provide excellent customer service. They can assist you in finding the perfect pair of leather shoes that meet your specific requirements.
With these characteristics, leather shoe stores offer a combination of style, durability, and comfort, allowing you to enjoy a superior shoe experience that reflects your personal style.

apple-macos:6830460291.name: Music Practice Tracker+
apple-macos:6830460291.description:
Music Practice Tracker is not a coaching app. It is a support system for the serious practicing musician: one place where your scores, backing tracks, recordings, links, set lists and practice log live together, ready on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, and on the iPhone Duo folded or open, the moment you sit down to play.
EVERYTHING FOR A PIECE, IN ONE PLACE
Each piece, tune or skill is a study. Its page holds the score or lead sheet (PDF), the play-along track, your own audio and video takes, and the links you keep going back to. Group studies into projects (a recital programme, an exam list, one composer's tunes) and share a chart book across all of them. Start on the iPad, continue on the iPhone, finish on the Mac.
A PLAYER BUILT FOR PRACTICE
Any audio file you own becomes a backing track you can slow down without changing its pitch, transpose without changing its speed, fine tune by up to a quarter tone to meet a recording that isn't at A = 440, and loop by ear with one button. Save the loops as named passages ("Bridge, slow") that remember their own speed and pitch. Each practice item remembers how you played its track, on every device.
A METRONOME THAT GOES WELL BEYOND A CLICK
Any time signature, subdivisions, accents on any beat, eight click sounds, a count-in. A speed trainer that moves towards a target tempo every few bars, silent bars and random mute to test your own time, swing, a polyrhythm voice, saved presets and ordered tempo sequences. Stage View shows the tempo in large type from across the room. On iPhone, haptic feedback puts the pulse in your hand, and a haptics-only mode gives singers a metronome they feel instead of hear.
MADE FOR THE IPHONE DUO TOO
The layout follows the window, not the device. Folded, it is a phone app with the metronome and timer one tap away. Unfolded, the pages open up the way they do on iPad, with a score across the wide screen and the track controls beside the timer.
SET LISTS
The studies for a gig, a recording session or an exam, in the order you'll play them, with a date and a countdown. Practice Set walks you through them one at a time.
A STROBE TUNER
Four strobe bands, cents and hertz, an adjustable reference pitch (400 to 480 Hz) and transposition for B-flat, E-flat and F instruments.
A LOG THAT KNOWS WHAT YOU PRACTICED, NOT JUST FOR HOW LONG
Each study has one progress metric: tempo, keys covered, a self-rating or a count. Log it as you go. Over time the app forecasts when a piece will reach its target, tells you which studies are due for review, finds the days you tend to skip and offers a reminder. A practice journal with three guided prompts is summarized weekly, on the device itself.
RECORD YOUR TAKES
Audio or video, with timestamped notes. Takes sit beside the material they belong to, newest first.
HANDS ON THE INSTRUMENT, PHONE ON THE STAND
Start, pause and resume practice with Siri, Shortcuts or the Action button. The timer, metronome and backing track keep running with the phone locked, and a Live Activity shows the clock on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
There is no account to create and no server of ours. Your log syncs through your own iCloud account. Your files live in a Music Practice Tracker folder in your iCloud Drive, visible in the Files app and arranged like a practice diary. Nothing goes to a third party.
FREE, TRIAL, PRO
The download is free, and a 14-day trial turns everything on. Afterwards the essentials stay free: the timer and sessions, three active studies, 30 days of history, the Basic metronome, the tuner, the Journal and the charts. Pro is a single one-time purchase. No subscription, and nothing you made is ever hidden or deleted.
Available in English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian. Full VoiceOver, Voice Control, Dynamic Type and keyboard support.
